Millard2025-12-27 02:32 UTC
i need to continue with postgres locally ii've brew installed it but i need to finish the steps to use is locally in my laravel app
Claude2025-12-27 02:33 UTC

Remaining steps:

1. Start PostgreSQL service

brew services start postgresql@17

(Adjust version number if you installed a different version — check with brew list | grep postgres)

2. Create a database

createdb your_database_name

3. Configure Laravel .env

DB_CONNECTION=pgsql
DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
DB_PORT=5432
DB_DATABASE=your_database_name
DB_USERNAME=your_mac_username
DB_PASSWORD=

(Homebrew PostgreSQL uses your macOS username with no password by default)

4. Verify PHP pgsql extension

php -m | grep pgsql

If missing:

pecl install pdo_pgsql

Or if using Laravel Herd/Valet, the extension is typically pre-installed.

5. Test connection

php artisan migrate

What's your current blocker, if any?

Millard2025-12-27 02:34 UTC
could you show my the steps before start posgressql servic
Claude2025-12-27 02:34 UTC

Steps before starting the service:

1. Install PostgreSQL via Homebrew

brew install postgresql@17

(Or postgresql@16, postgresql@15, etc.)

2. Add to PATH (if not automatic)

echo 'export PATH="/opt/homebrew/opt/postgresql@17/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.zshrc
source ~/.zshrc

3. Verify installation

psql --version

That's it. After these, you run brew services start postgresql@17.

Which step are you at or having trouble with?

Claude2025-12-29 16:15 UTC

For Laravel + Vite, import in your JS entry file (resources/js/app.js):

import 'primeicons/primeicons.css';

Remove the @import 'primeicons/primeicons.css'; line from your CSS file.

Vite resolves node_modules imports in JS files, not in CSS @import statements.

emit('update:customNumOfDays', someValue)

That someValue becomes $event in the parent template.

import { computed } from "vue";

import JSZip from "jszip";
import { Exception } from "sass";

/**
 * Compress an array of file wrappers into a single ZIP File
 * @param {Array} files Array of { file: File, title?, original_filename?, mime_type?, ... }
 * @param {string} zipFileName Name for the resulting ZIP file
 * @returns {Promise<File>} ZIP File
 */
export async function zipFiles(files, zipFileName = "files.zip") {
    const zip = new JSZip();

    files.forEach((wrapper) => {
        if (!wrapper || !wrapper.file) return;
        const file = wrapper.file;
        const name = wrapper.original_filename || file.name || "file";

        zip.file(name, file, {
            compression: "DEFLATE",
            compressionOptions: { level: 9 },
        });
    });

    const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: "blob" });
    return new File([zipBlob], zipFileName, { type: "application/zip" });
}

Claude2025-12-29 17:47 UTC

The problem is in UpdateClassroomStore.watchers():

watch(
    () => store.state.editRangeDate,
    (newEnd) => {
        store.state.recurring_end_date = newEnd;  // <-- THIS
        ...
    }
)

In setClassroomProperties, you set:

editRangeDate: new Date(end),           // event end time (e.g., 2pm)
recurring_end_date: recurringEndDateObject,  // actual recurring end (e.g., Dec 31)

When the watcher fires on editRangeDate change, it overwrites recurring_end_date with the single event's end time — not the recurring series end date.

Fix options:

  1. Add a guard to skip during initial data load:
watch(
    () => store.state.editRangeDate,
    (newEnd, oldEnd) => {
        if (!oldEnd) return;  // skip initial set
        store.state.recurring_end_date = newEnd;
        // ...
    }
)
  1. Or set editRangeDate to the correct value in setClassroomProperties:
editRangeDate: recurringEndDateObject,  // not new Date(end)

what does comma mean here ```javascript if (store.state.start && store.state.recurring_days && store.state.repeat_every, store.type === 'range') { const newNumOfDays = calculateNumOfDays({ start: store.state.start, recurring_days: store.state.recurring_days, repeat_every: store.state.repeat_every, recurring_end_date: newEnd, }); store.state.num_of_days = newNumOfDays; } ```
Claude2025-12-29 17:57 UTC

That's the comma operator. It evaluates all expressions left-to-right but only returns the last value.

So this:

if (store.state.start && store.state.recurring_days && store.state.repeat_every, store.type === 'range')

Ignores everything before the comma. It's equivalent to:

if (store.type === 'range')

This is almost certainly a bug. You probably meant &&:

if (store.state.start && store.state.recurring_days && store.state.repeat_every && store.type === 'range')

<template>
    <div>
        <h1>Test</h1>
        <button class="cursor-pointer" @click="openRoom">open room</button>
        <div v-if="token">{{ token }}</div>
        <div ref="parentElement"></div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';

import axios from 'axios';
import {
  LocalParticipant,
  LocalTrackPublication,
  Participant,
  RemoteParticipant,
  RemoteTrack,
  RemoteTrackPublication,
  Room,
  RoomEvent,
  Track,
  VideoPresets,
} from 'livekit-client';

const token = ref(null);
const parentElement = ref(null);
const url = import.meta.env.VITE_LIVEKIT_URL;

const fetchToken = async () => {
    const response = await axios.get('/livekit/token');
    token.value = response.data.token;
};

const openRoom = async () => {
    await fetchToken();
    
    if (!url || !token.value || !parentElement.value) return;
    
    const room = new Room({
        adaptiveStream: true,
        dynacast: true,
        videoCaptureDefaults: {
            resolution: VideoPresets.h720.resolution,
        },
    });

    room
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, handleTrackSubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackUnsubscribed, handleTrackUnsubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.ActiveSpeakersChanged, handleActiveSpeakerChange)
        .on(RoomEvent.Disconnected, handleDisconnect)
        .on(RoomEvent.LocalTrackUnpublished, handleLocalTrackUnpublished);

    await room.connect(url, token.value);
    console.log('connected to room', room.name);

    // Enable camera and mic
    await room.localParticipant.enableCameraAndMicrophone();

    // Attach local video
    const localVideo = room.localParticipant.getTrackPublication(Track.Source.Camera);
    if (localVideo?.track && parentElement.value) {
        const element = localVideo.track.attach();
        parentElement.value.appendChild(element);
    }
};

function handleTrackSubscribed(
    track: RemoteTrack,
    publication: RemoteTrackPublication,
    participant: RemoteParticipant,
) {
    if ((track.kind === Track.Kind.Video || track.kind === Track.Kind.Audio) && parentElement.value) {
        const element = track.attach();
        parentElement.value.appendChild(element);
    }
}

function handleTrackUnsubscribed(
    track: RemoteTrack,
    publication: RemoteTrackPublication,
    participant: RemoteParticipant,
) {
    track.detach();
}

function handleLocalTrackUnpublished(
    publication: LocalTrackPublication,
    participant: LocalParticipant,
) {
    publication.track?.detach();
}

function handleActiveSpeakerChange(speakers: Participant[]) {
    // show UI indicators when participant is speaking
}

function handleDisconnect() {
    console.log('disconnected from room');
}
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import {
    LocalParticipant,
    LocalTrackPublication,
    Participant,
    RemoteParticipant,
    RemoteTrack,
    RemoteTrackPublication,
    Room,
    RoomEvent,
    Track,
    VideoPresets,
} from 'livekit-client';

const token = ref(null);
const parentElement = ref(null);
const url = import.meta.env.VITE_LIVEKIT_URL;

const connected = ref(false);
const cameraEnabled = ref(true);
const micEnabled = ref(true);

let room: Room | null = null;

const fetchToken = async () => {
    const response = await axios.get('/livekit/token');
    token.value = response.data.token;
};

const openRoom = async () => {
    await fetchToken();
    
    if (!url || !token.value || !parentElement.value) return;
    
    room = new Room({
        adaptiveStream: true,
        dynacast: true,
        videoCaptureDefaults: {
            resolution: VideoPresets.h720.resolution,
        },
    });

    room
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, handleTrackSubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackUnsubscribed, handleTrackUnsubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.Disconnected, handleDisconnect);

    await room.connect(url, token.value);
    connected.value = true;

    await room.localParticipant.enableCameraAndMicrophone();

    const localVideo = room.localParticipant.getTrackPublication(Track.Source.Camera);
    if (localVideo?.track && parentElement.value) {
        const element = localVideo.track.attach();
        parentElement.value.appendChild(element);
    }
};

const toggleCamera = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setCameraEnabled(!cameraEnabled.value);
    cameraEnabled.value = !cameraEnabled.value;
};

const toggleMic = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setMicrophoneEnabled(!micEnabled.value);
    micEnabled.value = !micEnabled.value;
};

const disconnect = () => {
    if (!room) return;
    room.disconnect();
    room = null;
    connected.value = false;
    
    // Clear video elements
    if (parentElement.value) {
        parentElement.value.innerHTML = '';
    }
};

function handleTrackSubscribed(
    track: RemoteTrack,
    publication: RemoteTrackPublication,
    participant: RemoteParticipant,
) {
    if ((track.kind === Track.Kind.Video || track.kind === Track.Kind.Audio) && parentElement.value) {
        const element = track.attach();
        parentElement.value.appendChild(element);
    }
}

function handleTrackUnsubscribed(
    track: RemoteTrack,
    publication: RemoteTrackPublication,
    participant: RemoteParticipant,
) {
    track.detach();
}

function handleDisconnect() {
    connected.value = false;
    room = null;
}
</script>

when i create a room for people to connect should i hold version of it in the database to help with race conditions etc?
Claude2025-12-30 14:07 UTC

Depends on your use case. For your classroom app, yes — store room metadata in your database.

What to store:

// rooms table
id
classroom_id  // foreign key
room_name     // unique identifier sent to LiveKit
status        // pending, active, ended
created_by
started_at
ended_at

Why:

  • Link rooms to classrooms/courses
  • Prevent duplicate rooms for same classroom
  • Track who's authorized to join
  • Audit history

Race conditions: Use database transactions when creating:

DB::transaction(function () use ($classroom) {
    $room = Room::lockForUpdate()->firstOrCreate(

Claude2025-12-30 14:09 UTC

LiveKit creates rooms automatically when the first participant connects with a valid token for that room_name. No pre-creation needed.

The room_name in your token is the room identifier on LiveKit's server.

Flow:

  1. You generate token with room_name: "classroom-123"
  2. Client connects to LiveKit with that token
  3. LiveKit creates room classroom-123 if it doesn't exist
  4. Room auto-deletes when empty (configurable)

If you want explicit control, use the RoomService API:

use Agence104\LiveKit\RoomServiceClient;

$roomService = new RoomServiceClient(
    config('livekit.host'),
    config('livekit.api_key'),
    config('livekit.api_secret')
);

// Explicitly create room
$roomService->createRoom('classroom-123', $emptyTimeout, $maxParticipants);

// List active rooms
$rooms = $roomService->listRooms();

// Delete room
$roomService->deleteRoom('classroom-123');

Recommendation for your app:

  • Store room metadata in your DB (linked to classroom)
  • Let LiveKit auto-create on first join
  • Use webhooks to sync status (room_started, room_finished, participant_joined)

Claude2025-12-30 14:10 UTC

Yes. Simplified:

public function joinRoom(Request $request, Classroom $classroom)
{
    $user = $request->user();
    
    // Find or create room record in YOUR database
    $room = Room::firstOrCreate(
        ['classroom_id' => $classroom->id, 'status' => 'active'],
        ['room_name' => 'classroom-' . $classroom->id]
    );
    
    // Generate token with that room_name
    $token = (new AccessToken(config('livekit.api_key'), config('livekit.api_secret')))
        ->init((new AccessTokenOptions())->setIdentity($user->name))
        ->setGrant((new VideoGrant())->setRoomJoin()->setRoomName($room->room_name))
        ->toJwt();

    return response()->json([
        'token' => $token,
        'room_name' => $room->room_name,
        'url' => config('livekit.host'),
    ]);
}

LiveKit handles the actual room creation when first participant connects. Your DB just tracks which classrooms have active rooms.

            <!-- Remote participants -->

                <div :ref="el => setParticipantRef(participant.sid, el)"></div>
                <span class="absolute bottom-2 left-2 bg-black/50 text-white px-2 text-sm">

                </span>
            </div>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, reactive } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import {
    Room,
    RoomEvent,
    Track,
    VideoPresets,
    RemoteParticipant,
    RemoteTrack,
    RemoteTrackPublication,
} from 'livekit-client';

const token = ref(null);
const url = import.meta.env.VITE_LIVEKIT_URL;
const localVideoRef = ref(null);

const connected = ref(false);
const cameraEnabled = ref(true);
const micEnabled = ref(true);
const participants = ref<RemoteParticipant[]>([]);
const participantRefs = reactive<Record<string, HTMLElement | null>>({});

let room: Room | null = null;

const setParticipantRef = (sid: string, el: HTMLElement | null) => {
    participantRefs[sid] = el;
};

const fetchToken = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post('/livekit/token', {
        room_name: 'test-room',
        participant_name: 'User-' + Math.random().toString(36).substr(2, 5),
    });
    token.value = response.data.token;
};

const openRoom = async () => {
    await fetchToken();
    if (!url || !token.value) return;

    room = new Room({
        adaptiveStream: true,
        dynacast: true,
        videoCaptureDefaults: { resolution: VideoPresets.h720.resolution },
    });

    room
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, handleTrackSubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackUnsubscribed, handleTrackUnsubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, handleParticipantConnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantDisconnected, handleParticipantDisconnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.Disconnected, handleDisconnect);

    await room.connect(url, token.value);
    connected.value = true;

    // Add existing participants
    room.remoteParticipants.forEach((p) => {
        participants.value.push(p);
    });

    await room.localParticipant.enableCameraAndMicrophone();

    // Attach local video
    const localVideo = room.localParticipant.getTrackPublication(Track.Source.Camera);
    if (localVideo?.track && localVideoRef.value) {
        const el = localVideo.track.attach();
        localVideoRef.value.appendChild(el);
    }
};

function handleParticipantConnected(participant: RemoteParticipant) {
    participants.value.push(participant);
}

function handleParticipantDisconnected(participant: RemoteParticipant) {
    participants.value = participants.value.filter(p => p.sid !== participant.sid);
    delete participantRefs[participant.sid];
}

function handleTrackSubscribed(
    track: RemoteTrack,
    publication: RemoteTrackPublication,
    participant: RemoteParticipant,
) {
    if (track.kind === Track.Kind.Video || track.kind === Track.Kind.Audio) {
        const container = participantRefs[participant.sid];
        if (container) {
            const el = track.attach();
            container.appendChild(el);
        }
    }
}

function handleTrackUnsubscribed(track: RemoteTrack) {
    track.detach();
}

const toggleCamera = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setCameraEnabled(!cameraEnabled.value);
    cameraEnabled.value = !cameraEnabled.value;
};

const toggleMic = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setMicrophoneEnabled(!micEnabled.value);
    micEnabled.value = !micEnabled.value;
};

const disconnect = () => {
    room?.disconnect();
    room = null;
    connected.value = false;
    participants.value = [];
};

function handleDisconnect() {
    connected.value = false;
    room = null;
    participants.value = [];
}
</script>

Key events:

  • ParticipantConnected — add to list
  • ParticipantDisconnected — remove from list
  • TrackSubscribed — attach video/audio to that participant's container

Claude2025-12-30 14:33 UTC

Depends on your needs:

Yes, if you need:

  • Attendance records (who joined which classroom call)
  • Duration tracking (how long each student was present)
  • Analytics/reporting
  • Billing based on usage

No, if you just need:

  • Real-time presence (LiveKit tracks this already)

Recommended approach — use LiveKit webhooks to log events:

// participants table
id
room_id
user_id
joined_at
left_at
duration_seconds

// Webhook handler
public function handleWebhook(Request $request)
{
    $event = $request->input('event');
    $participant = $request->input('participant');
    $room = $request->input('room');

    match($event) {
        'participant_joined' => Participant::create([
            'room_id' => Room::where('room_name', $room['name'])->first()->id,
            'user_id' => $participant['identity'],
            'joined_at' => now(),
        ]),
        
        'participant_left' => Participant::where('user_id', $participant['identity'])
            ->whereNull('left_at')
            ->update([
                'left_at' => now(),
                'duration_seconds' => DB::raw('TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, joined_at, NOW())'),
            ]),
            
        default => null,
    };

    return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
}

This gives you attendance records without polling or real-time DB writes from the client.

export function withMixins(Base, ...mixins) {
  return class extends Base {
    constructor(props = {}) {
      super({ ...props, mixins: [...(props.mixins || []), ...mixins] })
    }
  }

export class Store {
  constructor({ defaultState = {}, stores = [], mixins = [] } = {}) {
    this._rawDefaultState = { ...defaultState }
    this._stores = stores
    this._mixins = mixins
    this._watchersCleanup = []
    this.excluded = ['create', 'watchers', 'boot', 'afterCreate', 'destroy', 'compute']
  }

  findStore(storeId) {
    const entry = this._stores.find(
      s => typeof s === 'function' && s.useStore?.$id === storeId
    )
    return typeof entry === 'function' ? entry() : entry

  _collectClassFieldState() {
    const state = {}
    const reserved = new Set([
      '_rawDefaultState',
      '_stores',
      '_mixins',
      '_watchersCleanup',
      'excluded'
    ])

    // Own instance fields
    for (const key of Object.keys(this)) {
      if (reserved.has(key) || key.startsWith('_')) continue
      const desc = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(this, key)
      if (!desc || 'get' in desc || 'set' in desc || typeof this[key] === 'function') continue
      state[key] = this[key]

    let proto = this.constructor
    while (proto && proto !== Object) {

          if (!(key in state)) state[key] = val

      }
      proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(proto)

    // Mixin instance fields
    for (const Mix of this._mixins) {
      const mixInstance = new Mix()
      for (const key of Object.keys(mixInstance)) {
        if (!key.startsWith('_') && !(key in state)) {
          state[key] = mixInstance[key]
        }

        }

  }

Claude2025-12-30 14:43 UTC

No. computed() is read-only by default. Setting connected.value = true will throw a warning and do nothing.

For two-way binding:

Use toRef:

const connected = toRef(liveKitClassroomStore.state, 'connected');
connected.value = true; // Updates store

Or writable computed:

const connected = computed({
  get: () => liveKitClassroomStore.state.connected,
  set: (val) => { liveKitClassroomStore.state.connected = val }
});

Or just set directly:

liveKitClassroomStore.state.connected = true;

const setParticipantRef = (sid: string, el: HTMLElement | null) => {
    participantRefs[sid] = el;
};

const fetchToken = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post('/livekit/token', {
        room_name:room_name.value,
        participant_name: userStore.state.user?.name,
    });
    token.value = response.data.token;
};
onMounted(async () => {
    if(!userStore.state.user) return;
   openRoom();
});
const openRoom = async () => {
    await fetchToken();
    if (!url || !token.value) return;

    room.value = new Room({
        adaptiveStream: true,
        dynacast: true,
        videoCaptureDefaults: { resolution: VideoPresets.h720.resolution },
    });

    room.value
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, handleTrackSubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackUnsubscribed, handleTrackUnsubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, handleParticipantConnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantDisconnected, handleParticipantDisconnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.Disconnected, handleDisconnect);

    await room.value.connect(url, token.value);
    connected.value = true;

    // Add existing participants
    room.value.remoteParticipants.forEach((p) => {
        participants.value.push(p);
    });

    await room.value.localParticipant.enableCameraAndMicrophone();

    // Attach local video
    const localVideo = room.value.localParticipant.getTrackPublication(Track.Source.Camera);
    if (localVideo?.track && localVideoRef.value) {
        const el = localVideo.track.attach();
        localVideoRef.value.appendChild(el);
    }
};

function handleParticipantConnected(participant: RemoteParticipant) {
    participants.value.push(participant);
}

function handleParticipantDisconnected(participant: RemoteParticipant) {
    participants.value = participants.value.filter(p => p.sid !== participant.sid);
    delete participantRefs[participant.sid];
}

function handleTrackSubscribed(
    track: RemoteTrack,
    publication: RemoteTrackPublication,
    participant: RemoteParticipant,
) {
    if (track.kind === Track.Kind.Video || track.kind === Track.Kind.Audio) {
        const container = participantRefs[participant.sid];
        if (container) {
            const el = track.attach();
            container.appendChild(el);
        }
    }
}

function handleTrackUnsubscribed(track: RemoteTrack) {
    track.detach();
}

const toggleCamera = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setCameraEnabled(!cameraEnabled.value);
    cameraEnabled.value = !cameraEnabled.value;
};

const toggleMic = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setMicrophoneEnabled(!micEnabled.value);
    micEnabled.value = !micEnabled.value;
};

const disconnect = () => {
    room?.disconnect();
    room = null;
    connected.value = false;
    participants.value = [];
};

function handleDisconnect() {
    connected.value = false;
    room = null;
    participants.value = [];
}
</script>

Claude2025-12-30 15:15 UTC

The problem is storing Room instance in reactive state. Vue wraps it in a Proxy, and LiveKit can't clone Proxy objects.

Fix: Don't store room in your Pinia store. Keep it as a local variable:

// Instead of:
const { room, ... } = toRefs(liveKitClassroomStore.state);

// Use local variable (not reactive):
let room: Room | null = null;

Or use shallowRef if you need reactivity without deep proxy wrapping:

import { shallowRef } from 'vue';

const room = shallowRef<Room | null>(null);

The Room instance has internal methods/objects that structuredClone can't handle when wrapped in Vue's reactive proxy.

Claude2025-12-30 15:21 UTC

Yes. That creates the room on LiveKit's server before any participant joins.

But it's optional. LiveKit auto-creates rooms when the first participant connects with a valid token. You only need RoomServiceClient if you want to:

  • Pre-create rooms with specific settings (timeout, max participants)
  • List active rooms
  • Delete rooms manually
  • Kick participants
  • Mute participants server-side

For your classroom flow:

public function joinRoom(Classroom $classroom)
{
    $user = auth()->user();
    $roomName = 'classroom-' . $classroom->id;
    
    // Optional: pre-create with settings
    $svc = new RoomServiceClient(
        config('livekit.host'),
        config('livekit.api_key'),
        config('livekit.api_secret')
    );
    
    $opts = (new RoomCreateOptions())
        ->setName($roomName)
        ->setEmptyTimeout(300) // 5 min after empty
        ->setMaxParticipants(30);
    
    $svc->createRoom($opts); // Idempotent - won't fail if exists
    
    // Generate token
    $token = (new AccessToken(...))
        ->setGrant((new VideoGrant())->setRoomJoin()->setRoomName($roomName))
        ->toJwt();
    
    return response()->json(['token' => $token, 'room_name' => $roomName]);
}

If you don't need custom settings, skip createRoom() entirely — just generate tokens.

Claude2025-12-30 15:24 UTC

This requires a more complex architecture:

Database schema:

// rooms table
id
classroom_id
room_name          // classroom-123 or classroom-123-breakout-1
type               // 'main' or 'breakout'
parent_room_id     // null for main, references main room for breakouts
max_participants
status

Room creation with breakouts:

public function createClassroomRooms(Classroom $classroom, int $breakoutCount = 0)
{
    $svc = new RoomServiceClient(
        config('livekit.host'),
        config('livekit.api_key'),
        config('livekit.api_secret')
    );
    
    // Main room
    $mainRoomName = 'classroom-' . $classroom->id;
    $svc->createRoom(
        (new RoomCreateOptions())
            ->setName($mainRoomName)
            ->setMaxParticipants(10)
            ->setEmptyTimeout(300)
    );
    
    $mainRoom = Room::create([
        'classroom_id' => $classroom->id,
        'room_name' => $mainRoomName,
        'type' => 'main',
        'max_participants' => 10,
    ]);
    
    // Breakout rooms
    for ($i = 1; $i <= $breakoutCount; $i++) {
        $breakoutName = $mainRoomName . '-breakout-' . $i;
        $svc->createRoom(
            (new RoomCreateOptions())
                ->setName($breakoutName)
                ->setMaxParticipants(10)
                ->setEmptyTimeout(300)
        );
        
        Room::create([
            'classroom_id' => $classroom->id,
            'room_name' => $breakoutName,
            'type' => 'breakout',
            'parent_room_id' => $mainRoom->id,
            'max_participants' => 10,
        ]);
    }
}

Teacher token with elevated permissions:

public function generateTeacherToken(Classroom $classroom, array $breakoutRoomNames = [])
{
    $user = auth()->user();
    
    // Grant for main room
    $grant = (new VideoGrant())
        ->setRoomJoin()
        ->setRoomName('classroom-' . $classroom->id)
        ->setCanPublish(true)
        ->setCanSubscribe(true)
        ->setCanPublishData(true);
    
    // For monitoring breakouts - teacher joins as hidden
    // Generate separate tokens for each breakout room
    
    $mainToken = (new AccessToken(config('livekit.api_key'), config('livekit.api_secret')))
        ->init((new AccessTokenOptions())->setIdentity($user->name))
        ->setGrant($grant)
        ->toJwt();
    
    $breakoutTokens = [];
    foreach ($breakoutRoomNames as $roomName) {
        $breakoutGrant = (new VideoGrant())
            ->setRoomJoin()
            ->setRoomName($roomName)
            ->setCanSubscribe(true)      // Can listen
            ->setCanPublish(true)        // Can broadcast
            ->setCanPublishData(true)
            ->setHidden(true);           // Hidden from participants
        
        $breakoutTokens[$roomName] = (new AccessToken(config('livekit.api_key'), config('livekit.api_secret')))
            ->init((new AccessTokenOptions())->setIdentity($user->name . '-monitor'))
            ->setGrant($breakoutGrant)
            ->toJwt();
    }
    
    return [
        'main_token' => $mainToken,
        'breakout_tokens' => $breakoutTokens,
    ];
}

Frontend - Teacher connects to multiple rooms:

// Main room connection
const mainRoom = new Room();
await mainRoom.connect(url, mainToken);

// Monitor breakout rooms (audio only, hidden)
const breakoutConnections = {};
for (const [roomName, token] of Object.entries(breakoutTokens)) {
    const breakout = new Room();
    await breakout.connect(url, token);
    
    // Subscribe to audio only
    breakout.on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, (track) => {
        if (track.kind === Track.Kind.Audio) {
            track.attach(); // Plays audio
        }
    });
    
    breakoutConnections[roomName] = breakout;
}

// Broadcast to specific breakout
const broadcastToBreakout = async (roomName, message) => {
    const room = breakoutConnections[roomName];
    if (room) {
        // Enable mic to broadcast
        await room.localParticipant.setMicrophoneEnabled(true);
    }
};

Move student to breakout room:

public function moveToBreakout(Request $request, Classroom $classroom)
{
    $breakoutRoom = Room::where('classroom_id', $classroom->id)
        ->where('type', 'breakout')
        ->where('id', $request->breakout_room_id)
        ->first();
    
    // Generate new token for student
    $token = (new AccessToken(...))
        ->setGrant(
            (new VideoGrant())
                ->setRoomJoin()
                ->setRoomName($breakoutRoom->room_name)
        )
        ->toJwt();
    
    return response()->json([
        'token' => $token,
        'room_name' => $breakoutRoom->room_name,
    ]);
}

Key points:

  • Teacher uses setHidden(true) to monitor without appearing in participant list
  • Teacher needs separate Room instances for each breakout they want to monitor
  • Students get moved by receiving a new token for the breakout room
  • Teacher can toggle mic on/off per breakout room to broadcast

Implementation approach:

// users or schools table
ai_credits         // remaining credits

// ai_usage_logs table
id

Credit system:

class AIService
{
    const CREDIT_COSTS = [
        'quiz_generate' => 5,
        'lesson_plan' => 10,
        'grade_essay' => 3,
        'summarize' => 2,
    ];
    
    public function generate(User $user, string $feature, string $prompt)
    {
        $cost = self::CREDIT_COSTS[$feature];
        
        if ($user->ai_credits < $cost) {
            throw new InsufficientCreditsException();
        }
        
        $result = $this->callAI($prompt);
        
        $user->decrement('ai_credits', $cost);
        $user->increment('ai_credits_used', $cost);
        
        AIUsageLog::create([
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'feature' => $feature,
            'credits_consumed' => $cost,
        ]);
        
        return $result;
    }
}

import { ref, reactive, onMounted, toRefs } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';
import { usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import { useUserStore, useLiveKitClassroomStore } from '@/Pinia/store';
import {
    Room,
    RoomEvent,
    Track,
    VideoPresets,
    RemoteParticipant,
    RemoteTrack,
    RemoteTrackPublication,
} from 'livekit-client';

const { user } = usePage().props.auth;
const userStore = useUserStore();
const liveKitClassroomStore = useLiveKitClassroomStore();
const { token, room_name, connected, camera_enabled, mic_enabled, participants } = toRefs(liveKitClassroomStore.state);
const url = import.meta.env.VITE_LIVEKIT_URL;
const localVideoRef = ref(null);

let room: Room | null = null;
const participantRefs = reactive<Record<string, HTMLElement | null>>({});

const setParticipantRef = (sid: string, el: HTMLElement | null) => {
    participantRefs[sid] = el;
};

const fetchToken = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post('/livekit/token', {
        room_name: room_name.value,
        participant_name: userStore.state.user?.name,
    });
    token.value = response.data.token;
};

onMounted(async () => {
    userStore.setData({ user });
    openRoom();
});

const openRoom = async () => {
    await fetchToken();
    if (!url || !token.value) return;

    room = new Room({
        adaptiveStream: true,
        dynacast: true,
        videoCaptureDefaults: { resolution: VideoPresets.h720.resolution },
    });

    room
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, handleTrackSubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackUnsubscribed, handleTrackUnsubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, handleParticipantConnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantDisconnected, handleParticipantDisconnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.Disconnected, handleDisconnect);

    await room.connect(url, token.value);
    connected.value = true;

    room.remoteParticipants.forEach((p) => {
        participants.value.push(p);
    });

    await room.localParticipant.enableCameraAndMicrophone();

    const localVideo = room.localParticipant.getTrackPublication(Track.Source.Camera);
    if (localVideo?.track && localVideoRef.value) {
        const el = localVideo.track.attach();
        localVideoRef.value.appendChild(el);
    }
};

function handleParticipantConnected(participant: RemoteParticipant) {
    participants.value.push(participant);
}

function handleParticipantDisconnected(participant: RemoteParticipant) {
    participants.value = participants.value.filter(p => p.sid !== participant.sid);
    delete participantRefs[participant.sid];
}

function handleTrackSubscribed(
    track: RemoteTrack,
    publication: RemoteTrackPublication,
    participant: RemoteParticipant,
) {
    if (track.kind === Track.Kind.Video || track.kind === Track.Kind.Audio) {
        const container = participantRefs[participant.sid];
        if (container) {
            const el = track.attach();
            container.appendChild(el);
        }
    }
}

function handleTrackUnsubscribed(track: RemoteTrack) {
    track.detach();
}

const toggleCamera = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setCameraEnabled(!camera_enabled.value);
    camera_enabled.value = !camera_enabled.value;
};

const toggleMic = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setMicrophoneEnabled(!mic_enabled.value);
    mic_enabled.value = !mic_enabled.value;
};

const disconnect = () => {
    room?.disconnect();
    room = null;
    connected.value = false;
    participants.value = [];
};

function handleDisconnect() {
    connected.value = false;
    room = null;
    participants.value = [];
}
</script>

Claude2025-12-30 15:56 UTC

The issue is you add existing participants but don't attach their already-published tracks. TrackSubscribed only fires for new subscriptions after you join.

Fix — attach existing tracks:

const openRoom = async () => {
    await fetchToken();
    if (!url || !token.value) return;

    room = new Room({
        adaptiveStream: true,
        dynacast: true,
        videoCaptureDefaults: { resolution: VideoPresets.h720.resolution },
    });

    room
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, handleTrackSubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackUnsubscribed, handleTrackUnsubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, handleParticipantConnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantDisconnected, handleParticipantDisconnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.Disconnected, handleDisconnect);

    await room.connect(url, token.value);
    connected.value = true;

    // Add existing participants AND attach their tracks
    room.remoteParticipants.forEach((participant) => {
        participants.value.push(participant);
        
        // Attach existing tracks
        participant.trackPublications.forEach((publication) => {
            if (publication.isSubscribed && publication.track) {
                attachTrack(publication.track, participant);
            }
        });
    });

    await room.localParticipant.enableCameraAndMicrophone();

    const localVideo = room.localParticipant.getTrackPublication(Track.Source.Camera);
    if (localVideo?.track && localVideoRef.value) {
        const el = localVideo.track.attach();
        localVideoRef.value.appendChild(el);
    }
};

// Extract to reusable function
function attachTrack(track: RemoteTrack, participant: RemoteParticipant) {
    if (track.kind === Track.Kind.Video || track.kind === Track.Kind.Audio) {
        const container = participantRefs[participant.sid];
        if (container) {
            const el = track.attach();
            container.appendChild(el);
        }
    }
}

function handleTrackSubscribed(
    track: RemoteTrack,
    publication: RemoteTrackPublication,
    participant: RemoteParticipant,
) {
    attachTrack(track, participant);
}

Problem: participantRefs won't exist yet when you try to attach — Vue hasn't rendered the DOM elements.

Better fix — use nextTick:

import { ref, reactive, onMounted, toRefs, nextTick } from 'vue';

// ...

room.remoteParticipants.forEach((participant) => {
    participants.value.push(participant);
});

// Wait for Vue to render participant containers
await nextTick();

// Now attach tracks
room.remoteParticipants.forEach((participant) => {
    participant.trackPublications.forEach((publication) => {
        if (publication.isSubscribed && publication.track) {
            attachTrack(publication.track, participant);
        }
    });
});
Millard2025-12-30 15:58 UTC
what does next tick do?
Claude2025-12-30 15:58 UTC

nextTick waits for Vue to finish updating the DOM after reactive data changes.

Timeline:

participants.value.push(participant);  // 1. Data changes
// DOM not updated yet
await nextTick();                       // 2. Wait for Vue to render
// DOM now has the new elements
participantRefs[participant.sid]        // 3. Element exists

Without nextTick:

participants.value.push(participant);
const container = participantRefs[participant.sid];  // undefined — DOM hasn't updated

With nextTick:

participants.value.push(participant);
await nextTick();
const container = participantRefs[participant.sid];  // HTMLElement — DOM updated

Vue batches DOM updates for performance. nextTick lets you run code after that batch completes.

}

const toggleCamera = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setCameraEnabled(!camera_enabled.value);
    camera_enabled.value = !camera_enabled.value;
};

const toggleMic = async () => {
    if (!room) return;
    await room.localParticipant.setMicrophoneEnabled(!mic_enabled.value);
    mic_enabled.value = !mic_enabled.value;
};

const disconnect = () => {
    room?.disconnect();
    room = null;
    connected.value = false;
    participants.value = [];
};

function handleDisconnect() {
    connected.value = false;
    room = null;
    participants.value = [];
}
</script>

a few things I think it would be better to start the room on the server run the room till that classtime is over then close it and kick participants particpants just join the room and i can limit the amount of participants
Claude2025-12-30 16:35 UTC

Good approach. Server controls the room lifecycle:

1. Create room when class starts (scheduled or on-demand):

// app/Services/LiveKitService.php
use Agence104\LiveKit\RoomServiceClient;
use Agence104\LiveKit\RoomCreateOptions;

class LiveKitService
{
    private RoomServiceClient $client;
    
    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->client = new RoomServiceClient(
            config('livekit.host'),
            config('livekit.api_key'),
            config('livekit.api_secret')
        );
    }
    
    public function createRoom(Classroom $classroom, int $maxParticipants = 10): void
    {
        $opts = (new RoomCreateOptions())
            ->setName('classroom-' . $classroom->id)
            ->setMaxParticipants($maxParticipants)
            ->setEmptyTimeout(60); // Close 60s after empty
        
        $this->client->createRoom($opts);
        
        $classroom->update([
            'livekit_room_name' => 'classroom-' . $classroom->id,
            'livekit_room_status' => 'active',
        ]);
    }
    
    public function closeRoom(Classroom $classroom): void
    {
        $this->client->deleteRoom($classroom->livekit_room_name);
        
        $classroom->update([
            'livekit_room_status' => 'closed',
        ]);
    }
    
    public function listParticipants(string $roomName): array
    {
        return $this->client->listParticipants($roomName);
    }
    
    public function kickParticipant(string $roomName, string $identity): void
    {
        $this->client->removeParticipant($roomName, $identity);
    }
}

2. Scheduled jobs to start/end rooms:

// app/Jobs/StartClassroomRoom.php
class StartClassroomRoom implements ShouldQueue
{
    public function __construct(public Classroom $classroom) {}
    
    public function handle(LiveKitService $liveKit): void
    {
        $liveKit->createRoom($this->classroom);
    }
}

// app/Jobs/EndClassroomRoom.php
class EndClassroomRoom implements ShouldQueue
{
    public function __construct(public Classroom $classroom) {}
    
    public function handle(LiveKitService $liveKit): void
    {
        $liveKit->closeRoom($this->classroom);
    }
}

3. Schedule when classroom is created:

// When creating/updating a classroom
public function scheduleClassroom(Classroom $classroom)
{
    // Start room 5 minutes before class
    $startAt = $classroom->start_time->subMinutes(5);
    StartClassroomRoom::dispatch($classroom)->delay($startAt);
    
    // End room when class ends
    EndClassroomRoom::dispatch($classroom)->delay($classroom->end_time);
}

4. Simplified token endpoint (join only):

// app/Http/Controllers/LiveKitController.php
public function joinRoom(Classroom $classroom)
{
    $user = auth()->user();
    
    // Check room is active
    if ($classroom->livekit_room_status !== 'active') {
        return response()->json(['error' => 'Room not active'], 403);
    }
    
    // Check authorization
    if (!$user->canJoinClassroom($classroom)) {
        return response()->json(['error' => 'Unauthorized'], 403);
    }
    
    $grant = (new VideoGrant())
        ->setRoomJoin()
        ->setRoomName($classroom->livekit_room_name);
    
    $token = (new AccessToken(config('livekit.api_key'), config('livekit.api_secret')))
        ->init((new AccessTokenOptions())->setIdentity($user->name))
        ->setGrant($grant)
        ->toJwt();
    
    return response()->json([
        'token' => $token,
        'url' => config('livekit.host'),
        'room_name' => $classroom->livekit_room_name,
    ]);
}

5. Migration:

    $table->string('livekit_room_name')->nullable();
    $table->enum('livekit_room_status', ['pending', 'active', 'closed'])->default('pending');
});

6. Simplified Vue component:

<script setup lang="ts">
// No room creation logic — just join
const openRoom = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post(`/classroom/${classroomId}/join`);
    
    if (response.data.error) {
        alert(response.data.error);
        return;
    }
    
    token.value = response.data.token;
    const url = response.data.url;
    
    room = new Room({
        adaptiveStream: true,
        dynacast: true,
    });

    room
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackSubscribed, handleTrackSubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.TrackUnsubscribed, handleTrackUnsubscribed)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantConnected, handleParticipantConnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.ParticipantDisconnected, handleParticipantDisconnected)
        .on(RoomEvent.Disconnected, handleDisconnect);

    await room.connect(url, token.value);
    connected.value = true;

    // Attach existing participants
    room.remoteParticipants.forEach((p) => participants.value.push(p));
    await nextTick();
    room.remoteParticipants.forEach((participant) => {
        participant.trackPublications.forEach((publication) => {
            if (publication.isSubscribed && publication.track) {
                attachTrack(publication.track, participant);
            }
        });
    });

    await room.localParticipant.enableCameraAndMicrophone();
    
    const localVideo = room.localParticipant.getTrackPublication(Track.Source.Camera);
    if (localVideo?.track && localVideoRef.value) {
        localVideoRef.value.appendChild(localVideo.track.attach());
    }
};
</script>

Flow:

  1. Classroom created → jobs scheduled for start/end times
  2. 5 min before class → StartClassroomRoom creates LiveKit room
  3. Students click "Join" → get token, connect to existing room
  4. Class ends → EndClassroomRoom deletes room (kicks everyone)

how do i trigger this room to start on the server do i need a worker?
Claude2025-12-30 18:16 UTC

Yes, for queued/delayed jobs you need:

1. Queue worker (for delayed jobs):

php artisan queue:work

2. Scheduler (runs every minute via cron):

* * * * * cd /var/www/clasivo && php artisan schedule:run >> /dev/null 2>&1

Alternative approaches:

Option A: Cron + Scheduler (simplest)

// app/Console/Kernel.php
protected function schedule(Schedule $schedule)
{
    $schedule->call(function () {
        // Start rooms for classes starting in next 5 minutes
        Classroom::where('start_time', '<=', now()->addMinutes(5))
            ->where('start_time', '>', now())
            ->where('livekit_room_status', 'pending')
            ->each(fn ($c) => app(LiveKitService::class)->createRoom($c));
        
        // Close rooms for ended classes
        Classroom::where('end_time', '<=', now())
            ->where('livekit_room_status', 'active')
            ->each(fn ($c) => app(LiveKitService::class)->closeRoom($c));
            
    })->everyMinute();
}

Just needs cron running scheduler — no queue worker.

Option B: On-demand (no worker needed)

Create room when first participant tries to join:

public function joinRoom(Classroom $classroom)
{
    $liveKit = app(LiveKitService::class);
    
    // Auto-create if within class time window
    if ($classroom->livekit_room_status === 'pending' && now()->between($classroom->start_time->subMinutes(5), $classroom->end_time)) {
        $liveKit->createRoom($classroom);
    }
    
    if ($classroom->livekit_room_status !== 'active') {
        return response()->json(['error' => 'Room not available'], 403);
    }
    
    // ... generate token
}

Close via scheduler (still need cron).

Option C: Full queue setup (production)

# Supervisor config (/etc/supervisor/conf.d/clasivo-worker.conf)
[program:clasivo-worker]
process_name=%(program_name)s_%(process_num)02d
command=php /var/www/clasivo/artisan queue:work --sleep=3 --tries=3
autostart=true
autorestart=true
user=www-data
numprocs=1
redirect_stderr=true
stdout_logfile=/var/www/clasivo/storage/logs/worker.log

sudo supervisorctl reread
sudo supervisorctl update
sudo supervisorctl start clasivo-worker:*

Recommendation for your stage:

Start with Option A or B — just cron + scheduler, no queue worker. Simpler to maintain.

// routes/api.php
Route::post('/livekit/webhook', [LiveKitWebhookController::class, 'handle']);

// app/Http/Controllers/LiveKitWebhookController.php
public function handle(Request $request)
{
    // Verify webhook signature (important for security)
    
    $event = $request->input('event');
    $room = $request->input('room');
    $participant = $request->input('participant');
    
    $classroom = Classroom::where('livekit_room_name', $room['name'])->first();
    if (!$classroom) return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
    
    match($event) {
        'participant_joined' => Attendance::create([
            'classroom_id' => $classroom->id,
            'user_identity' => $participant['identity'],
            'joined_at' => now(),
        ]),
        
        'participant_left' => Attendance::where('classroom_id', $classroom->id)
            ->where('user_identity', $participant['identity'])
            ->whereNull('left_at')
            ->update([
                'left_at' => now(),
                'duration_seconds' => DB::raw('TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, joined_at, NOW())'),
            ]),
            
        default => null,
    };
    
    return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
}

Webhook handler:

public function handle(Request $request)
{
    $event = $request->input('event');
    $room = $request->input('room');
    $participant = $request->input('participant');
    
    $classroom = Classroom::where('livekit_room_name', $room['name'])->first();
    if (!$classroom) return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
    
    $user = User::where('name', $participant['identity'])->first();
    if (!$user) return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
    
    $attendance = Attendance::firstOrCreate(
        ['classroom_id' => $classroom->id, 'user_id' => $user->id]
    );
    
    match($event) {
        'participant_joined' => $attendance->events()->create([
            'type' => 'join',
            'occurred_at' => now(),
        ]),
        
        'participant_left' => $this->handleLeave($attendance),
        
        default => null,
    };
    
    return response()->json(['ok' => true]);
}

private function handleLeave(Attendance $attendance): void
{
    $lastJoin = $attendance->events()
        ->where('type', 'join')
        ->latest('occurred_at')
        ->first();
    
    $attendance->events()->create([
        'type' => 'leave',
        'occurred_at' => now(),
    ]);
    
    if ($lastJoin) {
        $duration = now()->diffInSeconds($lastJoin->occurred_at);
        $attendance->increment('total_duration_seconds', $duration);
        
        // Mark present if attended > 50% of class
        $classLength = $attendance->classroom->start_time->diffInSeconds($attendance->classroom->end_time);
        $attendance->update([
            'present' => $attendance->total_duration_seconds >= ($classLength * 0.5)
        ]);
    }
}

                        @delete="deleteBlock(index)"

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import draggable from 'vuedraggable';
import BlockPalette from './BlockPalette.vue';
import AIAssistant from './AIAssistant.vue';
import ObjectiveBlock from './blocks/ObjectiveBlock.vue';
import ActivityBlock from './blocks/ActivityBlock.vue';
// ... other imports

const props = defineProps(['lessonPlanId']);

const lessonPlan = ref({
    title: '',
    description: '',
    standards: [],
});

const blocks = ref([]);

const blockComponents = {
    objective: ObjectiveBlock,
    activity: ActivityBlock,
    assessment: AssessmentBlock,
    materials: MaterialsBlock,
    media: MediaBlock,
    discussion: DiscussionBlock,
    differentiation: DifferentiationBlock,
    notes: NotesBlock,
};

const getBlockComponent = (type) => blockComponents[type];

const totalDuration = computed(() => 
    blocks.value.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (b.duration_minutes || 0), 0)
);

const addBlock = (type) => {
    blocks.value.push({
        id: Date.now(),
        type,
        content: {},
        duration_minutes: null,
        order: blocks.value.length,
    });
};

const updateBlock = (index, data) => {
    blocks.value[index] = { ...blocks.value[index], ...data };
    debouncedSave();
};

const deleteBlock = (index) => {
    blocks.value.splice(index, 1);
    debouncedSave();
};

const saveOrder = () => {
    blocks.value.forEach((b, i) => b.order = i);
    debouncedSave();
};

// Auto-save
const debouncedSave = useDebounceFn(save, 1000);

async function save() {
    await axios.put(`/api/lesson-plans/${props.lessonPlanId}`, {
        ...lessonPlan.value,
        blocks: blocks.value,
    });
}
</script>

// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPlanAIController.php
public function generate(Request $request)
{
    $request->validate([
        'type' => 'required|in:full,objectives,activities,assessment',
        'context' => 'required|string',
        'grade_level' => 'required|string',
        'subject' => 'required|string',
    ]);

    $response = Http::withHeaders([
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . config('services.openai.key'),
    ])->post('https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions', [
        'model' => 'gpt-4o-mini',
        'messages' => [
            ['role' => 'system', 'content' => 'You are a helpful teaching assistant that creates lesson plan components. Respond in JSON format.'],
            ['role' => 'user', 'content' => $prompt],
        ],
        'response_format' => ['type' => 'json_object'],
    ]);
    
    return $response->json('choices.0.message.content');
}

private function buildPrompt(array $data): string
{
    return match($data['type']) {
        'full' => "Create a complete lesson plan for {$data['grade_level']} {$data['subject']} on: {$data['context']}. Include objectives, activities, assessment, and materials.",
        'objectives' => "Generate 3-5 learning objectives for {$data['grade_level']} {$data['subject']} on: {$data['context']}",
        'activities' => "Suggest 3 engaging activities for {$data['grade_level']} {$data['subject']} on: {$data['context']}",
        'assessment' => "Create a short assessment (5 questions) for {$data['grade_level']} {$data['subject']} on: {$data['context']}",
    };
}

// app/Models/LessonPlan.php
<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

class LessonPlan extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = [
        'user_id',
        'school_id',
        'course_id',
        'title',
        'description',
        'subject',
        'grade_level',
        'duration_minutes',
        'status',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'duration_minutes' => 'integer',
    ];

    public function user(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class);
    }

    public function school(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(School::class);
    }

    public function course(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Course::class);
    }

    public function blocks(): HasMany
    {
        return $this->hasMany(LessonPlanBlock::class)->orderBy('order');
    }

    public function getTotalDurationAttribute(): int
    {
        return $this->blocks->sum('duration_minutes') ?? 0;
    }
}

3. Controller:

// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPlanController.php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use App\Models\LessonPlanBlock;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class LessonPlanController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $lessonPlans = LessonPlan::where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->withCount('blocks')
            ->latest()
            ->paginate(20);

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Index', [
            'lessonPlans' => $lessonPlans,
        ]);
    }

    public function create()
    {
        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Builder', [
            'lessonPlan' => null,
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
            'subject' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'grade_level' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'status' => 'in:draft,published,archived',
        ]);

        $lessonPlan = LessonPlan::create([
            ...$validated,
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->school_id,
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.edit', $lessonPlan)
            ->with('success', 'Lesson plan created');
    }

    public function edit(LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $lessonPlan);

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Builder', [
            'lessonPlan' => $lessonPlan->load('blocks'),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $lessonPlan);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
            'subject' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'grade_level' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'status' => 'in:draft,published,archived',
            'blocks' => 'array',
            'blocks.*.id' => 'nullable|integer',
            'blocks.*.type' => 'required|string',
            'blocks.*.content' => 'required|array',
            'blocks.*.order' => 'required|integer',
            'blocks.*.duration_minutes' => 'nullable|integer',
        ]);

        $lessonPlan->update([
            'title' => $validated['title'],
            'description' => $validated['description'],
            'subject' => $validated['subject'],
            'grade_level' => $validated['grade_level'],
            'status' => $validated['status'] ?? 'draft',
        ]);

        // Sync blocks
        if (isset($validated['blocks'])) {
            $this->syncBlocks($lessonPlan, $validated['blocks']);
        }

        return back()->with('success', 'Lesson plan saved');
    }

    public function destroy(LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $lessonPlan);

        $lessonPlan->delete();

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.index')
            ->with('success', 'Lesson plan deleted');
    }

    private function syncBlocks(LessonPlan $lessonPlan, array $blocks): void
    {
        $existingIds = [];

        foreach ($blocks as $blockData) {
            if (!empty($blockData['id'])) {
                $block = LessonPlanBlock::find($blockData['id']);
                if ($block && $block->lesson_plan_id === $lessonPlan->id) {
                    $block->update([
                        'type' => $blockData['type'],
                        'content' => $blockData['content'],
                        'order' => $blockData['order'],
                        'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'],
                    ]);
                    $existingIds[] = $block->id;
                }
            } else {
                $block = $lessonPlan->blocks()->create([
                    'type' => $blockData['type'],
                    'content' => $blockData['content'],
                    'order' => $blockData['order'],
                    'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'],
                ]);
                $existingIds[] = $block->id;
            }
        }

        // Delete removed blocks
        $lessonPlan->blocks()->whereNotIn('id', $existingIds)->delete();
    }
}

namespace App\Policies;

                    Add blocks from the sidebar to build your lesson
                </div>

                    <component
                        v-for="(block, index) in form.blocks"
                        :key="block._uid"
                        :is="getBlockComponent(block.type)"
                        :block="block"
                        @update="updateBlock(index, $event)"
                        @delete="deleteBlock(index)"
                        @move-up="moveBlock(index, -1)"

                            @click="save" 
                            :disabled="saving"
                            class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-500 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-600 disabled:opacity-50"
                        >
                            {{ saving ? 'Saving...' : 'Save' }}
                        </button>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import ObjectiveBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/ObjectiveBlock.vue';
import ActivityBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/ActivityBlock.vue';
import AssessmentBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/AssessmentBlock.vue';
import MaterialsBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/MaterialsBlock.vue';
import MediaBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/MediaBlock.vue';
import DiscussionBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/DiscussionBlock.vue';
import DifferentiationBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/DifferentiationBlock.vue';
import NotesBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/NotesBlock.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    lessonPlan: Object,
});

const saving = ref(false);
let uidCounter = 0;

const blockTypes = [
    { type: 'objective', label: 'Objective', icon: '🎯' },
    { type: 'activity', label: 'Activity', icon: '⚡' },
    { type: 'assessment', label: 'Assessment', icon: '📝' },
    { type: 'materials', label: 'Materials', icon: '📦' },
    { type: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: '🎬' },
    { type: 'discussion', label: 'Discussion', icon: '💬' },
    { type: 'differentiation', label: 'Differentiation', icon: '🔀' },
    { type: 'notes', label: 'Notes', icon: '📌' },
];

const blockComponents = {
    objective: ObjectiveBlock,
    activity: ActivityBlock,
    assessment: AssessmentBlock,
    materials: MaterialsBlock,
    media: MediaBlock,
    discussion: DiscussionBlock,
    differentiation: DifferentiationBlock,
    notes: NotesBlock,
};

const getBlockComponent = (type) => blockComponents[type];

const form = ref({
    title: props.lessonPlan?.title ?? '',
    description: props.lessonPlan?.description ?? '',
    subject: props.lessonPlan?.subject ?? '',
    grade_level: props.lessonPlan?.grade_level ?? '',
    status: props.lessonPlan?.status ?? 'draft',
    blocks: (props.lessonPlan?.blocks ?? []).map(b => ({ ...b, _uid: ++uidCounter })),
});

const totalDuration = computed(() => 
    form.value.blocks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (b.duration_minutes || 0), 0)
);

const addBlock = (type) => {
    form.value.blocks.push({
        _uid: ++uidCounter,
        id: null,
        type,
        content: getDefaultContent(type),
        order: form.value.blocks.length,
        duration_minutes: null,
    });
};

const getDefaultContent = (type) => {
    const defaults = {
        objective: { text: '', bloom_level: 'understand' },
        activity: { title: '', instructions: '', grouping: 'individual' },
        assessment: { title: '', questions: [] },
        materials: { items: [] },
        media: { url: '', type: 'video', title: '' },
        discussion: { prompt: '', questions: [] },
        differentiation: { struggling: '', advanced: '', ell: '' },
        notes: { text: '' },
    };
    return defaults[type] || {};
};

const updateBlock = (index, data) => {
    form.value.blocks[index] = { ...form.value.blocks[index], ...data };
};

const deleteBlock = (index) => {
    form.value.blocks.splice(index, 1);
    form.value.blocks.forEach((b, i) => b.order = i);
};

const moveBlock = (index, direction) => {
    const newIndex = index + direction;
    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= form.value.blocks.length) return;
    
    const blocks = [...form.value.blocks];
    [blocks[index], blocks[newIndex]] = [blocks[newIndex], blocks[index]];
    blocks.forEach((b, i) => b.order = i);
    form.value.blocks = blocks;
};

const save = async () => {
    saving.value = true;
    
    const data = {
        ...form.value,
        blocks: form.value.blocks.map(({ _uid, ...block }) => block),
    };

    if (props.lessonPlan?.id) {
        router.put(route('lesson-plans.update', props.lessonPlan.id), data, {
            onFinish: () => saving.value = false,
        });
    } else {
        router.post(route('lesson-plans.store'), data, {
            onFinish: () => saving.value = false,
        });
    }
};
</script>

    >
        <input

                >
                    <option value="short_answer">Short Answer</option>

<script setup>
import BaseBlock from './BaseBlock.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    block: Object,
    canMoveUp: Boolean,
    canMoveDown: Boolean,
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update', 'delete', 'move-up', 'move-down']);

const updateContent = (key, value) => {
    emit('update', {
        content: { ...props.block.content, [key]: value },
    });
};

const addQuestion = () => {
    const questions = [...(props.block.content.questions || []), { type: 'short_answer', question: '' }];
    updateContent('questions', questions);
};

const updateQuestion = (index, key, value) => {
    const questions = [...props.block.content.questions];
    questions[index] = { ...questions[index], [key]: value };
    updateContent('questions', questions);
};

const removeQuestion = (index) => {
    const questions = props.block.content.questions.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    updateContent('questions', questions);
};
</script>

how does Route::resource work?
Claude2025-12-30 19:01 UTC

Route::resource creates 7 standard CRUD routes automatically:

Route::resource('lesson-plans', LessonPlanController::class);

Generates:

Method URI Action Route Name
GET /lesson-plans index lesson-plans.index
GET /lesson-plans/create create lesson-plans.create
POST /lesson-plans store lesson-plans.store
GET /lesson-plans/{lesson_plan} show lesson-plans.show
GET /lesson-plans/{lesson_plan}/edit edit lesson-plans.edit
PUT/PATCH /lesson-plans/{lesson_plan} update lesson-plans.update
DELETE /lesson-plans/{lesson_plan} destroy lesson-plans.destroy

Verify with:

php artisan route:list --name=lesson-plans

Limit routes:

Route::resource('lesson-plans', LessonPlanController::class)
    ->only(['index', 'store', 'update', 'destroy']);

// or

Route::resource('lesson-plans', LessonPlanController::class)
    ->except(['show']);

API version (no create/edit):

Route::apiResource('lesson-plans', LessonPlanController::class);

Both are correct:

auth()->id()           // Shorthand - returns user ID directly
auth()->user()->id     // Gets user model, then ID property

They return the same value. auth()->id() is just cleaner.

The reason I used auth()->user()->school_id is because there's no shorthand for school_id — you have to access the user model first.

'user_id' => auth()->id(),                    // ✓ shorthand exists
'school_id' => auth()->user()->school_id,     // ✓ no shorthand, need user model

// Only show published plans in shared library
LessonPlan::where('status', 'published')

// Teachers browse/duplicate others' published plans
public function library()
{
    $plans = LessonPlan::where('status', 'published')
        ->where('school_id', auth()->user()->current_school_id)
        ->where('user_id', '!=', auth()->id())
        ->with('user')
        ->get();
    
    return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Library', ['plans' => $plans]);
}

// Duplicate a published plan
public function duplicate(LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
{
    $copy = $lessonPlan->replicate();
    $copy->user_id = auth()->id();
    $copy->title = $copy->title . ' (Copy)';
    $copy->status = 'draft';
    $copy->save();
    
    foreach ($lessonPlan->blocks as $block) {
        $copy->blocks()->create($block->toArray());
    }
    
    return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.edit', $copy);
}

<!-- resources/js/Pages/LessonPlans/Builder.vue -->

                <!-- Header -->

                    <input
                        v-model="form.title"
                        @input="debouncedSave"
                        class="text-2xl font-bold w-full border-b border-transparent hover:border-gray-300 focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-none pb-1"
                        placeholder="Lesson Title"
                    />
                    <textarea
                        v-model="form.description"
                        @input="debouncedSave"
                        class="w-full mt-2 text-gray-600 border-b border-transparent hover:border-gray-300 focus:border-blue-500 focus:outline-none resize-none"
                        placeholder="Description (optional)"
                        rows="2"
                    />
                    <div class="flex gap-4 mt-3">
                        <input
                            v-model="form.subject"
                            @input="debouncedSave"
                            class="text-sm border rounded px-2 py-1"
                            placeholder="Subject"
                        />
                        <input
                            v-model="form.grade_level"
                            @input="debouncedSave"
                            class="text-sm border rounded px-2 py-1"
                            placeholder="Grade Level"
                        />
                        <select v-model="form.status" @change="debouncedSave" class="text-sm border rounded px-2 py-1">
                            <option value="draft">Draft</option>
                            <option value="published">Published</option>
                            <option value="archived">Archived</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Blocks with drag-drop -->
                <div v-if="form.blocks.length === 0" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400 border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg">
                    Add blocks from the sidebar to build your lesson
                </div>

                <draggable
                    v-else
                    v-model="form.blocks"
                    item-key="_uid"
                    handle=".drag-handle"
                    ghost-class="opacity-50"
                    animation="200"
                    @end="onDragEnd"
                >
                    <template #item="{ element, index }">
                        <component
                            :is="getBlockComponent(element.type)"
                            :block="element"
                            @update="updateBlock(index, $event)"
                            @delete="deleteBlock(index)"
                            @move-up="moveBlock(index, -1)"
                            @move-down="moveBlock(index, 1)"
                            :can-move-up="index > 0"
                            :can-move-down="index < form.blocks.length - 1"
                        />
                    </template>
                </draggable>

                <!-- Footer -->
                <div class="mt-6 flex justify-between items-center text-sm text-gray-500">
                    <span>Total duration: {{ totalDuration }} minutes</span>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-4">
                        <span v-if="saveStatus" :class="saveStatusClass">{{ saveStatus }}</span>
                        <Link :href="route('lesson-plans.index')" class="px-4 py-2 border rounded hover:bg-gray-50">
                            Back

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, watch } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import draggable from 'vuedraggable';
import { useDebounceFn } from '@vueuse/core';
import ObjectiveBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/ObjectiveBlock.vue';
import ActivityBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/ActivityBlock.vue';
import AssessmentBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/AssessmentBlock.vue';
import MaterialsBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/MaterialsBlock.vue';
import MediaBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/MediaBlock.vue';
import DiscussionBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/DiscussionBlock.vue';
import DifferentiationBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/DifferentiationBlock.vue';
import NotesBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/NotesBlock.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    lessonPlan: Object,
});

let uidCounter = 0;
const saveStatus = ref('');

const blockTypes = [
    { type: 'objective', label: 'Objective', icon: '🎯' },
    { type: 'activity', label: 'Activity', icon: '⚡' },
    { type: 'assessment', label: 'Assessment', icon: '📝' },
    { type: 'materials', label: 'Materials', icon: '📦' },
    { type: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: '🎬' },
    { type: 'discussion', label: 'Discussion', icon: '💬' },
    { type: 'differentiation', label: 'Differentiation', icon: '🔀' },
    { type: 'notes', label: 'Notes', icon: '📌' },
];

const blockComponents = {
    objective: ObjectiveBlock,
    activity: ActivityBlock,
    assessment: AssessmentBlock,
    materials: MaterialsBlock,
    media: MediaBlock,
    discussion: DiscussionBlock,
    differentiation: DifferentiationBlock,
    notes: NotesBlock,
};

const getBlockComponent = (type) => blockComponents[type];

const form = ref({
    title: props.lessonPlan?.title ?? '',
    description: props.lessonPlan?.description ?? '',
    subject: props.lessonPlan?.subject ?? '',
    grade_level: props.lessonPlan?.grade_level ?? '',
    status: props.lessonPlan?.status ?? 'draft',
    blocks: (props.lessonPlan?.blocks ?? []).map(b => ({ ...b, _uid: ++uidCounter })),
});

const totalDuration = computed(() =>
    form.value.blocks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (b.duration_minutes || 0), 0)
);

const saveStatusClass = computed(() => ({
    'text-green-600': saveStatus.value === 'Saved',
    'text-yellow-600': saveStatus.value === 'Saving...',
    'text-red-600': saveStatus.value === 'Error saving',
}));

const getDefaultContent = (type) => {
    const defaults = {
        objective: { text: '', bloom_level: 'understand' },
        activity: { title: '', instructions: '', grouping: 'individual' },
        assessment: { title: '', questions: [] },
        materials: { items: [] },
        media: { url: '', type: 'video', title: '' },
        discussion: { prompt: '', questions: [] },
        differentiation: { struggling: '', advanced: '', ell: '' },
        notes: { text: '' },
    };
    return defaults[type] || {};
};

const addBlock = (type) => {
    form.value.blocks.push({
        _uid: ++uidCounter,
        id: null,
        type,
        content: getDefaultContent(type),
        order: form.value.blocks.length,
        duration_minutes: null,
    });
    debouncedSave();
};

const updateBlock = (index, data) => {
    form.value.blocks[index] = { ...form.value.blocks[index], ...data };
    debouncedSave();
};

const deleteBlock = (index) => {
    form.value.blocks.splice(index, 1);
    reorderBlocks();
    debouncedSave();
};

const moveBlock = (index, direction) => {
    const newIndex = index + direction;
    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= form.value.blocks.length) return;

    const blocks = [...form.value.blocks];
    [blocks[index], blocks[newIndex]] = [blocks[newIndex], blocks[index]];
    form.value.blocks = blocks;
    reorderBlocks();
    debouncedSave();
};

const onDragEnd = () => {
    reorderBlocks();
    debouncedSave();
};

const reorderBlocks = () => {
    form.value.blocks.forEach((b, i) => b.order = i);
};

const save = async () => {
    if (!props.lessonPlan?.id) return;

    saveStatus.value = 'Saving...';

    const data = {
        ...form.value,
        blocks: form.value.blocks.map(({ _uid, ...block }) => block),
    };

    router.put(route('lesson-plans.update', props.lessonPlan.id), data, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            saveStatus.value = 'Saved';
            setTimeout(() => saveStatus.value = '', 2000);
        },
        onError: () => {
            saveStatus.value = 'Error saving';
        },
    });
};

const debouncedSave = useDebounceFn(save, 1000);
</script>

Install it:

yarn add @vueuse/core

Or skip the dependency and use a simple debounce:

// Replace this import:
// import { useDebounceFn } from '@vueuse/core';

// With this function:
const debounce = (fn, delay) => {
    let timeout;
    return (...args) => {
        clearTimeout(timeout);
        timeout = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), delay);
    };
};

const debouncedSave = debounce(save, 1000);

<draggable

>
    <template #item="{ element, index }">
        <div>
            <component
                :is="getBlockComponent(element.type)"
                :block="element"
                @update="updateBlock(index, $event)"
                @delete="deleteBlock(index)"
                @move-up="moveBlock(index, -1)"
                @move-down="moveBlock(index, 1)"
                :can-move-up="index > 0"
                :can-move-down="index < form.blocks.length - 1"
            />
        </div>
    </template>
</draggable>
