<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import draggable from 'vuedraggable';
import { useDebounceFn } from '@vueuse/core';
import ObjectiveBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/ObjectiveBlock.vue';
import ActivityBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/ActivityBlock.vue';
import AssessmentBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/AssessmentBlock.vue';
import MaterialsBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/MaterialsBlock.vue';
import MediaBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/MediaBlock.vue';
import DiscussionBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/DiscussionBlock.vue';
import DifferentiationBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/DifferentiationBlock.vue';
import NotesBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/NotesBlock.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    lessonPlan: Object,
});

let uidCounter = 0;
const saveStatus = ref('');

const blockTypes = [
    { type: 'objective', label: 'Objective', icon: '🎯' },
    { type: 'activity', label: 'Activity', icon: '⚡' },
    { type: 'assessment', label: 'Assessment', icon: '📝' },
    { type: 'materials', label: 'Materials', icon: '📦' },
    { type: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: '🎬' },
    { type: 'discussion', label: 'Discussion', icon: '💬' },
    { type: 'differentiation', label: 'Differentiation', icon: '🔀' },
    { type: 'notes', label: 'Notes', icon: '📌' },
];

const blockComponents = {
    objective: ObjectiveBlock,
    activity: ActivityBlock,
    assessment: AssessmentBlock,
    materials: MaterialsBlock,
    media: MediaBlock,
    discussion: DiscussionBlock,
    differentiation: DifferentiationBlock,
    notes: NotesBlock,
};

const getBlockComponent = (type) => blockComponents[type];

const form = ref({
    title: props.lessonPlan?.title ?? '',
    description: props.lessonPlan?.description ?? '',
    subject: props.lessonPlan?.subject ?? '',
    grade_level: props.lessonPlan?.grade_level ?? '',
    status: props.lessonPlan?.status ?? 'draft',
    blocks: (props.lessonPlan?.blocks ?? []).map(b => ({ ...b, _uid: ++uidCounter })),
});

const totalDuration = computed(() =>
    form.value.blocks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (b.duration_minutes || 0), 0)
);

const saveStatusClass = computed(() => ({
    'text-green-600': saveStatus.value === 'Saved',
    'text-yellow-600': saveStatus.value === 'Saving...',
    'text-red-600': saveStatus.value === 'Error saving',
}));

const getDefaultContent = (type) => {
    const defaults = {
        objective: { text: '', bloom_level: 'understand' },
        activity: { title: '', instructions: '', grouping: 'individual' },
        assessment: { title: '', questions: [] },
        materials: { items: [] },
        media: { url: '', type: 'video', title: '' },
        discussion: { prompt: '', questions: [] },
        differentiation: { struggling: '', advanced: '', ell: '' },
        notes: { text: '' },
    };
    return defaults[type] || {};
};

const addBlock = (type) => {
    form.value.blocks.push({
        _uid: ++uidCounter,
        id: null,
        type,
        content: getDefaultContent(type),
        order: form.value.blocks.length,
        duration_minutes: null,
    });
    debouncedSave();
};

const updateBlock = (index, data) => {
    form.value.blocks[index] = { ...form.value.blocks[index], ...data };
    debouncedSave();
};

const deleteBlock = (index) => {
    form.value.blocks.splice(index, 1);
    reorderBlocks();
    debouncedSave();
};

const moveBlock = (index, direction) => {
    const newIndex = index + direction;
    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= form.value.blocks.length) return;

    const blocks = [...form.value.blocks];
    [blocks[index], blocks[newIndex]] = [blocks[newIndex], blocks[index]];
    form.value.blocks = blocks;
    reorderBlocks();
    debouncedSave();
};

const onDragEnd = () => {
    reorderBlocks();
    debouncedSave();
};

const reorderBlocks = () => {
    form.value.blocks.forEach((b, i) => b.order = i);
};

const save = async () => {
    if (!props.lessonPlan?.id) return;

    saveStatus.value = 'Saving...';

    const data = {
        ...form.value,
        blocks: form.value.blocks.map(({ _uid, ...block }) => block),
    };

    router.put(route('lesson-plans.update', props.lessonPlan.id), data, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            saveStatus.value = 'Saved';
            setTimeout(() => saveStatus.value = '', 2000);
        },
        onError: () => {
            saveStatus.value = 'Error saving';
        },
    });
};

const debouncedSave = useDebounceFn(save, 1000);
</script>

// app/Http/Controllers/ClassroomLessonPlanController.php
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Classroom;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ClassroomLessonPlanController extends Controller
{
    public function search(Request $request)
    {
        $query = $request->input('q');
        
        $lessonPlans = LessonPlan::where('school_id', auth()->user()->current_school_id)
            ->where('status', 'published')
            ->where(function ($q) use ($query) {
                $q->where('title', 'like', "%{$query}%")
                  ->orWhere('subject', 'like', "%{$query}%")
                  ->orWhere('grade_level', 'like', "%{$query}%");
            })
            ->limit(10)
            ->get(['id', 'title', 'subject', 'grade_level']);
        
        return response()->json($lessonPlans);
    }
    
    public function assign(Request $request, Classroom $classroom)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'lesson_plan_id' => 'required|exists:lesson_plans,id',
        ]);
        
        $classroom->lessonPlans()->syncWithoutDetaching([$request->lesson_plan_id]);
        
        return back()->with('success', 'Lesson plan assigned');
    }
    
    public function remove(Classroom $classroom, LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        $classroom->lessonPlans()->detach($lessonPlan->id);
        
        return back()->with('success', 'Lesson plan removed');
    }
}

import { ref } from 'vue';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useDebounceFn } from '@vueuse/core';

const props = defineProps({
    classroomId: Number,
    assignedPlans: Array,
});

const searchQuery = ref('');
const searchResults = ref([]);

const search = useDebounceFn(async () => {
    if (searchQuery.value.length < 2) {
        searchResults.value = [];
        return;
    }
    
    const response = await axios.get('/lesson-plans/search', {
        params: { q: searchQuery.value }
    });
    
    // Filter out already assigned
    const assignedIds = props.assignedPlans.map(p => p.id);
    searchResults.value = response.data.filter(p => !assignedIds.includes(p.id));
}, 300);

const assign = (plan) => {
    router.post(`/classrooms/${props.classroomId}/lesson-plans`, {
        lesson_plan_id: plan.id,
    }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
    });
    
    searchQuery.value = '';
    searchResults.value = [];
};

const remove = (plan) => {
    router.delete(`/classrooms/${props.classroomId}/lesson-plans/${plan.id}`, {
        preserveScroll: true,
    });
};
</script>

4. Update controller to handle sub-blocks:

// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPlanController.php

public function edit(LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
{
    $this->authorize('update', $lessonPlan);

    return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Builder', [
        'lessonPlan' => $lessonPlan->load('blocks.subBlocks'),
    ]);
}

private function syncBlocks(LessonPlan $lessonPlan, array $blocks): void
{
    $existingBlockIds = [];

    foreach ($blocks as $blockData) {
        if (!empty($blockData['id'])) {
            $block = LessonPlanBlock::find($blockData['id']);
            if ($block && $block->lesson_plan_id === $lessonPlan->id) {
                $block->update([
                    'type' => $blockData['type'],
                    'content' => $blockData['content'],
                    'order' => $blockData['order'],
                    'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'],
                ]);
                $existingBlockIds[] = $block->id;
            }
        } else {
            $block = $lessonPlan->blocks()->create([
                'type' => $blockData['type'],
                'content' => $blockData['content'],
                'order' => $blockData['order'],
                'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'],
            ]);
            $existingBlockIds[] = $block->id;
        }

        // Sync sub-blocks
        if (isset($blockData['sub_blocks'])) {
            $this->syncSubBlocks($block, $blockData['sub_blocks']);
        }
    }

    $lessonPlan->blocks()->whereNotIn('id', $existingBlockIds)->delete();
}

private function syncSubBlocks(LessonPlanBlock $block, array $subBlocks): void
{
    $existingIds = [];

    foreach ($subBlocks as $subBlockData) {
        if (!empty($subBlockData['id'])) {
            $subBlock = LessonPlanSubBlock::find($subBlockData['id']);
            if ($subBlock && $subBlock->lesson_plan_block_id === $block->id) {
                $subBlock->update([
                    'title' => $subBlockData['title'],
                    'content' => $subBlockData['content'],
                    'type' => $subBlockData['type'],
                    'order' => $subBlockData['order'],
                    'duration_minutes' => $subBlockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                    'meta' => $subBlockData['meta'] ?? null,
                ]);
                $existingIds[] = $subBlock->id;
            }
        } else {
            $subBlock = $block->subBlocks()->create([
                'title' => $subBlockData['title'],
                'content' => $subBlockData['content'],
                'type' => $subBlockData['type'],
                'order' => $subBlockData['order'],
                'duration_minutes' => $subBlockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                'meta' => $subBlockData['meta'] ?? null,
            ]);
            $existingIds[] = $subBlock->id;
        }
    }

    $block->subBlocks()->whereNotIn('id', $existingIds)->delete();
}

public function update(Request $request, LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
{
    $this->authorize('update', $lessonPlan);

    $validated = $request->validate([
        'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
        'description' => 'nullable|string',
        'subject' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
        'grade_level' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
        'status' => 'in:draft,published,archived',
        'blocks' => 'array',
        'blocks.*.id' => 'nullable|integer',
        'blocks.*.type' => 'required|string',
        'blocks.*.content' => 'required|array',
        'blocks.*.order' => 'required|integer',
        'blocks.*.duration_minutes' => 'nullable|integer',
        'blocks.*.sub_blocks' => 'array',
        'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.id' => 'nullable|integer',
        'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.title' => 'required|string|max:255',
        'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.content' => 'nullable|string',
        'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.type' => 'required|string',
        'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.order' => 'required|integer',
        'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.duration_minutes' => 'nullable|integer',
        'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.meta' => 'nullable|array',
    ]);

    $lessonPlan->update([
        'title' => $validated['title'],
        'description' => $validated['description'],
        'subject' => $validated['subject'],
        'grade_level' => $validated['grade_level'],
        'status' => $validated['status'] ?? 'draft',
    ]);

    if (isset($validated['blocks'])) {
        $this->syncBlocks($lessonPlan, $validated['blocks']);
    }

    return back()->with('success', 'Lesson plan saved');
}

                    v-for="(subBlock, index) in block.sub_blocks"

                    :sub-block="subBlock"

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import SubBlock from '../SubBlock.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    block: Object,
    icon: String,
    label: String,
    colorClass: String,
    textColorClass: String,
    canMoveUp: Boolean,
    canMoveDown: Boolean,
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update', 'delete', 'move-up', 'move-down']);

const expanded = ref(false);
let subBlockUid = 0;

const addSubBlock = () => {
    const subBlocks = [...(props.block.sub_blocks || [])];
    subBlocks.push({
        _uid: ++subBlockUid,
        id: null,
        title: '',
        content: '',
        type: 'step',
        order: subBlocks.length,
        duration_minutes: null,
        meta: null,
    });
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: subBlocks });
};

const updateSubBlock = (index, data) => {
    const subBlocks = [...props.block.sub_blocks];
    subBlocks[index] = { ...subBlocks[index], ...data };
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: subBlocks });
};

const deleteSubBlock = (index) => {
    const subBlocks = props.block.sub_blocks.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    subBlocks.forEach((sb, i) => sb.order = i);
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: subBlocks });
};
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import ObjectiveBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/ObjectiveBlock.vue';
import ActivityBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/ActivityBlock.vue';
import AssessmentBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/AssessmentBlock.vue';
import MaterialsBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/MaterialsBlock.vue';
import MediaBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/MediaBlock.vue';
import DiscussionBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/DiscussionBlock.vue';
import DifferentiationBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/DifferentiationBlock.vue';
import NotesBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/NotesBlock.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    lessonPlan: Object,
});

const saving = ref(false);
let uidCounter = 0;

const blockTypes = [
    { type: 'objective', label: 'Objective', icon: '🎯' },
    { type: 'activity', label: 'Activity', icon: '⚡' },
    { type: 'assessment', label: 'Assessment', icon: '📝' },
    { type: 'materials', label: 'Materials', icon: '📦' },
    { type: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: '🎬' },
    { type: 'discussion', label: 'Discussion', icon: '💬' },
    { type: 'differentiation', label: 'Differentiation', icon: '🔀' },
    { type: 'notes', label: 'Notes', icon: '📌' },
];

const blockComponents = {
    objective: ObjectiveBlock,
    activity: ActivityBlock,
    assessment: AssessmentBlock,
    materials: MaterialsBlock,
    media: MediaBlock,
    discussion: DiscussionBlock,
    differentiation: DifferentiationBlock,
    notes: NotesBlock,
};

const getBlockComponent = (type) => blockComponents[type];

const form = ref({
    title: props.lessonPlan?.title ?? '',
    description: props.lessonPlan?.description ?? '',
    subject: props.lessonPlan?.subject ?? '',
    grade_level: props.lessonPlan?.grade_level ?? '',
    status: props.lessonPlan?.status ?? 'draft',
    blocks: (props.lessonPlan?.blocks ?? []).map(b => ({ ...b, _uid: ++uidCounter })),
});

const totalDuration = computed(() => 
    form.value.blocks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (b.duration_minutes || 0), 0)
);

const addBlock = (type) => {
    form.value.blocks.push({
        _uid: ++uidCounter,
        id: null,
        type,
        content: getDefaultContent(type),
        order: form.value.blocks.length,
        duration_minutes: null,
    });
};

const getDefaultContent = (type) => {
    const defaults = {
        objective: { text: '', bloom_level: 'understand' },
        activity: { title: '', instructions: '', grouping: 'individual' },
        assessment: { title: '', questions: [] },
        materials: { items: [] },
        media: { url: '', type: 'video', title: '' },
        discussion: { prompt: '', questions: [] },
        differentiation: { struggling: '', advanced: '', ell: '' },
        notes: { text: '' },
    };
    return defaults[type] || {};
};

const updateBlock = (index, data) => {
    form.value.blocks[index] = { ...form.value.blocks[index], ...data };
};

const deleteBlock = (index) => {
    form.value.blocks.splice(index, 1);
    form.value.blocks.forEach((b, i) => b.order = i);
};

const moveBlock = (index, direction) => {
    const newIndex = index + direction;
    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= form.value.blocks.length) return;
    
    const blocks = [...form.value.blocks];
    [blocks[index], blocks[newIndex]] = [blocks[newIndex], blocks[index]];
    blocks.forEach((b, i) => b.order = i);
    form.value.blocks = blocks;
};

const save = async () => {
    saving.value = true;
    
    const data = {
        ...form.value,
        blocks: form.value.blocks.map(({ _uid, ...block }) => block),
    };

    if (props.lessonPlan?.id) {
        router.put(route('lesson-plans.update', props.lessonPlan.id), data, {
            onFinish: () => saving.value = false,
        });
    } else {
        router.post(route('lesson-plans.store'), data, {
            onFinish: () => saving.value = false,
        });
    }
};
</script>

import ObjectiveBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/ObjectiveBlock.vue';

});

];

const blockComponents = {

    media: MediaBlock,

};

        ...b,

    })),
});

const totalDuration = computed(() =>
    form.value.blocks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (b.duration_minutes || 0), 0)
);

const saveStatusClass = computed(() => ({
    'text-green-600': saveStatus.value === 'Saved',
    'text-yellow-600': saveStatus.value === 'Saving...',
    'text-red-600': saveStatus.value === 'Error saving',
}));

const getDefaultContent = (type) => {
    const defaults = {
        objective: { text: '', bloom_level: 'understand' },
        activity: { title: '', instructions: '', grouping: 'individual' },
        assessment: { title: '', questions: [] },
        materials: { items: [] },
        media: { url: '', type: 'video', title: '' },

    };

};

const addBlock = (type) => {

        type,
        content: getDefaultContent(type),
        order: form.value.blocks.length,

        sub_blocks: [],
    });
    debouncedSave();

const updateBlock = (index, data) => {

};

const moveBlock = (index, direction) => {

    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= form.value.blocks.length) return;

    const blocks = [...form.value.blocks];
    [blocks[index], blocks[newIndex]] = [blocks[newIndex], blocks[index]];
    form.value.blocks = blocks;

const reorderBlocks = () => {

};

const save = () => {
    if (!props.lessonPlan?.id) {

        const data = {
            ...form.value,
            blocks: form.value.blocks.map(({ _uid, sub_blocks, ...block }) => ({

                setTimeout(() => saveStatus.value = '', 2000);
            },
            onError: () => {
                saveStatus.value = 'Error saving';
            },
        });
        return;
    }

    saveStatus.value = 'Saving...';

    const data = {
        ...form.value,
        blocks: form.value.blocks.map(({ _uid, sub_blocks, ...block }) => ({
            ...block,
            sub_blocks: (sub_blocks || []).map(({ _uid: subUid, ...sb }) => sb),
        })),
    };

    router.put(route('lesson-plans.update', props.lessonPlan.id), data, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            saveStatus.value = 'Saved';
            setTimeout(() => saveStatus.value = '', 2000);
        },
        onError: () => {
            saveStatus.value = 'Error saving';
        },
    });
};

    save();
};

7. Update LessonPlanController:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPlanController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use App\Models\LessonPlanBlock;
use App\Models\LessonPlanSubBlock;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class LessonPlanController extends Controller
{
    public function index()
    {
        $lessonPlans = LessonPlan::where('user_id', auth()->id())
            ->withCount('blocks')
            ->latest()
            ->paginate(20);

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Index', [
            'lessonPlans' => $lessonPlans,
        ]);
    }

    public function create()
    {
        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Builder', [
            'lessonPlan' => null,
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $this->validateRequest($request);

        $lessonPlan = LessonPlan::create([
            'title' => $validated['title'],
            'description' => $validated['description'] ?? null,
            'subject' => $validated['subject'] ?? null,
            'grade_level' => $validated['grade_level'] ?? null,
            'status' => $validated['status'] ?? 'draft',
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
        ]);

        if (!empty($validated['blocks'])) {
            $this->syncBlocks($lessonPlan, $validated['blocks']);
        }

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.edit', $lessonPlan)
            ->with('success', 'Lesson plan created');
    }

    public function edit(LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $lessonPlan);

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Builder', [
            'lessonPlan' => $lessonPlan->load('blocks.subBlocks'),
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        $this->authorize('update', $lessonPlan);

        $validated = $this->validateRequest($request);

        $lessonPlan->update([
            'title' => $validated['title'],
            'description' => $validated['description'],
            'subject' => $validated['subject'],
            'grade_level' => $validated['grade_level'],
            'status' => $validated['status'] ?? 'draft',
        ]);

        if (isset($validated['blocks'])) {
            $this->syncBlocks($lessonPlan, $validated['blocks']);
        }

        return back()->with('success', 'Lesson plan saved');
    }

    public function destroy(LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $lessonPlan);

        $lessonPlan->delete();

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.index')
            ->with('success', 'Lesson plan deleted');
    }

    public function search(Request $request)
    {
        $query = $request->input('q');

        $lessonPlans = LessonPlan::where('school_id', auth()->user()->current_school_id)
            ->where('status', 'published')
            ->where(function ($q) use ($query) {
                $q->where('title', 'like', "%{$query}%")
                  ->orWhere('subject', 'like', "%{$query}%")
                  ->orWhere('grade_level', 'like', "%{$query}%");
            })
            ->limit(10)
            ->get(['id', 'title', 'subject', 'grade_level']);

        return response()->json($lessonPlans);
    }

    private function validateRequest(Request $request): array
    {
        return $request->validate([
            'title' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
            'subject' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'grade_level' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'status' => 'in:draft,published,archived',
            'blocks' => 'array',
            'blocks.*.id' => 'nullable|integer',
            'blocks.*.type' => 'required|string',
            'blocks.*.content' => 'required|array',
            'blocks.*.order' => 'required|integer',
            'blocks.*.duration_minutes' => 'nullable|integer',
            'blocks.*.sub_blocks' => 'nullable|array',
            'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.id' => 'nullable|integer',
            'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.title' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.content' => 'nullable|string',
            'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.type' => 'required|string',
            'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.order' => 'required|integer',
            'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.duration_minutes' => 'nullable|integer',
            'blocks.*.sub_blocks.*.meta' => 'nullable|array',
        ]);
    }

    private function syncBlocks(LessonPlan $lessonPlan, array $blocks): void
    {
        $existingBlockIds = [];

        foreach ($blocks as $blockData) {
            if (!empty($blockData['id'])) {
                $block = LessonPlanBlock::find($blockData['id']);
                if ($block && $block->lesson_plan_id === $lessonPlan->id) {
                    $block->update([
                        'type' => $blockData['type'],
                        'content' => $blockData['content'],
                        'order' => $blockData['order'],
                        'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'],
                    ]);
                    $existingBlockIds[] = $block->id;
                }
            } else {
                $block = $lessonPlan->blocks()->create([
                    'type' => $blockData['type'],
                    'content' => $blockData['content'],
                    'order' => $blockData['order'],
                    'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'],
                ]);
                $existingBlockIds[] = $block->id;
            }

            if (isset($blockData['sub_blocks'])) {
                $this->syncSubBlocks($block, $blockData['sub_blocks']);
            }
        }

        $lessonPlan->blocks()->whereNotIn('id', $existingBlockIds)->delete();
    }

    private function syncSubBlocks(LessonPlanBlock $block, array $subBlocks): void
    {
        $existingIds = [];

        foreach ($subBlocks as $subBlockData) {
            if (!empty($subBlockData['id'])) {
                $subBlock = LessonPlanSubBlock::find($subBlockData['id']);
                if ($subBlock && $subBlock->lesson_plan_block_id === $block->id) {
                    $subBlock->update([
                        'title' => $subBlockData['title'],
                        'content' => $subBlockData['content'] ?? '',
                        'type' => $subBlockData['type'],
                        'order' => $subBlockData['order'],
                        'duration_minutes' => $subBlockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                        'meta' => $subBlockData['meta'] ?? null,
                    ]);
                    $existingIds[] = $subBlock->id;
                }
            } else {
                $subBlock = $block->subBlocks()->create([
                    'title' => $subBlockData['title'],
                    'content' => $subBlockData['content'] ?? '',
                    'type' => $subBlockData['type'],
                    'order' => $subBlockData['order'],
                    'duration_minutes' => $subBlockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                    'meta' => $subBlockData['meta'] ?? null,
                ]);
                $existingIds[] = $subBlock->id;
            }
        }

        $block->subBlocks()->whereNotIn('id', $existingIds)->delete();
    }
}

8. ClassroomLessonPlanController:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/ClassroomLessonPlanController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Classroom;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ClassroomLessonPlanController extends Controller
{
    public function assign(Request $request, Classroom $classroom)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'lesson_plan_id' => 'required|exists:lesson_plans,id',
        ]);

        $classroom->lessonPlans()->syncWithoutDetaching([$request->lesson_plan_id]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Lesson plan assigned');
    }

    public function remove(Classroom $classroom, LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        $classroom->lessonPlans()->detach($lessonPlan->id);

        return back()->with('success', 'Lesson plan removed');
    }
}

4. Template Controller:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPlanTemplateController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\LessonPlanTemplate;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class LessonPlanTemplateController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $category = $request->input('category');

        $query = LessonPlanTemplate::query();

        if ($category && $category !== 'all') {
            $query->where('category', $category);
        }

        $templates = $query->orderByDesc('is_featured')
            ->orderByDesc('uses_count')
            ->get();

        $categories = [
            ['value' => 'all', 'label' => 'All Templates'],
            ['value' => 'instruction', 'label' => 'Instruction'],
            ['value' => 'discussion', 'label' => 'Discussion'],
            ['value' => 'project', 'label' => 'Project-Based'],
            ['value' => 'assessment', 'label' => 'Assessment'],
            ['value' => 'other', 'label' => 'Other'],
        ];

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Templates', [
            'templates' => $templates,
            'categories' => $categories,
            'currentCategory' => $category ?? 'all',
        ]);
    }

    public function preview(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        return response()->json($template);
    }

    public function use(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        $template->increment('uses_count');

        $lessonPlan = LessonPlan::create([
            'title' => 'Untitled - ' . $template->name,
            'description' => '',
            'subject' => '',
            'grade_level' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
        ]);

        $structure = $template->structure;
        $blockOrder = 0;

        foreach ($structure['blocks'] as $blockData) {
            $block = $lessonPlan->blocks()->create([
                'type' => $blockData['type'],
                'content' => $blockData['content'],
                'order' => $blockOrder++,
                'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
            ]);

            if (!empty($blockData['sub_blocks'])) {
                $subBlockOrder = 0;
                foreach ($blockData['sub_blocks'] as $subBlockData) {
                    $block->subBlocks()->create([
                        'title' => $subBlockData['title'],
                        'content' => $subBlockData['content'] ?? '',
                        'type' => $subBlockData['type'] ?? 'step',
                        'order' => $subBlockOrder++,
                        'duration_minutes' => $subBlockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                    ]);
                }
            }
        }

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.edit', $lessonPlan)
            ->with('success', 'Lesson plan created from template');
    }
}

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    templates: Array,
    categories: Array,
    currentCategory: String,
});

const previewTemplate = ref(null);
const loading = ref(false);

const filterCategory = (category) => {
    router.get(route('lesson-plan-templates.index'), { category }, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
    });
};

const openPreview = (template) => {
    previewTemplate.value = template;
};

const closePreview = () => {
    previewTemplate.value = null;
};

const useTemplate = () => {
    loading.value = true;
    router.post(route('lesson-plan-templates.use', previewTemplate.value.id), {}, {
        onFinish: () => loading.value = false,
    });
};

const getCategoryIcon = (category) => {
    const icons = {
        instruction: '📚',
        discussion: '💬',
        project: '🚀',
        assessment: '📝',
        other: '📋',
    };
    return icons[category] || '📋';
};

const getBlockIcon = (type) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: '🎯',
        activity: '⚡',
        assessment: '📝',
        materials: '📦',
        media: '🎬',
        discussion: '💬',
        differentiation: '🔀',
        notes: '📌',
    };
    return icons[type] || '📋';
};
</script>

                v-for="plan in lessonPlans.data"
                :key="plan.id"
                class="border rounded-lg p-4 hover:shadow-md transition"
            >
                <div class="flex justify-between items-start">
                    <div>
                        <Link
                            :href="route('lesson-plans.edit', plan.id)"
                            class="text-lg font-semibold hover:text-blue-500"
                        >
                            {{ plan.title }}
                        </Link>
                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                            {{ plan.subject }} · {{ plan.grade_level }} · {{ plan.blocks_count }} blocks
                        </p>
                        <p v-if="plan.description" class="text-gray-600 mt-1 text-sm">
                            {{ plan.description }}
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex gap-2">
                        <span
                            :class="{
                                'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800': plan.status === 'draft',
                                'bg-green-100 text-green-800': plan.status === 'published',
                                'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800': plan.status === 'archived',
                            }"
                            class="text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded"
                        >
                            {{ plan.status }}
                        </span>
                        <button @click="deletePlan(plan)" class="text-red-500 text-sm hover:underline">
                            Delete
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

defineProps({
    lessonPlans: Object,
});

const deletePlan = (plan) => {
    if (confirm(`Delete "${plan.title}"?`)) {
        router.delete(route('lesson-plans.destroy', plan.id));
    }
};
</script>

Got it. Shopify-style architecture with schemas.

Concept:

Template (layout)
  └── Section (block type with schema)
        ├── Settings (configurable fields)
        └── Blocks (sub-blocks with their own schemas)

1. Block Schema definitions:

2. Sub-block (inner block) schemas:

<?php
// app/LessonPlan/SubBlockSchemas.php

namespace App\LessonPlan;

class SubBlockSchemas
{
    public static function all(): array
    {
        return [
            // Teaching steps
            'step' => self::step(),
            'teacher_note' => self::teacherNote(),
            'check_understanding' => self::checkUnderstanding(),
            'differentiation_tip' => self::differentiationTip(),
            
            // Objective sub-blocks
            'success_criteria' => self::successCriteria(),
            'prerequisite' => self::prerequisite(),
            
            // Assessment sub-blocks
            'question' => self::question(),
            'rubric_item' => self::rubricItem(),
            
            // Materials sub-blocks
            'material_item' => self::materialItem(),
            'resource_link' => self::resourceLink(),
            
            // Discussion sub-blocks
            'follow_up_question' => self::followUpQuestion(),
            'talking_point' => self::talkingPoint(),
            'student_response' => self::studentResponse(),
            
            // Differentiation sub-blocks
            'accommodation' => self::accommodation(),
            'extension' => self::extension(),
            'ell_support' => self::ellSupport(),
            'iep_modification' => self::iepModification(),
            
            // Generic
            'note' => self::note(),
            'discussion_prompt' => self::discussionPrompt(),

5. Vue composable to use schemas:

// resources/js/composables/useLessonPlanSchemas.js

import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import axios from 'axios';

const schemas = ref(null);
const loading = ref(false);
const loaded = ref(false);

export function useLessonPlanSchemas() {
    const fetchSchemas = async () => {
        if (loaded.value) return schemas.value;
        
        loading.value = true;
        try {
            const response = await axios.get('/api/lesson-plan-schemas');
            schemas.value = response.data;
            loaded.value = true;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to load schemas:', error);
        } finally {
            loading.value = false;
        }
        
        return schemas.value;
    };

    const getBlockSchema = (type) => {
        return schemas.value?.blocks?.[type] || null;
    };

    const getSubBlockSchema = (type) => {
        return schemas.value?.sub_blocks?.[type] || null;
    };

    const getAllowedSubBlocks = (blockType) => {
        const blockSchema = getBlockSchema(blockType);
        if (!blockSchema?.blocks?.types) return [];
        
        return blockSchema.blocks.types.map(type => ({
            type,
            ...getSubBlockSchema(type),
        }));
    };

    const getDefaultSettings = (schema) => {
        const defaults = {};
        schema.settings?.forEach(setting => {
            defaults[setting.id] = setting.default ?? '';
        });
        return defaults;
    };

    const blockTypes = computed(() => {
        if (!schemas.value?.blocks) return [];
        return Object.entries(schemas.value.blocks).map(([type, schema]) => ({
            type,
            ...schema,
        }));
    });

    return {
        schemas,
        loading,
        loaded,
        fetchSchemas,
        getBlockSchema,
        getSubBlockSchema,
        getAllowedSubBlocks,
        getDefaultSettings,
        blockTypes,
    };
}

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue';
import draggable from 'vuedraggable';
import SettingsRenderer from '../SettingsRenderer.vue';
import DynamicSubBlock from './DynamicSubBlock.vue';
import { useLessonPlanSchemas } from '@/composables/useLessonPlanSchemas';

const props = defineProps({
    block: Object,
    canMoveUp: Boolean,
    canMoveDown: Boolean,
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update', 'delete', 'move-up', 'move-down']);

const { getBlockSchema, getSubBlockSchema, getAllowedSubBlocks, getDefaultSettings } = useLessonPlanSchemas();

const expanded = ref(false);
const showSubBlockMenu = ref(false);
let subBlockUid = Date.now();

const schema = computed(() => getBlockSchema(props.block.type));
const allowedSubBlocks = computed(() => getAllowedSubBlocks(props.block.type));

const colorClasses = {
    objective: 'bg-green-50',
    activity: 'bg-blue-50',
    assessment: 'bg-purple-50',
    materials: 'bg-orange-50',
    media: 'bg-pink-50',
    discussion: 'bg-cyan-50',
    differentiation: 'bg-yellow-50',
    notes: 'bg-gray-50',
};

const addSubBlock = (type) => {
    const subSchema = getSubBlockSchema(type);
    const subBlocks = [...(props.block.sub_blocks || [])];
    subBlocks.push({
        _uid: ++subBlockUid,
        id: null,
        type,
        settings: getDefaultSettings(subSchema),
        order: subBlocks.length,
    });
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: subBlocks });
    showSubBlockMenu.value = false;
};

const updateSubBlock = (index, data) => {
    const subBlocks = [...props.block.sub_blocks];
    subBlocks[index] = { ...subBlocks[index], ...data };
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: subBlocks });
};

const deleteSubBlock = (index) => {
    const subBlocks = props.block.sub_blocks.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    subBlocks.forEach((sb, i) => sb.order = i);
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: subBlocks });
};

const updateSubBlocks = (newSubBlocks) => {
    newSubBlocks.forEach((sb, i) => sb.order = i);
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: newSubBlocks });
};
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import draggable from 'vuedraggable';
import { useDebounceFn } from '@vueuse/core';
import DynamicBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/blocks/DynamicBlock.vue';
import { useLessonPlanSchemas } from '@/composables/useLessonPlanSchemas';

const props = defineProps({
    lessonPlan: Object,
});

const { fetchSchemas, blockTypes, getBlockSchema, getDefaultSettings, loaded: schemasLoaded } = useLessonPlanSchemas();

let uidCounter = Date.now();
const saveStatus = ref('');

const form = ref({
    title: props.lessonPlan?.title ?? '',
    description: props.lessonPlan?.description ?? '',
    subject: props.lessonPlan?.subject ?? '',
    grade_level: props.lessonPlan?.grade_level ?? '',
    status: props.lessonPlan?.status ?? 'draft',
    blocks: [],
});

onMounted(async () => {
    await fetchSchemas();
    
    // Initialize blocks with _uid
    form.value.blocks = (props.lessonPlan?.blocks ?? []).map(b => ({
        ...b,
        _uid: ++uidCounter,
        settings: b.content || {},
        sub_blocks: (b.sub_blocks || []).map(sb => ({
            ...sb,
            _uid: ++uidCounter,
            settings: sb.content || {},
        })),
    }));
});

const totalDuration = computed(() =>
    form.value.blocks.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (b.duration_minutes || 0), 0)
);

const saveStatusClass = computed(() => ({
    'text-green-600': saveStatus.value === 'Saved',
    'text-yellow-600': saveStatus.value === 'Saving...',
    'text-red-600': saveStatus.value === 'Error saving',
}));

const addBlock = (type) => {
    const schema = getBlockSchema(type);
    form.value.blocks.push({
        _uid: ++uidCounter,
        id: null,
        type,
        settings: getDefaultSettings(schema),
        order: form.value.blocks.length,
        duration_minutes: null,
        sub_blocks: [],
    });
    debouncedSave();
};

const updateBlock = (index, data) => {
    form.value.blocks[index] = { ...form.value.blocks[index], ...data };
    debouncedSave();
};

const deleteBlock = (index) => {
    form.value.blocks.splice(index, 1);
    reorderBlocks();
    debouncedSave();
};

const moveBlock = (index, direction) => {
    const newIndex = index + direction;
    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= form.value.blocks.length) return;
    const blocks = [...form.value.blocks];
    [blocks[index], blocks[newIndex]] = [blocks[newIndex], blocks[index]];
    form.value.blocks = blocks;
    reorderBlocks();
    debouncedSave();
};

const onDragEnd = () => {
    reorderBlocks();
    debouncedSave();
};

const reorderBlocks = () => {
    form.value.blocks.forEach((b, i) => b.order = i);
};

const save = () => {
    if (!props.lessonPlan?.id) {
        const data = prepareData();
        saveStatus.value = 'Saving...';
        router.post(route('lesson-plans.store'), data, {
            onSuccess: () => {
                saveStatus.value = 'Saved';
                setTimeout(() => saveStatus.value = '', 2000);
            },
            onError: () => saveStatus.value = 'Error saving',
        });
        return;
    }

    saveStatus.value = 'Saving...';
    router.put(route('lesson-plans.update', props.lessonPlan.id), prepareData(), {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            saveStatus.value = 'Saved';
            setTimeout(() => saveStatus.value = '', 2000);
        },
        onError: () => saveStatus.value = 'Error saving',
    });
};

const prepareData = () => ({
    ...form.value,
    blocks: form.value.blocks.map(({ _uid, settings, sub_blocks, ...block }) => ({
        ...block,
        content: settings,
        sub_blocks: (sub_blocks || []).map(({ _uid: subUid, settings: subSettings, ...sb }) => ({
            ...sb,
            content: JSON.stringify(subSettings),
        })),
    })),
});

const saveNow = () => save();
const debouncedSave = useDebounceFn(save, 1000);
</script>

Now the system works like Shopify:

  • Block types defined by schemas with configurable settings
  • Each block type specifies which sub-block types are allowed
  • Templates reference these schemas
  • Settings are rendered dynamically based on schema definition
  • Extensible — add new block/sub-block types by adding to the schema files

Create it:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPlanTemplateController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\LessonPlanTemplate;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class LessonPlanTemplateController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $category = $request->input('category');

        $query = LessonPlanTemplate::query();

        if ($category && $category !== 'all') {
            $query->where('category', $category);
        }

        $templates = $query->orderByDesc('is_featured')
            ->orderByDesc('uses_count')
            ->get();

        $categories = [
            ['value' => 'all', 'label' => 'All Templates'],
            ['value' => 'instruction', 'label' => 'Instruction'],
            ['value' => 'discussion', 'label' => 'Discussion'],
            ['value' => 'project', 'label' => 'Project-Based'],
            ['value' => 'assessment', 'label' => 'Assessment'],
            ['value' => 'other', 'label' => 'Other'],
        ];

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Templates', [
            'templates' => $templates,
            'categories' => $categories,
            'currentCategory' => $category ?? 'all',
        ]);
    }

    public function preview(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        return response()->json($template);
    }

    public function use(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        $template->increment('uses_count');

        $lessonPlan = LessonPlan::create([
            'title' => 'Untitled - ' . $template->name,
            'description' => '',
            'subject' => '',
            'grade_level' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
        ]);

        $structure = $template->structure;
        $blockOrder = 0;

        foreach ($structure['blocks'] as $blockData) {
            $block = $lessonPlan->blocks()->create([
                'type' => $blockData['type'],
                'content' => $blockData['content'],
                'order' => $blockOrder++,
                'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
            ]);

            if (!empty($blockData['sub_blocks'])) {
                $subBlockOrder = 0;
                foreach ($blockData['sub_blocks'] as $subBlockData) {
                    $block->subBlocks()->create([
                        'title' => $subBlockData['title'],
                        'content' => $subBlockData['content'] ?? '',
                        'type' => $subBlockData['type'] ?? 'step',
                        'order' => $subBlockOrder++,
                        'duration_minutes' => $subBlockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                    ]);
                }
            }
        }

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.edit', $lessonPlan)
            ->with('success', 'Lesson plan created from template');
    }
}

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    templates: Array,
    categories: Array,
    currentCategory: String,
});

const previewTemplate = ref(null);
const loading = ref(false);

const filterCategory = (category) => {
    router.get(route('lesson-plan-templates.index'), { category }, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
    });
};

const openPreview = (template) => {
    previewTemplate.value = template;
};

const closePreview = () => {
    previewTemplate.value = null;
};

const useTemplate = () => {
    loading.value = true;
    router.post(route('lesson-plan-templates.use', previewTemplate.value.id), {}, {
        onFinish: () => loading.value = false,
    });
};

const getCategoryIcon = (category) => {
    const icons = {
        instruction: '📚',
        discussion: '💬',
        project: '🚀',
        assessment: '📝',
        other: '📋',
    };
    return icons[category] || '📋';
};

const getBlockIcon = (type) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: '🎯',
        activity: '⚡',
        assessment: '📝',
        materials: '📦',
        media: '🎬',
        discussion: '💬',
        differentiation: '🔀',
        notes: '📌',
    };
    return icons[type] || '📋';
};
</script>

    public function subBlocks(): HasMany
    {

}

{

    "subject": "Subject area",

                {"title": "Step 1", "content": "Do this first", "type": "step"},
                {"title": "Step 2", "content": "Then do this", "type": "step"}
            ]
        }
    ]
}

Block types: objective, activity, assessment, materials, media, discussion, differentiation, notes
Sub-block types: step, note, question, check, media
Grouping options: individual, pairs, small_group, whole_class
Bloom levels: remember, understand, apply, analyze, evaluate, create

Create a complete, practical lesson plan with 4-8 blocks and detailed sub-blocks for each activity.
PROMPT;

        try {
            $response = OpenAI::chat()->create([
                'model' => 'gpt-4o-mini',
                'messages' => [
                    ['role' => 'system', 'content' => $systemPrompt],
                    ['role' => 'user', 'content' => $prompt],
                ],
                'temperature' => 0.7,
                'max_tokens' => 4000,
            ]);

            $json = $response->choices[0]->message->content;
            
            // Clean JSON if wrapped in markdown
            $json = preg_replace('/```json\s*/', '', $json);
            $json = preg_replace('/```\s*$/', '', $json);
            
            $data = json_decode($json, true);

            if (!$data) {
                return back()->with('error', 'Failed to parse AI response');
            }

            // Create lesson plan
            $lessonPlan = LessonPlan::create([
                'title' => $data['title'] ?? 'AI Generated Lesson',
                'description' => $data['description'] ?? '',
                'subject' => $data['subject'] ?? '',
                'grade_level' => $data['grade_level'] ?? '',
                'status' => 'draft',
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
            ]);

            // Create blocks
            $blockOrder = 0;
            foreach ($data['blocks'] ?? [] as $blockData) {
                $block = $lessonPlan->blocks()->create([
                    'type' => $blockData['type'],
                    'content' => $blockData['content'],
                    'order' => $blockOrder++,
                    'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                ]);

                // Create sub-blocks
                $subBlockOrder = 0;
                foreach ($blockData['sub_blocks'] ?? [] as $subBlockData) {
                    $block->subBlocks()->create([
                        'title' => $subBlockData['title'],
                        'content' => $subBlockData['content'] ?? '',
                        'type' => $subBlockData['type'] ?? 'step',
                        'order' => $subBlockOrder++,
                        'duration_minutes' => $subBlockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.edit', $lessonPlan)
                ->with('success', 'Lesson plan generated!');

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Generation failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

3. Parser Service:

<?php
// app/Services/LessonPlanShortcodeParser.php

namespace App\Services;

class LessonPlanShortcodeParser
{
    public function parse(string $shortcode): array
    {
        $result = [
            'title' => '',
            'description' => '',
            'subject' => '',
            'grade_level' => '',
            'duration_minutes' => null,
            'blocks' => [],
        ];

        // Parse lesson tag
        if (preg_match('/\[lesson([^\]]*)\]/', $shortcode, $lessonMatch)) {
            $attrs = $this->parseAttributes($lessonMatch[1]);
            $result['title'] = $attrs['title'] ?? 'Untitled Lesson';
            $result['subject'] = $attrs['subject'] ?? '';
            $result['grade_level'] = $attrs['grade'] ?? '';
            $result['duration_minutes'] = isset($attrs['duration']) ? (int)$attrs['duration'] : null;
        }

        // Parse objectives
        preg_match_all('/\[objective([^\]]*)\](.*?)\[\/objective\]/s', $shortcode, $objectives);
        foreach ($objectives[0] as $i => $match) {
            $attrs = $this->parseAttributes($objectives[1][$i]);
            $result['blocks'][] = [
                'type' => 'objective',
                'content' => [
                    'text' => trim($objectives[2][$i]),
                    'bloom_level' => $attrs['bloom'] ?? 'understand',
                ],
                'duration_minutes' => null,
                'sub_blocks' => [],
            ];
        }

        // Parse activities
        preg_match_all('/\[activity([^\]]*)\](.*?)\[\/activity\]/s', $shortcode, $activities);
        foreach ($activities[0] as $i => $match) {
            $attrs = $this->parseAttributes($activities[1][$i]);
            $content = $activities[2][$i];
            
            // Extract sub-blocks
            $subBlocks = [];
            
            // Steps
            preg_match_all('/\[step\](.*?)\[\/step\]/s', $content, $steps);
            foreach ($steps[1] as $j => $step) {
                $subBlocks[] = [
                    'title' => 'Step ' . ($j + 1),
                    'content' => trim($step),
                    'type' => 'step',
                ];
            }
            
            // Notes
            preg_match_all('/\[note\](.*?)\[\/note\]/s', $content, $notes);
            foreach ($notes[1] as $note) {
                $subBlocks[] = [
                    'title' => 'Note',
                    'content' => trim($note),
                    'type' => 'note',
                ];
            }
            
            // Checks
            preg_match_all('/\[check\](.*?)\[\/check\]/s', $content, $checks);
            foreach ($checks[1] as $check) {
                $subBlocks[] = [
                    'title' => 'Check Understanding',
                    'content' => trim($check),
                    'type' => 'check',
                ];
            }
            
            // Clean content (remove sub-block tags)
            $cleanContent = preg_replace('/\[(step|note|check)\].*?\[\/\1\]/s', '', $content);
            $cleanContent = trim($cleanContent);
            
            $result['blocks'][] = [
                'type' => 'activity',
                'content' => [
                    'title' => $attrs['title'] ?? 'Activity',
                    'instructions' => $cleanContent,
                    'grouping' => $attrs['grouping'] ?? 'whole_class',
                ],
                'duration_minutes' => isset($attrs['duration']) ? (int)$attrs['duration'] : null,
                'sub_blocks' => $subBlocks,
            ];
        }

        // Parse materials
        preg_match_all('/\[materials\](.*?)\[\/materials\]/s', $shortcode, $materials);
        foreach ($materials[1] as $materialBlock) {
            preg_match_all('/\[item\](.*?)\[\/item\]/s', $materialBlock, $items);
            $result['blocks'][] = [
                'type' => 'materials',
                'content' => [
                    'items' => array_map('trim', $items[1]),
                ],
                'duration_minutes' => null,
                'sub_blocks' => [],
            ];
        }

        // Parse discussions
        preg_match_all('/\[discussion([^\]]*)\](.*?)\[\/discussion\]/s', $shortcode, $discussions);
        foreach ($discussions[0] as $i => $match) {
            $attrs = $this->parseAttributes($discussions[1][$i]);
            $content = $discussions[2][$i];
            
            $subBlocks = [];
            preg_match_all('/\[question\](.*?)\[\/question\]/s', $content, $questions);
            foreach ($questions[1] as $q) {
                $subBlocks[] = [
                    'title' => trim($q),
                    'content' => '',
                    'type' => 'question',
                ];
            }
            
            $result['blocks'][] = [
                'type' => 'discussion',
                'content' => [
                    'prompt' => $attrs['prompt'] ?? '',
                    'format' => $attrs['format'] ?? 'whole_class',
                ],
                'duration_minutes' => isset($attrs['duration']) ? (int)$attrs['duration'] : null,
                'sub_blocks' => $subBlocks,
            ];
        }

        // Parse assessments
        preg_match_all('/\[assessment([^\]]*)\](.*?)\[\/assessment\]/s', $shortcode, $assessments);
        foreach ($assessments[0] as $i => $match) {
            $attrs = $this->parseAttributes($assessments[1][$i]);
            $content = $assessments[2][$i];
            
            $subBlocks = [];
            preg_match_all('/\[question([^\]]*)\](.*?)\[\/question\]/s', $content, $questions);
            foreach ($questions[0] as $j => $q) {
                $qAttrs = $this->parseAttributes($questions[1][$j]);
                $subBlocks[] = [
                    'title' => trim($questions[2][$j]),
                    'content' => $qAttrs['answer'] ?? '',
                    'type' => $qAttrs['type'] ?? 'short_answer',
                ];
            }
            
            $result['blocks'][] = [
                'type' => 'assessment',
                'content' => [
                    'title' => $attrs['title'] ?? 'Assessment',
                    'assessment_type' => $attrs['type'] ?? 'formative',
                ],
                'duration_minutes' => isset($attrs['duration']) ? (int)$attrs['duration'] : null,
                'sub_blocks' => $subBlocks,
            ];
        }

        // Parse notes
        preg_match_all('/\[notes([^\]]*)\](.*?)\[\/notes\]/s', $shortcode, $notes);
        foreach ($notes[0] as $i => $match) {
            $attrs = $this->parseAttributes($notes[1][$i]);
            $result['blocks'][] = [
                'type' => 'notes',
                'content' => [
                    'text' => trim($notes[2][$i]),
                    'visibility' => $attrs['visibility'] ?? 'teacher_only',
                ],
                'duration_minutes' => null,
                'sub_blocks' => [],
            ];
        }

        // Add order to blocks
        foreach ($result['blocks'] as $i => &$block) {
            $block['order'] = $i;
            foreach ($block['sub_blocks'] as $j => &$subBlock) {
                $subBlock['order'] = $j;
            }
        }

        return $result;
    }

    private function parseAttributes(string $attrString): array
    {
        $attrs = [];
        preg_match_all('/(\w+)=["\']([^"\']*)["\']/', $attrString, $matches);
        foreach ($matches[1] as $i => $key) {
            $attrs[$key] = $matches[2][$i];
        }
        return $attrs;
    }
}

4. Controller:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPlanImportController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use App\Services\LessonPlanShortcodeParser;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class LessonPlanImportController extends Controller
{
    public function show()
    {
        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Import');
    }

    public function preview(Request $request, LessonPlanShortcodeParser $parser)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'shortcode' => 'required|string',
        ]);

        try {
            $data = $parser->parse($request->input('shortcode'));
            return response()->json(['success' => true, 'data' => $data]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json(['success' => false, 'error' => $e->getMessage()], 422);
        }
    }

    public function import(Request $request, LessonPlanShortcodeParser $parser)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'shortcode' => 'required|string',
        ]);

        try {
            $data = $parser->parse($request->input('shortcode'));

            $lessonPlan = LessonPlan::create([
                'title' => $data['title'],
                'description' => $data['description'],
                'subject' => $data['subject'],
                'grade_level' => $data['grade_level'],
                'status' => 'draft',
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
            ]);

            foreach ($data['blocks'] as $blockData) {
                $block = $lessonPlan->blocks()->create([
                    'type' => $blockData['type'],
                    'content' => $blockData['content'],
                    'order' => $blockData['order'],
                    'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'],
                ]);

                foreach ($blockData['sub_blocks'] as $subBlockData) {
                    $block->subBlocks()->create([
                        'title' => $subBlockData['title'],
                        'content' => $subBlockData['content'],
                        'type' => $subBlockData['type'],
                        'order' => $subBlockData['order'],
                    ]);
                }
            }

            return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.edit', $lessonPlan)
                ->with('success', 'Lesson plan imported!');

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return back()->with('error', 'Import failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }
}

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useDebounceFn } from '@vueuse/core';

const shortcode = ref('');
const previewData = ref(null);
const error = ref('');
const loading = ref(false);
const showPrompt = ref(false);

const aiPrompt = `Create a lesson plan using this shortcode format:

[lesson title="Title" subject="Subject" grade="Grade" duration="minutes"]

[objective bloom="remember|understand|apply|analyze|evaluate|create"]
Objective text here
[/objective]

[activity title="Name" grouping="individual|pairs|small_group|whole_class" duration="minutes"]
Description of the activity
  [step]Step instruction[/step]
  [step]Another step[/step]
  [note]Teacher note[/note]
  [check]Check for understanding question[/check]
[/activity]

[materials]
  [item]Item name[/item]
  [item]Another item[/item]
[/materials]

[discussion prompt="Main question" format="think_pair_share|whole_class|small_group|socratic"]
  [question]Follow-up question[/question]
[/discussion]

[assessment title="Name" type="formative|summative"]
  [question type="multiple_choice|short_answer|true_false"]Question text[/question]
[/assessment]

[notes visibility="teacher_only|visible"]
Teacher notes here
[/notes]

[/lesson]

Create a complete lesson about: [DESCRIBE YOUR LESSON HERE]`;

const preview = useDebounceFn(async () => {
    if (!shortcode.value.trim()) {
        previewData.value = null;
        return;
    }

    try {
        const response = await axios.post('/lesson-plans/import/preview', {
            shortcode: shortcode.value,
        });
        
        if (response.data.success) {
            previewData.value = response.data.data;
            error.value = '';
        } else {
            error.value = response.data.error;
            previewData.value = null;
        }
    } catch (e) {
        error.value = e.response?.data?.error || 'Parse error';
        previewData.value = null;
    }
}, 500);

3. Template management controller:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPlanTemplateController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\LessonPlanTemplate;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class LessonPlanTemplateController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $category = $request->input('category');
        $tab = $request->input('tab', 'all');

        $query = LessonPlanTemplate::query();

        // Filter by tab
        if ($tab === 'mine') {
            $query->where('created_by', auth()->id());
        } elseif ($tab === 'school') {
            $query->where('school_id', auth()->user()->current_school_id)
                  ->where('is_public', true);
        } else {
            // All = system + public school templates + own templates
            $query->where(function ($q) {
                $q->where('is_system', true)
                  ->orWhere('created_by', auth()->id())
                  ->orWhere(function ($q2) {
                      $q2->where('school_id', auth()->user()->current_school_id)
                         ->where('is_public', true);
                  });
            });
        }

        if ($category && $category !== 'all') {
            $query->where('category', $category);
        }

        $templates = $query->orderByDesc('is_featured')
            ->orderByDesc('uses_count')
            ->get();

        $categories = [
            ['value' => 'all', 'label' => 'All Categories'],
            ['value' => 'instruction', 'label' => 'Instruction'],
            ['value' => 'discussion', 'label' => 'Discussion'],
            ['value' => 'project', 'label' => 'Project-Based'],
            ['value' => 'assessment', 'label' => 'Assessment'],
            ['value' => 'other', 'label' => 'Other'],
        ];

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Templates', [
            'templates' => $templates,
            'categories' => $categories,
            'currentCategory' => $category ?? 'all',
            'currentTab' => $tab,
        ]);
    }

    public function create()
    {
        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/TemplateBuilder', [
            'template' => null,
            'categories' => [
                ['value' => 'instruction', 'label' => 'Instruction'],
                ['value' => 'discussion', 'label' => 'Discussion'],
                ['value' => 'project', 'label' => 'Project-Based'],
                ['value' => 'assessment', 'label' => 'Assessment'],
                ['value' => 'other', 'label' => 'Other'],
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
            'category' => 'required|string',
            'is_public' => 'boolean',
            'blocks' => 'array',
        ]);

        $template = LessonPlanTemplate::create([
            'name' => $validated['name'],
            'slug' => Str::slug($validated['name']) . '-' . Str::random(6),
            'description' => $validated['description'] ?? '',
            'category' => $validated['category'],
            'is_public' => $validated['is_public'] ?? false,
            'is_system' => false,
            'is_featured' => false,
            'created_by' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
            'structure' => ['blocks' => $validated['blocks'] ?? []],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plan-templates.edit', $template)
            ->with('success', 'Template created');
    }

    public function edit(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        // Only creator can edit non-system templates
        if (!$template->is_system && $template->created_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/TemplateBuilder', [
            'template' => $template,
            'categories' => [
                ['value' => 'instruction', 'label' => 'Instruction'],
                ['value' => 'discussion', 'label' => 'Discussion'],
                ['value' => 'project', 'label' => 'Project-Based'],
                ['value' => 'assessment', 'label' => 'Assessment'],
                ['value' => 'other', 'label' => 'Other'],
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        if (!$template->is_system && $template->created_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
            'category' => 'required|string',
            'is_public' => 'boolean',
            'blocks' => 'array',
        ]);

        $template->update([
            'name' => $validated['name'],
            'description' => $validated['description'] ?? '',
            'category' => $validated['category'],
            'is_public' => $validated['is_public'] ?? false,
            'structure' => ['blocks' => $validated['blocks'] ?? []],
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Template saved');
    }

    public function destroy(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        if ($template->is_system || $template->created_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $template->delete();

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plan-templates.index')
            ->with('success', 'Template deleted');
    }

    public function use(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        $template->increment('uses_count');

        $lessonPlan = LessonPlan::create([
            'title' => 'Untitled - ' . $template->name,
            'description' => '',
            'subject' => '',
            'grade_level' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
        ]);

        $structure = $template->structure;
        $blockOrder = 0;

        foreach ($structure['blocks'] ?? [] as $blockData) {
            $block = $lessonPlan->blocks()->create([
                'type' => $blockData['type'],
                'content' => $blockData['content'] ?? [],
                'order' => $blockOrder++,
                'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
            ]);

            foreach ($blockData['sub_blocks'] ?? [] as $subBlockData) {
                $block->subBlocks()->create([
                    'title' => $subBlockData['title'] ?? '',
                    'content' => $subBlockData['content'] ?? '',
                    'type' => $subBlockData['type'] ?? 'step',
                    'order' => $subBlockData['order'] ?? 0,
                    'duration_minutes' => $subBlockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                ]);
            }
        }

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.edit', $lessonPlan)
            ->with('success', 'Lesson plan created from template');
    }

    public function saveAsTemplate(LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        if ($lessonPlan->user_id !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $lessonPlan->load('blocks.subBlocks');

        $blocks = $lessonPlan->blocks->map(function ($block) {
            return [
                'type' => $block->type,
                'content' => $block->content,
                'duration_minutes' => $block->duration_minutes,
                'sub_blocks' => $block->subBlocks->map(function ($sub) {
                    return [
                        'title' => $sub->title,
                        'content' => $sub->content,
                        'type' => $sub->type,
                        'order' => $sub->order,
                        'duration_minutes' => $sub->duration_minutes,
                    ];
                })->toArray(),
            ];
        })->toArray();

        $template = LessonPlanTemplate::create([
            'name' => $lessonPlan->title . ' Template',
            'slug' => Str::slug($lessonPlan->title) . '-' . Str::random(6),
            'description' => $lessonPlan->description ?? '',
            'category' => 'other',
            'is_public' => false,
            'is_system' => false,
            'is_featured' => false,
            'created_by' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
            'structure' => ['blocks' => $blocks],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plan-templates.edit', $template)
            ->with('success', 'Saved as template');
    }
}

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { Link, router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    templates: Array,
    categories: Array,
    currentCategory: String,
    currentTab: String,
});

const page = usePage();
const previewTemplate = ref(null);
const loading = ref(false);

const tabs = [
    { value: 'all', label: 'All Templates' },
    { value: 'mine', label: 'My Templates' },
    { value: 'school', label: 'School Templates' },
];

const switchTab = (tab) => {
    router.get(route('lesson-plan-templates.index'), {
        tab,
        category: props.currentCategory,
    }, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
    });
};

const filterCategory = (category) => {
    router.get(route('lesson-plan-templates.index'), {
        tab: props.currentTab,
        category,
    }, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
    });
};

const openPreview = (template) => {
    previewTemplate.value = template;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
};

const closePreview = () => {
    previewTemplate.value = null;
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
};

const useTemplate = () => {
    loading.value = true;
    router.post(route('lesson-plan-templates.use', previewTemplate.value.id), {}, {
        onFinish: () => loading.value = false,
    });
};

const canEdit = (template) => {
    return !template.is_system && template.created_by === page.props.auth?.user?.id;
};

const canDelete = (template) => {
    return !template.is_system && template.created_by === page.props.auth?.user?.id;
};

const editTemplate = () => {
    router.get(route('lesson-plan-templates.edit', previewTemplate.value.id));
};

const deleteTemplate = () => {
    if (confirm(`Delete "${previewTemplate.value.name}"?`)) {
        router.delete(route('lesson-plan-templates.destroy', previewTemplate.value.id));
        closePreview();
    }
};

const getCategoryIcon = (category) => {
    const icons = {
        instruction: '📚',
        discussion: '💬',
        project: '🚀',
        assessment: '📝',
        other: '📋',
    };
    return icons[category] || '📋';
};

const getBlockIcon = (type) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: '🎯',
        activity: '⚡',
        assessment: '📝',
        materials: '📦',
        media: '🎬',
        discussion: '💬',
        differentiation: '🔀',
        notes: '📌',
    };
    return icons[type] || '📋';
};
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import draggable from 'vuedraggable';
import TemplateBlock from '@/Components/LessonPlanBuilder/TemplateBlock.vue';

const props = defineProps({
    template: Object,
    categories: Array,
});

let uidCounter = Date.now();
const saving = ref(false);
const saveStatus = ref('');

const blockTypes = [
    { type: 'objective', label: 'Objective', icon: '🎯' },
    { type: 'activity', label: 'Activity', icon: '⚡' },
    { type: 'assessment', label: 'Assessment', icon: '📝' },
    { type: 'materials', label: 'Materials', icon: '📦' },
    { type: 'media', label: 'Media', icon: '🎬' },
    { type: 'discussion', label: 'Discussion', icon: '💬' },
    { type: 'differentiation', label: 'Differentiation', icon: '🔀' },
    { type: 'notes', label: 'Notes', icon: '📌' },
];

const form = ref({
    name: props.template?.name ?? '',
    description: props.template?.description ?? '',
    category: props.template?.category ?? 'other',
    is_public: props.template?.is_public ?? false,
    blocks: (props.template?.structure?.blocks ?? []).map(b => ({
        ...b,
        _uid: ++uidCounter,
        sub_blocks: (b.sub_blocks || []).map(sb => ({ ...sb, _uid: ++uidCounter })),
    })),
});

const saveStatusClass = computed(() => ({
    'text-green-600': saveStatus.value === 'Saved',
    'text-red-600': saveStatus.value === 'Error',
}));

const getDefaultContent = (type) => {
    const defaults = {
        objective: { text: '', bloom_level: 'understand' },
        activity: { title: '', instructions: '', grouping: 'whole_class' },
        assessment: { title: '', assessment_type: 'formative' },
        materials: { items: [] },
        media: { url: '', type: 'video', title: '' },
        discussion: { prompt: '', format: 'whole_class' },
        differentiation: { struggling: '', advanced: '', ell: '' },
        notes: { text: '', visibility: 'teacher_only' },
    };
    return defaults[type] || {};
};

const addBlock = (type) => {
    form.value.blocks.push({
        _uid: ++uidCounter,
        type,
        content: getDefaultContent(type),
        duration_minutes: null,
        sub_blocks: [],
    });
};

const updateBlock = (index, data) => {
    form.value.blocks[index] = { ...form.value.blocks[index], ...data };
};

const deleteBlock = (index) => {
    form.value.blocks.splice(index, 1);
    reorderBlocks();
};

const moveBlock = (index, direction) => {
    const newIndex = index + direction;
    if (newIndex < 0 || newIndex >= form.value.blocks.length) return;
    const blocks = [...form.value.blocks];
    [blocks[index], blocks[newIndex]] = [blocks[newIndex], blocks[index]];
    form.value.blocks = blocks;
    reorderBlocks();
};

const reorderBlocks = () => {
    form.value.blocks.forEach((b, i) => b.order = i);
};

const save = () => {
    saving.value = true;

    const data = {
        name: form.value.name,
        description: form.value.description,
        category: form.value.category,
        is_public: form.value.is_public,
        blocks: form.value.blocks.map(({ _uid, sub_blocks, ...block }) => ({
            ...block,
            sub_blocks: (sub_blocks || []).map(({ _uid: subUid, ...sb }) => sb),
        })),
    };

    if (props.template?.id) {
        router.put(route('lesson-plan-templates.update', props.template.id), data, {
            preserveScroll: true,
            onSuccess: () => {
                saveStatus.value = 'Saved';
                setTimeout(() => saveStatus.value = '', 2000);
            },
            onError: () => saveStatus.value = 'Error',
            onFinish: () => saving.value = false,
        });
    } else {
        router.post(route('lesson-plan-templates.store'), data, {
            onFinish: () => saving.value = false,
        });
    }
};
</script>
