<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    block: Object,
    canMoveUp: Boolean,
    canMoveDown: Boolean,
});

const emit = defineEmits(['update', 'delete', 'move-up', 'move-down']);

const expanded = ref(true);
let subUid = Date.now();

const colorClasses = {
    objective: 'bg-green-50',
    activity: 'bg-blue-50',
    assessment: 'bg-purple-50',
    materials: 'bg-orange-50',
    media: 'bg-pink-50',
    discussion: 'bg-cyan-50',
    differentiation: 'bg-yellow-50',
    notes: 'bg-gray-100',
};

const getBlockIcon = (type) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: '🎯',
        activity: '⚡',
        assessment: '📝',
        materials: '📦',
        media: '🎬',
        discussion: '💬',
        differentiation: '🔀',
        notes: '📌',
    };
    return icons[type] || '📋';
};

const updateContent = (key, value) => {
    emit('update', {
        content: { ...props.block.content, [key]: value },
    });
};

const addSubBlock = () => {
    const subBlocks = [...(props.block.sub_blocks || [])];
    subBlocks.push({
        _uid: ++subUid,
        title: '',
        content: '',
        type: 'step',
        order: subBlocks.length,
    });
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: subBlocks });
};

const updateSubBlock = (index, key, value) => {
    const subBlocks = [...props.block.sub_blocks];
    subBlocks[index] = { ...subBlocks[index], [key]: value };
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: subBlocks });
};

const deleteSubBlock = (index) => {
    const subBlocks = props.block.sub_blocks.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
    emit('update', { sub_blocks: subBlocks });
};
</script>

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPlanTemplateController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\LessonPlanTemplate;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class LessonPlanTemplateController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $category = $request->input('category');
        $tab = $request->input('tab', 'all');

        $query = LessonPlanTemplate::query();

        // Filter by tab
        if ($tab === 'mine') {
            $query->where('created_by', auth()->id());
        } elseif ($tab === 'school') {
            $query->where('school_id', auth()->user()->current_school_id)
                  ->where('is_public', true);
        } else {
            // All = system + public school templates + own templates
            $query->where(function ($q) {
                $q->where('is_system', true)
                  ->orWhere('created_by', auth()->id())
                  ->orWhere(function ($q2) {
                      $q2->where('school_id', auth()->user()->current_school_id)
                         ->where('is_public', true);
                  });
            });
        }

        if ($category && $category !== 'all') {
            $query->where('category', $category);
        }

        $templates = $query->orderByDesc('is_featured')
            ->orderByDesc('uses_count')
            ->get();

        $categories = [
            ['value' => 'all', 'label' => 'All Categories'],
            ['value' => 'instruction', 'label' => 'Instruction'],
            ['value' => 'discussion', 'label' => 'Discussion'],
            ['value' => 'project', 'label' => 'Project-Based'],
            ['value' => 'assessment', 'label' => 'Assessment'],
            ['value' => 'other', 'label' => 'Other'],
        ];

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/Templates', [
            'templates' => $templates,
            'categories' => $categories,
            'currentCategory' => $category ?? 'all',
            'currentTab' => $tab,
        ]);
    }

    public function create()
    {
        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/TemplateBuilder', [
            'template' => null,
            'categories' => [
                ['value' => 'instruction', 'label' => 'Instruction'],
                ['value' => 'discussion', 'label' => 'Discussion'],
                ['value' => 'project', 'label' => 'Project-Based'],
                ['value' => 'assessment', 'label' => 'Assessment'],
                ['value' => 'other', 'label' => 'Other'],
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
            'category' => 'required|string',
            'is_public' => 'boolean',
            'blocks' => 'array',
        ]);

        $template = LessonPlanTemplate::create([
            'name' => $validated['name'],
            'slug' => Str::slug($validated['name']) . '-' . Str::random(6),
            'description' => $validated['description'] ?? '',
            'category' => $validated['category'],
            'is_public' => $validated['is_public'] ?? false,
            'is_system' => false,
            'is_featured' => false,
            'created_by' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
            'structure' => ['blocks' => $validated['blocks'] ?? []],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plan-templates.edit', $template)
            ->with('success', 'Template created');
    }

    public function edit(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        // Only creator can edit non-system templates
        if (!$template->is_system && $template->created_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        return Inertia::render('LessonPlans/TemplateBuilder', [
            'template' => $template,
            'categories' => [
                ['value' => 'instruction', 'label' => 'Instruction'],
                ['value' => 'discussion', 'label' => 'Discussion'],
                ['value' => 'project', 'label' => 'Project-Based'],
                ['value' => 'assessment', 'label' => 'Assessment'],
                ['value' => 'other', 'label' => 'Other'],
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        if (!$template->is_system && $template->created_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
            'category' => 'required|string',
            'is_public' => 'boolean',
            'blocks' => 'array',
        ]);

        $template->update([
            'name' => $validated['name'],
            'description' => $validated['description'] ?? '',
            'category' => $validated['category'],
            'is_public' => $validated['is_public'] ?? false,
            'structure' => ['blocks' => $validated['blocks'] ?? []],
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Template saved');
    }

    public function destroy(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        if ($template->is_system || $template->created_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $template->delete();

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plan-templates.index')
            ->with('success', 'Template deleted');
    }

    public function preview(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        return response()->json($template);
    }

    public function use(LessonPlanTemplate $template)
    {
        $template->increment('uses_count');

        $lessonPlan = LessonPlan::create([
            'title' => 'Untitled - ' . $template->name,
            'description' => '',
            'subject' => '',
            'grade_level' => '',
            'status' => 'draft',
            'user_id' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
        ]);

        $structure = $template->structure;
        $blockOrder = 0;

        foreach ($structure['blocks'] ?? [] as $blockData) {
            $block = $lessonPlan->blocks()->create([
                'type' => $blockData['type'],
                'content' => $blockData['content'] ?? [],
                'order' => $blockOrder++,
                'duration_minutes' => $blockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
            ]);

            foreach ($blockData['sub_blocks'] ?? [] as $subBlockData) {
                $block->subBlocks()->create([
                    'title' => $subBlockData['title'] ?? '',
                    'content' => $subBlockData['content'] ?? '',
                    'type' => $subBlockData['type'] ?? 'step',
                    'order' => $subBlockData['order'] ?? 0,
                    'duration_minutes' => $subBlockData['duration_minutes'] ?? null,
                ]);
            }
        }

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plans.edit', $lessonPlan)
            ->with('success', 'Lesson plan created from template');
    }

    public function saveAsTemplate(LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        if ($lessonPlan->user_id !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $lessonPlan->load('blocks.subBlocks');

        $blocks = $lessonPlan->blocks->map(function ($block) {
            return [
                'type' => $block->type,
                'content' => $block->content,
                'duration_minutes' => $block->duration_minutes,
                'sub_blocks' => $block->subBlocks->map(function ($sub) {
                    return [
                        'title' => $sub->title,
                        'content' => $sub->content,
                        'type' => $sub->type,
                        'order' => $sub->order,
                        'duration_minutes' => $sub->duration_minutes,
                    ];
                })->toArray(),
            ];
        })->toArray();

        $template = LessonPlanTemplate::create([
            'name' => $lessonPlan->title . ' Template',
            'slug' => Str::slug($lessonPlan->title) . '-' . Str::random(6),
            'description' => $lessonPlan->description ?? '',
            'category' => 'other',
            'is_public' => false,
            'is_system' => false,
            'is_featured' => false,
            'created_by' => auth()->id(),
            'school_id' => auth()->user()->current_school_id,
            'structure' => ['blocks' => $blocks],
        ]);

        return redirect()->route('lesson-plan-templates.edit', $template)
            ->with('success', 'Saved as template');
    }
}

import { ref, onUnmounted } from 'vue';
import { Link, router, usePage } from '@inertiajs/vue3';

const props = defineProps({
    templates: Array,
    categories: Array,
    currentCategory: String,
    currentTab: String,
});

const page = usePage();
const previewTemplate = ref(null);
const loading = ref(false);

const tabs = [
    { value: 'all', label: 'All Templates' },
    { value: 'mine', label: 'My Templates' },
    { value: 'school', label: 'School Templates' },
];

const switchTab = (tab) => {
    router.get(route('lesson-plan-templates.index'), {
        tab,
        category: props.currentCategory,
    }, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
    });
};

const filterCategory = (category) => {
    router.get(route('lesson-plan-templates.index'), {
        tab: props.currentTab,
        category,
    }, {
        preserveState: true,
        preserveScroll: true,
    });
};

const openPreview = (template) => {
    previewTemplate.value = template;
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
};

const closePreview = () => {
    previewTemplate.value = null;
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
};

// Cleanup on unmount
onUnmounted(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
});

const useTemplate = () => {
    loading.value = true;
    router.post(route('lesson-plan-templates.use', previewTemplate.value.id), {}, {
        onFinish: () => loading.value = false,
    });
};

const canEdit = (template) => {
    return !template.is_system && template.created_by === page.props.auth?.user?.id;
};

const canDelete = (template) => {
    return !template.is_system && template.created_by === page.props.auth?.user?.id;
};

const editTemplate = () => {
    router.get(route('lesson-plan-templates.edit', previewTemplate.value.id));
};

const deleteTemplate = () => {
    if (confirm(`Delete "${previewTemplate.value.name}"?`)) {
        router.delete(route('lesson-plan-templates.destroy', previewTemplate.value.id));
        closePreview();
    }
};

const getCategoryIcon = (category) => {
    const icons = {
        instruction: '📚',
        discussion: '💬',
        project: '🚀',
        assessment: '📝',
        other: '📋',

    return icons[category] || '📋';
};

const getBlockIcon = (type) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: '🎯',

        assessment: '📝',
        materials: '📦',
        media: '🎬',
        discussion: '💬',
        differentiation: '🔀',
        notes: '📌',
    };
    return icons[type] || '📋';
};

<?php
// app/Models/LessonPresentation.php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

class LessonPresentation extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = [
        'classroom_id',
        'lesson_plan_id',
        'started_by',
        'current_block_index',
        'current_sub_block_index',
        'status',
        'started_at',
        'ended_at',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'current_block_index' => 'integer',
        'current_sub_block_index' => 'integer',
        'started_at' => 'datetime',
        'ended_at' => 'datetime',
    ];

    public function classroom(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Classroom::class);
    }

    public function lessonPlan(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(LessonPlan::class);
    }

    public function teacher(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'started_by');
    }

    public function getCurrentBlock()
    {
        return $this->lessonPlan->blocks()
            ->where('order', $this->current_block_index)
            ->with('subBlocks')
            ->first();
    }

    public function getCurrentSubBlock()
    {
        if ($this->current_sub_block_index === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $block = $this->getCurrentBlock();
        return $block?->subBlocks()
            ->where('order', $this->current_sub_block_index)
            ->first();
    }
}

4. Broadcasting Event:

<?php
// app/Events/LessonPresentationUpdated.php

namespace App\Events;

use App\Models\LessonPresentation;
use Illuminate\Broadcasting\Channel;
use Illuminate\Broadcasting\InteractsWithSockets;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Broadcasting\ShouldBroadcast;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Events\Dispatchable;
use Illuminate\Queue\SerializesModels;

class LessonPresentationUpdated implements ShouldBroadcast
{
    use Dispatchable, InteractsWithSockets, SerializesModels;

    public function __construct(
        public LessonPresentation $presentation,
        public array $currentBlock,
        public ?array $currentSubBlock
    ) {}

    public function broadcastOn(): Channel
    {
        return new Channel('classroom.' . $this->presentation->classroom_id);
    }

    public function broadcastAs(): string
    {
        return 'lesson.updated';
    }

    public function broadcastWith(): array
    {
        return [
            'presentation_id' => $this->presentation->id,
            'status' => $this->presentation->status,
            'current_block_index' => $this->presentation->current_block_index,
            'current_sub_block_index' => $this->presentation->current_sub_block_index,
            'current_block' => $this->currentBlock,
            'current_sub_block' => $this->currentSubBlock,
        ];
    }
}

5. Controller:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPresentationController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Classroom;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use App\Models\LessonPresentation;
use App\Events\LessonPresentationUpdated;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class LessonPresentationController extends Controller
{
    public function start(Request $request, Classroom $classroom)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'lesson_plan_id' => 'required|exists:lesson_plans,id',
        ]);

        // End any active presentation
        $classroom->presentations()
            ->where('status', 'active')
            ->update(['status' => 'completed', 'ended_at' => now()]);

        $lessonPlan = LessonPlan::with('blocks.subBlocks')->findOrFail($request->lesson_plan_id);

        $presentation = LessonPresentation::create([
            'classroom_id' => $classroom->id,
            'lesson_plan_id' => $lessonPlan->id,
            'started_by' => auth()->id(),
            'current_block_index' => 0,
            'current_sub_block_index' => null,
            'status' => 'active',
            'started_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $this->broadcastState($presentation);

        return redirect()->route('lesson-presentation.teach', $presentation);
    }

    public function teach(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        $this->authorize('teach', $presentation);

        $presentation->load(['lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks', 'classroom']);

        return Inertia::render('LessonPresentation/Teach', [
            'presentation' => $presentation,
            'lessonPlan' => $presentation->lessonPlan,
            'classroom' => $presentation->classroom,
        ]);
    }

    public function student(Classroom $classroom)
    {
        $presentation = $classroom->activePresentation;

        if (!$presentation) {
            return Inertia::render('LessonPresentation/Waiting', [
                'classroom' => $classroom,
            ]);
        }

        $presentation->load(['lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks']);

        return Inertia::render('LessonPresentation/Student', [
            'presentation' => $presentation,
            'lessonPlan' => $presentation->lessonPlan,
            'classroom' => $classroom,
        ]);
    }

    public function navigate(Request $request, LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        $this->authorize('teach', $presentation);

        $request->validate([
            'block_index' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'sub_block_index' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
        ]);

        $presentation->update([
            'current_block_index' => $request->block_index,
            'current_sub_block_index' => $request->sub_block_index,
        ]);

        $this->broadcastState($presentation);

        return response()->json(['success' => true]);
    }

    public function next(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        $this->authorize('teach', $presentation);

        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        $blocks = $presentation->lessonPlan->blocks;
        $currentBlock = $blocks->where('order', $presentation->current_block_index)->first();

        if (!$currentBlock) {
            return response()->json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'No current block']);
        }

        $subBlocks = $currentBlock->subBlocks;
        $currentSubIndex = $presentation->current_sub_block_index;

        // If we have sub-blocks and haven't gone through them all
        if ($subBlocks->count() > 0) {
            if ($currentSubIndex === null) {
                // Start sub-blocks
                $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => 0]);
            } elseif ($currentSubIndex < $subBlocks->count() - 1) {
                // Next sub-block
                $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => $currentSubIndex + 1]);
            } else {
                // Move to next block
                $this->moveToNextBlock($presentation, $blocks);
            }
        } else {
            // No sub-blocks, move to next block
            $this->moveToNextBlock($presentation, $blocks);
        }

        $this->broadcastState($presentation->fresh());

        return response()->json(['success' => true]);
    }

    public function previous(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        $this->authorize('teach', $presentation);

        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        $blocks = $presentation->lessonPlan->blocks;
        $currentSubIndex = $presentation->current_sub_block_index;

        if ($currentSubIndex !== null && $currentSubIndex > 0) {
            // Previous sub-block
            $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => $currentSubIndex - 1]);
        } elseif ($currentSubIndex === 0) {
            // Back to block overview
            $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => null]);
        } elseif ($presentation->current_block_index > 0) {
            // Previous block
            $prevBlockIndex = $presentation->current_block_index - 1;
            $prevBlock = $blocks->where('order', $prevBlockIndex)->first();
            $lastSubIndex = $prevBlock?->subBlocks->count() > 0
                ? $prevBlock->subBlocks->count() - 1
                : null;

            $presentation->update([
                'current_block_index' => $prevBlockIndex,
                'current_sub_block_index' => $lastSubIndex,
            ]);
        }

        $this->broadcastState($presentation->fresh());

        return response()->json(['success' => true]);
    }

    public function pause(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        $this->authorize('teach', $presentation);

        $presentation->update(['status' => 'paused']);
        $this->broadcastState($presentation);

        return response()->json(['success' => true]);
    }

    public function resume(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        $this->authorize('teach', $presentation);

        $presentation->update(['status' => 'active']);
        $this->broadcastState($presentation);

        return response()->json(['success' => true]);
    }

    public function end(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        $this->authorize('teach', $presentation);

        $presentation->update([
            'status' => 'completed',
            'ended_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $this->broadcastState($presentation);

        return redirect()->route('classrooms.show', $presentation->classroom_id)
            ->with('success', 'Lesson completed');
    }

    public function state(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        $currentBlock = $presentation->getCurrentBlock();
        $currentSubBlock = $presentation->getCurrentSubBlock();

        return response()->json([
            'presentation_id' => $presentation->id,
            'status' => $presentation->status,
            'current_block_index' => $presentation->current_block_index,
            'current_sub_block_index' => $presentation->current_sub_block_index,
            'current_block' => $currentBlock?->toArray(),
            'current_sub_block' => $currentSubBlock?->toArray(),
        ]);
    }

    private function moveToNextBlock(LessonPresentation $presentation, $blocks)
    {
        $nextBlockIndex = $presentation->current_block_index + 1;

        if ($nextBlockIndex < $blocks->count()) {
            $presentation->update([
                'current_block_index' => $nextBlockIndex,
                'current_sub_block_index' => null,
            ]);
        } else {
            // End of lesson
            $presentation->update([
                'status' => 'completed',
                'ended_at' => now(),
            ]);
        }
    }

    private function broadcastState(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        $currentBlock = $presentation->getCurrentBlock();
        $currentSubBlock = $presentation->getCurrentSubBlock();

        broadcast(new LessonPresentationUpdated(
            $presentation,
            $currentBlock?->toArray() ?? [],
            $currentSubBlock?->toArray()
        ));
    }
}

6. Policy:

<?php
// app/Policies/LessonPresentationPolicy.php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\LessonPresentation;
use App\Models\User;

class LessonPresentationPolicy
{
    public function teach(User $user, LessonPresentation $presentation): bool
    {
        return $user->id === $presentation->started_by;
    }

    public function view(User $user, LessonPresentation $presentation): bool
    {
        // Teacher or student in classroom
        return $user->id === $presentation->started_by ||
               $presentation->classroom->students->contains($user->id);
    }
}

                    >

                    </button>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed } from 'vue';
import { router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';

const props = defineProps({
    presentation: Object,
    lessonPlan: Object,
    classroom: Object,
});

const currentBlockIndex = ref(props.presentation.current_block_index);
const currentSubBlockIndex = ref(props.presentation.current_sub_block_index);
const status = ref(props.presentation.status);

const blocks = computed(() => props.lessonPlan.blocks || []);

const currentBlock = computed(() => blocks.value[currentBlockIndex.value]);

const currentSubBlock = computed(() => {
    if (currentSubBlockIndex.value === null || !currentBlock.value?.sub_blocks) {
        return null;
    }
    return currentBlock.value.sub_blocks[currentSubBlockIndex.value];
});

const isFirst = computed(() => {
    return currentBlockIndex.value === 0 && currentSubBlockIndex.value === null;
});

const isCompleted = computed(() => {
    return status.value === 'completed';
});

const goToBlock = async (index) => {
    await axios.post(`/presentation/${props.presentation.id}/navigate`, {
        block_index: index,
        sub_block_index: null,
    });
    currentBlockIndex.value = index;
    currentSubBlockIndex.value = null;
};

const next = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post(`/presentation/${props.presentation.id}/next`);
    if (response.data.success) {
        // Refresh state
        const state = await axios.get(`/presentation/${props.presentation.id}/state`);
        currentBlockIndex.value = state.data.current_block_index;
        currentSubBlockIndex.value = state.data.current_sub_block_index;
        status.value = state.data.status;
    }
};

const previous = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post(`/presentation/${props.presentation.id}/previous`);
    if (response.data.success) {
        const state = await axios.get(`/presentation/${props.presentation.id}/state`);
        currentBlockIndex.value = state.data.current_block_index;
        currentSubBlockIndex.value = state.data.current_sub_block_index;
    }
};

const pause = async () => {
    await axios.post(`/presentation/${props.presentation.id}/pause`);
    status.value = 'paused';
};

const resume = async () => {
    await axios.post(`/presentation/${props.presentation.id}/resume`);
    status.value = 'active';
};

const endLesson = () => {
    if (confirm('End this lesson?')) {
        router.post(`/presentation/${props.presentation.id}/end`);
    }
};

const getBlockIcon = (type) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: '🎯',
        activity: '⚡',
        assessment: '📝',
        materials: '📦',
        media: '🎬',
        discussion: '💬',
        differentiation: '🔀',
        notes: '📌',
    };
    return icons[type] || '📋';
};
</script>

                                <div
                                    class="h-full bg-blue-500 transition-all"
                                    :style="{ width: progressPercent + '%' }"
                                />
                            </div>
                            <span class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                                {{ currentBlockIndex + 1 }}/{{ blocks.length }}
                            </span>
                        </div>

</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, onUnmounted } from 'vue';

const props = defineProps({
    presentation: Object,
    lessonPlan: Object,
    classroom: Object,
});

const currentBlockIndex = ref(props.presentation.current_block_index);
const currentSubBlockIndex = ref(props.presentation.current_sub_block_index);
const status = ref(props.presentation.status);

const blocks = computed(() => props.lessonPlan.blocks || []);
const currentBlock = computed(() => blocks.value[currentBlockIndex.value]);
const currentSubBlock = computed(() => {
    if (currentSubBlockIndex.value === null || !currentBlock.value?.sub_blocks) {
        return null;
    }
    return currentBlock.value.sub_blocks[currentSubBlockIndex.value];
});

const progressPercent = computed(() => {
    if (blocks.value.length === 0) return 0;
    return ((currentBlockIndex.value + 1) / blocks.value.length) * 100;
});

const blockColorClass = computed(() => {
    const colors = {
        objective: 'bg-green-500',
        activity: 'bg-blue-500',
        assessment: 'bg-purple-500',
        materials: 'bg-orange-500',
        media: 'bg-pink-500',
        discussion: 'bg-cyan-500',
        differentiation: 'bg-yellow-500',
        notes: 'bg-gray-500',
    };
    return colors[currentBlock.value?.type] || 'bg-gray-500';
});

const getBlockIcon = (type) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: '🎯',
        activity: '⚡',
        assessment: '📝',
        materials: '📦',
        media: '🎬',
        discussion: '💬',
        differentiation: '🔀',
        notes: '📌',
    };
    return icons[type] || '📋';
};

// Listen for real-time updates
let channel;

onMounted(() => {
    // Using Laravel Echo
    if (window.Echo) {
        channel = window.Echo.channel(`classroom.${props.classroom.id}`)
            .listen('.lesson.updated', (data) => {
                currentBlockIndex.value = data.current_block_index;
                currentSubBlockIndex.value = data.current_sub_block_index;
                status.value = data.status;
            });
    } else {
        // Fallback: Poll for updates
        const poll = setInterval(async () => {
            try {
                const response = await fetch(`/presentation/${props.presentation.id}/state`);
                const data = await response.json();
                currentBlockIndex.value = data.current_block_index;
                currentSubBlockIndex.value = data.current_sub_block_index;
                status.value = data.status;
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Failed to fetch state:', e);
            }
        }, 2000);

        onUnmounted(() => clearInterval(poll));
    }
});

onUnmounted(() => {
    if (channel) {
        channel.stopListening('.lesson.updated');
    }
});
</script>

3. Controller for managing classroom lesson plans:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/ClassroomLessonPlanController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Classroom;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ClassroomLessonPlanController extends Controller
{
    public function search(Request $request)
    {
        $query = $request->input('q');
        $excludeClassroom = $request->input('exclude_classroom');

        $lessonPlans = LessonPlan::where('school_id', auth()->user()->current_school_id)
            ->where('status', 'published')
            ->where(function ($q) use ($query) {
                $q->where('title', 'like', "%{$query}%")
                  ->orWhere('subject', 'like', "%{$query}%")
                  ->orWhere('grade_level', 'like', "%{$query}%");
            })
            ->when($excludeClassroom, function ($q) use ($excludeClassroom) {
                $q->whereDoesntHave('classrooms', function ($q2) use ($excludeClassroom) {
                    $q2->where('classroom_id', $excludeClassroom);
                });
            })
            ->limit(10)
            ->get(['id', 'title', 'subject', 'grade_level']);

        return response()->json($lessonPlans);
    }

    public function assign(Request $request, Classroom $classroom)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'lesson_plan_id' => 'required|exists:lesson_plans,id',
        ]);

        $maxOrder = $classroom->lessonPlans()->max('order') ?? -1;

        $classroom->lessonPlans()->syncWithoutDetaching([
            $request->lesson_plan_id => ['order' => $maxOrder + 1]
        ]);

        return back()->with('success', 'Lesson plan assigned');
    }

    public function remove(Classroom $classroom, LessonPlan $lessonPlan)
    {
        $classroom->lessonPlans()->detach($lessonPlan->id);

        return back()->with('success', 'Lesson plan removed');
    }

    public function reorder(Request $request, Classroom $classroom)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'lesson_plan_ids' => 'required|array',
            'lesson_plan_ids.*' => 'exists:lesson_plans,id',
        ]);

        foreach ($request->lesson_plan_ids as $index => $id) {
            $classroom->lessonPlans()->updateExistingPivot($id, ['order' => $index]);
        }

        return response()->json(['success' => true]);
    }
}

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { Link, router } from '@inertiajs/vue3';
import axios from 'axios';
import { useDebounceFn } from '@vueuse/core';

const props = defineProps({
    classroomId: Number,
    lessonPlans: Array,
    activePresentation: Object,
});

const showSearch = ref(false);
const searchQuery = ref('');
const searchResults = ref([]);
const searching = ref(false);

const search = useDebounceFn(async () => {
    if (searchQuery.value.length < 2) {
        searchResults.value = [];
        return;
    }

    searching.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(route('lesson-plans.search'), {
            params: {
                q: searchQuery.value,
                exclude_classroom: props.classroomId,
            },
        });
        searchResults.value = response.data;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error('Search failed:', e);
    } finally {
        searching.value = false;
    }
}, 300);

const assign = (plan) => {
    router.post(route('classrooms.lesson-plans.assign', props.classroomId), {
        lesson_plan_id: plan.id,
    }, {
        preserveScroll: true,
        onSuccess: () => {
            searchQuery.value = '';
            searchResults.value = [];
            showSearch.value = false;
        },
    });
};

const remove = (plan) => {
    if (confirm(`Remove "${plan.title}" from this classroom?`)) {
        router.delete(route('classrooms.lesson-plans.remove', [props.classroomId, plan.id]), {
            preserveScroll: true,
        });
    }
};

const startPresentation = (plan) => {
    router.post(route('lesson-presentation.start', props.classroomId), {
        lesson_plan_id: plan.id,
    });
};
</script>

// ClassroomLessonPlanController.php
public function search(Request $request)
{
    $query = $request->input('q');
    $schoolId = auth()->user()->current_school_id;

    $lessonPlans = LessonPlan::where('status', 'published')
        ->whereHas('user', function ($q) use ($schoolId) {
            $q->where('current_school_id', $schoolId);
        })
        ->where(function ($q) use ($query) {
            $q->where('title', 'like', "%{$query}%")
              ->orWhere('subject', 'like', "%{$query}%")
              ->orWhere('grade_level', 'like', "%{$query}%");
        })
        ->limit(10)
        ->get(['id', 'title', 'subject', 'grade_level']);

    return response()->json($lessonPlans);
}

/* --- imports --- */
import { Button, Dialog, ProgressSpinner, useToast } from "primevue";
import { computed, onMounted} from "vue";

import { router, usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import {
    useCalendarStore,
    useUpdateClassroomStore,
    useClassroomDetailsStore,
} from "@/Pinia/store";
import { useLiveKitClassroomStore, useRescheduleClassroomStore } from "../../Pinia/store";
import { now } from "../../state/clockState.js";
import { findClassrooms } from "../../utils/rescheduleFormFunctions";
import ClassroomSettings from "./ClassroomModal/ClassroomSettings.vue";
import ClassroomModalTabs from "./ClassroomModal/ClassroomModalTabs.vue";
import ClassroomResources from "./ClassroomModal/ClassroomResources.vue";
import ClassroomAttendance from "./ClassroomModal/ClassroomAttendance.vue";
import { provide } from "vue";
import UpdateClassroomForm from "./ClassroomModal/UpdateClassroomForm.vue";
import UpdateClassroomFollowingForm from "./ClassroomModal/UpdateClassroomFollowingForm.vue";
import UpdateClassroomRangeForm from "./ClassroomModal/UpdateClassroomRangeForm.vue";
import RescheduleClassrooms from "./ClassroomModal/RescheduleClassrooms.vue";
import RescheduleClassroomsUpdate from "./ClassroomModal/RescheduleClassroomsUpdate.vue";
import RescheduleClassroomsUndo from "./ClassroomModal/RescheduleClassroomsUndo.vue";
import { useSetClassroomProperties } from "../../utils/generalUtils.js";
import { nextMonday } from "date-fns";

/* --- page props / stores / state --- */
const { auth } = usePage().props;
const hasFullEditAccess = computed(() =>
    ["admin", "school"].includes(auth.user.active_system_role)
);
const toast = useToast();

const updateClassroomStore = useUpdateClassroomStore();
const classroomDetailsStore = useClassroomDetailsStore();
const calendarStore = useCalendarStore();
const rescheduleClassroomStore = useRescheduleClassroomStore();
const updateFormState = updateClassroomStore.state;
const classroomDetails = classroomDetailsStore.state;
const liveKitClassroomStore = useLiveKitClassroomStore();
const { setClassroomProperties } = useSetClassroomProperties();
const toastSuccess = (msg) => {
    toast.add({
        severity: "success",
        summary: "Success",
        detail: msg,
        life: 5000,
    });
};

const toastError = (err) => {
    toast.add({
        severity: "error",
        summary: "Error",
        detail: err?.message || err,
        life: 5000,
    });
};

let initialized = false;

const setDefaults = () => {
    const api = calendarStore.getApi();
    if (!api) throw new Error("Calendar API not found");
    const baseEvent = api.getEventById(classroomDetails.id);
    if (!baseEvent) return;
    setClassroomProperties(baseEvent);
};

provide("setDefaults", setDefaults);
onMounted(() => {
    initialized = true;

});

/* --- computed lists --- */

const rescheduledFromDate = computed(() => {
    return classroomDetails.rescheduled_from
        ? new Date(classroomDetails.rescheduled_from.start)
        : null;
});

const nativegateFromTo = () => {
    if (!classroomDetails.rescheduled_to) return;
    classroomDetailsStore.setData({ open: false });
    const waitForClose = setTimeout(() => {
        calendarStore.triggerEventClick(classroomDetails.rescheduled_to.id);
    }, 300);
    const clearWait = setTimeout(() => {
        clearTimeout(waitForClose);
        clearTimeout(clearWait);
    }, 500);
};
const nativegateToFrom = () => {
    if (!classroomDetails.rescheduled_from) return;

    classroomDetailsStore.setData({ open: false });
    const waitForClose = setTimeout(() => {
        calendarStore.triggerEventClick(classroomDetails.rescheduled_from.id);
    }, 300);
    const clearWait = setTimeout(() => {
        clearTimeout(waitForClose);
        clearTimeout(clearWait);
    }, 500);
};

const onDialogHide = () => {
    updateClassroomStore.resetData();
    rescheduleClassroomStore.resetData();
};
/* --- modal close reset --- */
const onCloseClick = () => {
    classroomDetailsStore.resetData();
};

/* ================= Parent-managed reschedule/update/undo handling ================= */

const existingClassroomsRescheduleUpdate = computed(() => {
    if (
        (classroomDetails.view === "reschedule.update" ||
            classroomDetails.view === "reschedule.undo") &&
        classroomDetails.rescheduled_to
    ) {
        return findClassrooms({
            from: new Date(classroomDetails.start),
            groupId: classroomDetails.group_id,
            events: calendarStore.state.events,
            rescheduledFromOnly: true,
        });
    }
    return [];
});

const existingClassroomsReschedule = computed(() => {
    //this is the existing classrooms that are following start date not all classrooms
    if (classroomDetails.view !== "reschedule") {
        return [];
    }
    return findClassrooms({
        from: new Date(classroomDetails.start),
        groupId: classroomDetails.group_id,
        events: calendarStore.state.events,
        excludeRescheduledFrom: true,
        excludeRescheduledTo: true,
    });
});
const attendClass = () => {

         liveKitClassroomStore.setData({
        room_name: classroomDetails.id,
    });
    router.visit(route('livekit.test'));
   

    //todo: check if user is already in the classroom

    //todo: check if class has started

    //todo: check if user is a parent
    //todo: check if user is a guest
    //todo: check if user is a school admin
    //todo: check if user is a global admin
};
// clear generated/conflicts when key form fields change
</script>

import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { useClassroomDetailsStore } from "@/Pinia/store";
import { computed } from "vue";

const auth = usePage().props.auth;
const classroomDetailsStore = useClassroomDetailsStore();
const classroomDetails = classroomDetailsStore.state;

    ["admin", "school", "teacher"].includes(auth.user.active_system_role)
);

const activeTab = computed({
    get: () => {
        const view = classroomDetails.view;
        return view;
    },
    set: (tab: string) => {
        switch (tab) {
            case "settings":
                classroomDetailsStore.setData({ view: "settings" });
                break;
            case "resources":
                classroomDetailsStore.setData({ view: "resources" });
                break;
            case "lesson-plan":
                classroomDetailsStore.setData({ view: "lesson-plan" });
                break;
            default:
                classroomDetailsStore.setData({ view: "main" });
                break;
        }
    },
});

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch, onMounted } from "vue";
import { usePage, router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { Button, InputText, ProgressSpinner } from "primevue";
import { useClassroomDetailsStore } from "@/Pinia/store";
import axios from "axios";

const auth = usePage().props.auth;
const classroomDetailsStore = useClassroomDetailsStore();
const classroomDetails = classroomDetailsStore.state;

const loading = ref(false);
const lessonPlan = ref(null);
const activePresentation = ref(null);
const showSearch = ref(false);
const searchQuery = ref("");
const searchResults = ref([]);
const searching = ref(false);

const canEdit = computed(() =>
    ["admin", "school", "teacher"].includes(auth.user.active_system_role)
);

// Fetch lesson plan when tab opens or classroom changes
const fetchLessonPlan = async () => {
    if (!classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id) {
        lessonPlan.value = null;
        return;
    }

    loading.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(
            route("api.lesson-plans.show", classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id)
        );
        lessonPlan.value = response.data.lesson_plan;
        activePresentation.value = response.data.active_presentation;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch lesson plan:", e);
        lessonPlan.value = null;
    } finally {
        loading.value = false;
    }
};

// Watch for view changes to fetch data
watch(
    () => classroomDetails.view,
    (view) => {
        if (view === "lesson-plan") {
            fetchLessonPlan();
        }
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

// Watch for lesson_plan_id changes
watch(
    () => classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id,
    () => {
        if (classroomDetails.view === "lesson-plan") {
            fetchLessonPlan();
        }
    }
);

// Search
let searchTimeout: number | null = null;
const search = () => {
    if (searchTimeout) clearTimeout(searchTimeout);

    if (searchQuery.value.length < 2) {
        searchResults.value = [];
        return;
    }

    searching.value = true;
    searchTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route("lesson-plans.search"), {
                params: { q: searchQuery.value },
            });
            searchResults.value = response.data;
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Search failed:", e);
        } finally {
            searching.value = false;
        }
    }, 300);
};

// Assign
const assignLessonPlan = async (plan) => {
    try {
        await axios.post(
            route("classrooms.lesson-plan.assign", classroomDetails.id),
            { lesson_plan_id: plan.id }
        );

        // Update local state
        classroomDetailsStore.setData({ lesson_plan_id: plan.id });
        lessonPlan.value = plan;
        showSearch.value = false;
        searchQuery.value = "";
        searchResults.value = [];

        // Fetch full details
        fetchLessonPlan();
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to assign:", e);
    }
};

// Remove
const removeLessonPlan = async () => {
    if (!confirm("Remove lesson plan from this classroom?")) return;

    try {
        await axios.delete(
            route("classrooms.lesson-plan.remove", classroomDetails.id)
        );

        classroomDetailsStore.setData({ lesson_plan_id: null });
        lessonPlan.value = null;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to remove:", e);
    }
};

// Start presentation
const startPresentation = () => {
    router.post(route("lesson-presentation.start", classroomDetails.id), {
        lesson_plan_id: lessonPlan.value.id,
    });
};

// Continue presentation
const continuePresentation = () => {
    router.visit(
        route("lesson-presentation.teach", activePresentation.value.id)
    );
};

const getBlockIcon = (type: string) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: "🎯",
        activity: "⚡",
        assessment: "📝",
        materials: "📦",
        media: "🎬",
        discussion: "💬",
        differentiation: "🔀",
        notes: "📌",
    };
    return icons[type] || "📋";
};
</script>

import { ref, computed, watch } from "vue";
import { usePage, router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { Button, ProgressSpinner, OverlayPanel, Listbox } from "primevue";
import { useClassroomDetailsStore } from "@/Pinia/store";
import axios from "axios";

const auth = usePage().props.auth;
const classroomDetailsStore = useClassroomDetailsStore();
const classroomDetails = classroomDetailsStore.state;

const loading = ref(false);
const loadingPlans = ref(false);
const lessonPlan = ref(null);
const activePresentation = ref(null);
const lessonPlanOptions = ref([]);
const selectedPlanId = ref(null);
const op = ref(null);

const canEdit = computed(() =>
    ["admin", "school", "teacher"].includes(auth.user.active_system_role)
);

// Fetch assigned lesson plan
const fetchLessonPlan = async () => {
    if (!classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id) {
        lessonPlan.value = null;
        return;
    }

    loading.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(
            route("api.lesson-plans.show", classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id)
        );
        lessonPlan.value = response.data.lesson_plan;
        activePresentation.value = response.data.active_presentation;
        selectedPlanId.value = lessonPlan.value?.id || null;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch lesson plan:", e);
        lessonPlan.value = null;
    } finally {
        loading.value = false;
    }
};

// Fetch available lesson plans for selection
const fetchLessonPlanOptions = async () => {
    loadingPlans.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(route("lesson-plans.search"), {
            params: { q: "" },
        });
        lessonPlanOptions.value = response.data;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch lesson plans:", e);
    } finally {
        loadingPlans.value = false;
    }
};

// Toggle overlay panel
const togglePanel = (event) => {
    op.value.toggle(event);
    if (!lessonPlanOptions.value.length) {
        fetchLessonPlanOptions();
    }
};

// Handle selection
const onSelectionChange = async () => {
    if (!selectedPlanId.value) return;

    try {
        await axios.post(
            route("classrooms.lesson-plan.assign", classroomDetails.id),
            { lesson_plan_id: selectedPlanId.value }
        );

        classroomDetailsStore.setData({ lesson_plan_id: selectedPlanId.value });
        op.value.hide();
        fetchLessonPlan();
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to assign:", e);
    }
};

// Remove
const removeLessonPlan = async () => {
    if (!confirm("Remove lesson plan from this classroom?")) return;

    try {
        await axios.delete(
            route("classrooms.lesson-plan.remove", classroomDetails.id)
        );

        classroomDetailsStore.setData({ lesson_plan_id: null });
        lessonPlan.value = null;
        selectedPlanId.value = null;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to remove:", e);
    }
};

// Start presentation
const startPresentation = () => {
    router.post(route("lesson-presentation.start", classroomDetails.id), {
        lesson_plan_id: lessonPlan.value.id,
    });
};

// Continue presentation
const continuePresentation = () => {
    router.visit(
        route("lesson-presentation.teach", activePresentation.value.id)
    );
};

const getBlockIcon = (type: string) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: "🎯",
        activity: "⚡",
        assessment: "📝",
        materials: "📦",
        media: "🎬",
        discussion: "💬",
        differentiation: "🔀",
        notes: "📌",
    };
    return icons[type] || "📋";
};

// Watch for view changes
watch(
    () => classroomDetails.view,
    (view) => {
        if (view === "lesson-plan") {
            fetchLessonPlan();
        }
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

// Watch for lesson_plan_id changes
watch(
    () => classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id,
    () => {
        if (classroomDetails.view === "lesson-plan") {
            fetchLessonPlan();
        }
    }
);
</script>

        ->where('status', 'published')
        ->when($query, function ($q) use ($query) {

                   ->orWhere('subject', 'like', "%{$query}%")
                   ->orWhere('grade_level', 'like', "%{$query}%");

Create it:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/ClassroomLessonPlanController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Classroom;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;

class ClassroomLessonPlanController extends Controller
{
    public function search(Request $request)
    {
        $query = $request->input('q', '');

        $lessonPlans = LessonPlan::where('school_id', auth()->user()->current_school_id)
            ->where('status', 'published')
            ->when($query, function ($q) use ($query) {
                $q->where(function ($q2) use ($query) {
                    $q2->where('title', 'like', "%{$query}%")
                       ->orWhere('subject', 'like', "%{$query}%")
                       ->orWhere('grade_level', 'like', "%{$query}%");
                });
            })
            ->orderBy('title')
            ->limit(50)
            ->get(['id', 'title', 'subject', 'grade_level']);

        return response()->json($lessonPlans);
    }

    public function assign(Request $request, Classroom $classroom)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'lesson_plan_id' => 'required|exists:lesson_plans,id',
        ]);

        $classroom->update([
            'lesson_plan_id' => $request->lesson_plan_id,
        ]);

        return response()->json(['success' => true]);
    }

    public function remove(Classroom $classroom)

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch } from "vue";
import { usePage, router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { Button, ProgressSpinner, OverlayPanel, InputText } from "primevue";
import { useClassroomDetailsStore } from "@/Pinia/store";
import axios from "axios";

const auth = usePage().props.auth;
const classroomDetailsStore = useClassroomDetailsStore();
const classroomDetails = classroomDetailsStore.state;

const loading = ref(false);
const loadingPlans = ref(false);
const lessonPlan = ref(null);
const activePresentation = ref(null);
const lessonPlanOptions = ref([]);
const filterQuery = ref("");
const assigning = ref(null); // Track which plan is being assigned
const op = ref(null);

const canEdit = computed(() =>
    ["admin", "school", "teacher"].includes(auth.user.active_system_role)
);

const filteredLessonPlans = computed(() => {
    if (!filterQuery.value) return lessonPlanOptions.value;
    
    const query = filterQuery.value.toLowerCase();
    return lessonPlanOptions.value.filter(plan =>
        plan.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        plan.subject?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        plan.grade_level?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
});

// Fetch assigned lesson plan
const fetchLessonPlan = async () => {
    if (!classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id) {
        lessonPlan.value = null;
        return;
    }

    loading.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(
            route("api.lesson-plans.show", classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id)
        );
        lessonPlan.value = response.data.lesson_plan;
        activePresentation.value = response.data.active_presentation;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch lesson plan:", e);
        lessonPlan.value = null;
    } finally {
        loading.value = false;
    }
};

// Fetch available lesson plans for selection
const fetchLessonPlanOptions = async () => {
    loadingPlans.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(route("lesson-plans.search"), {
            params: { q: "" },
        });
        lessonPlanOptions.value = response.data;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch lesson plans:", e);
    } finally {
        loadingPlans.value = false;
    }
};

// Toggle overlay panel
const togglePanel = (event) => {
    op.value.toggle(event);
    if (!lessonPlanOptions.value.length) {
        fetchLessonPlanOptions();
    }
};

// Assign lesson plan
const assignLessonPlan = async (plan) => {
    assigning.value = plan.id;
    try {
        await axios.post(
            route("classrooms.lesson-plan.assign", classroomDetails.id),
            { lesson_plan_id: plan.id }
        );

        classroomDetailsStore.setData({ lesson_plan_id: plan.id });
        op.value.hide();
        filterQuery.value = "";
        fetchLessonPlan();
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to assign:", e);
    } finally {
        assigning.value = null;
    }
};

// Remove
const removeLessonPlan = async () => {
    if (!confirm("Remove lesson plan from this classroom?")) return;

    try {
        await axios.delete(
            route("classrooms.lesson-plan.remove", classroomDetails.id)
        );

        classroomDetailsStore.setData({ lesson_plan_id: null });
        lessonPlan.value = null;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to remove:", e);
    }
};

// Start presentation
const startPresentation = () => {
    router.post(route("lesson-presentation.start", classroomDetails.id), {
        lesson_plan_id: lessonPlan.value.id,
    });
};

// Continue presentation
const continuePresentation = () => {
    router.visit(
        route("lesson-presentation.teach", activePresentation.value.id)
    );
};

const getBlockIcon = (type: string) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: "🎯",
        activity: "⚡",
        assessment: "📝",
        materials: "📦",
        media: "🎬",
        discussion: "💬",
        differentiation: "🔀",
        notes: "📌",
    };
    return icons[type] || "📋";
};

// Watch for view changes
watch(
    () => classroomDetails.view,
    (view) => {
        if (view === "lesson-plan") {
            fetchLessonPlan();
        }
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

// Watch for lesson_plan_id changes
watch(
    () => classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id,
    () => {
        if (classroomDetails.view === "lesson-plan") {
            fetchLessonPlan();
        }
    }
);
</script>

  3. Shows "✓ Assigned" for currently assigned plan
  4. Shows loading state while assigning

  6. Better visual layout with flex between plan info and assign button

<script setup lang="ts">
/* --- imports --- */
import { Button, Dialog, ProgressSpinner, useToast } from "primevue";
import { computed, onMounted } from "vue";

import { router, usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import {
    useCalendarStore,
    useUpdateClassroomStore,
    useClassroomDetailsStore,
} from "@/Pinia/store";
import { useLiveKitClassroomStore, useRescheduleClassroomStore } from "../../Pinia/store";
import { now } from "../../state/clockState.js";
import { findClassrooms } from "../../utils/rescheduleFormFunctions";
import ClassroomSettings from "./ClassroomModal/ClassroomSettings.vue";
import ClassroomModalTabs from "./ClassroomModal/ClassroomModalTabs.vue";
import ClassroomResources from "./ClassroomModal/ClassroomResources.vue";
import ClassroomAttendance from "./ClassroomModal/ClassroomAttendance.vue";
import ClassroomLessonPlan from "./ClassroomModal/ClassroomLessonPlan.vue";
import { provide } from "vue";
import UpdateClassroomForm from "./ClassroomModal/UpdateClassroomForm.vue";
import UpdateClassroomFollowingForm from "./ClassroomModal/UpdateClassroomFollowingForm.vue";
import UpdateClassroomRangeForm from "./ClassroomModal/UpdateClassroomRangeForm.vue";
import RescheduleClassrooms from "./ClassroomModal/RescheduleClassrooms.vue";
import RescheduleClassroomsUpdate from "./ClassroomModal/RescheduleClassroomsUpdate.vue";
import RescheduleClassroomsUndo from "./ClassroomModal/RescheduleClassroomsUndo.vue";
import { useSetClassroomProperties } from "../../utils/generalUtils.js";
import { nextMonday } from "date-fns";

/* --- page props / stores / state --- */
const { auth } = usePage().props;
const hasFullEditAccess = computed(() =>
    ["admin", "school"].includes(auth.user.active_system_role)
);
const toast = useToast();

const updateClassroomStore = useUpdateClassroomStore();
const classroomDetailsStore = useClassroomDetailsStore();
const calendarStore = useCalendarStore();
const rescheduleClassroomStore = useRescheduleClassroomStore();
const updateFormState = updateClassroomStore.state;
const classroomDetails = classroomDetailsStore.state;
const liveKitClassroomStore = useLiveKitClassroomStore();
const { setClassroomProperties } = useSetClassroomProperties();

const toastSuccess = (msg) => {
    toast.add({
        severity: "success",
        summary: "Success",
        detail: msg,
        life: 5000,
    });
};

const toastError = (err) => {
    toast.add({
        severity: "error",
        summary: "Error",
        detail: err?.message || err,
        life: 5000,
    });
};

let initialized = false;

const setDefaults = () => {
    const api = calendarStore.getApi();
    if (!api) throw new Error("Calendar API not found");
    const baseEvent = api.getEventById(classroomDetails.id);
    if (!baseEvent) return;
    setClassroomProperties(baseEvent);
};

provide("setDefaults", setDefaults);

onMounted(() => {
    initialized = true;
});

/* --- computed lists --- */

const rescheduledFromDate = computed(() => {
    return classroomDetails.rescheduled_from
        ? new Date(classroomDetails.rescheduled_from.start)
        : null;
});

const nativegateFromTo = () => {
    if (!classroomDetails.rescheduled_to) return;
    classroomDetailsStore.setData({ open: false });
    const waitForClose = setTimeout(() => {
        calendarStore.triggerEventClick(classroomDetails.rescheduled_to.id);
    }, 300);
    const clearWait = setTimeout(() => {
        clearTimeout(waitForClose);
        clearTimeout(clearWait);
    }, 500);
};

const nativegateToFrom = () => {
    if (!classroomDetails.rescheduled_from) return;

    classroomDetailsStore.setData({ open: false });
    const waitForClose = setTimeout(() => {
        calendarStore.triggerEventClick(classroomDetails.rescheduled_from.id);
    }, 300);
    const clearWait = setTimeout(() => {
        clearTimeout(waitForClose);
        clearTimeout(clearWait);
    }, 500);
};

const onDialogHide = () => {
    updateClassroomStore.resetData();
    rescheduleClassroomStore.resetData();
};

/* --- modal close reset --- */
const onCloseClick = () => {
    classroomDetailsStore.resetData();
};

/* ================= Parent-managed reschedule/update/undo handling ================= */

const existingClassroomsRescheduleUpdate = computed(() => {
    if (
        (classroomDetails.view === "reschedule.update" ||
            classroomDetails.view === "reschedule.undo") &&
        classroomDetails.rescheduled_to
    ) {
        return findClassrooms({
            from: new Date(classroomDetails.start),
            groupId: classroomDetails.group_id,
            events: calendarStore.state.events,
            rescheduledFromOnly: true,
        });
    }
    return [];
});

const existingClassroomsReschedule = computed(() => {
    if (classroomDetails.view !== "reschedule") {
        return [];
    }
    return findClassrooms({
        from: new Date(classroomDetails.start),
        groupId: classroomDetails.group_id,
        events: calendarStore.state.events,
        excludeRescheduledFrom: true,
        excludeRescheduledTo: true,
    });
});

const attendClass = () => {
    liveKitClassroomStore.setData({
        room_name: classroomDetails.id,
    });
    router.visit(route('livekit.test'));
};
</script>

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Classroom;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Models\Team;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class ClassroomService
{
    /**
     * Fetch classrooms visible to a user between date ranges.
     * Cache unit = (school_id + team_id + group_id)
     * FullCalendar range is applied AFTER cache load.
     *
     * Returns: [array $mappedClassrooms, \Illuminate\Support\Collection $usersById]
     */
    public function getClassrooms(User $user, string $start, string $end)
    {
        try {
            // Determine which teams user can access
            $teams = $user->isAdmin() ? Team::all() : $user->teams;

            if ($teams->isEmpty()) {
                return [[], collect()];
            }

            $teamIds = $teams->pluck('id')->toArray();

            // Fetch classrooms directly from DB with eager loading
            $classrooms = Classroom::whereIn('team_id', $teamIds)
                ->with([
                    'courseData.owner',
                    'links',
                    'files',
                    'meetingLink',
                    'materialLinks',
                    'attendances.user',
                    'attendances.school',
                    'rescheduledFrom',
                    'rescheduledFrom.attendances.user',
                    'rescheduledTo',
                    'rescheduledTo.attendances.user',
                ])
                ->get();

            // normalize and extract users
            [$mapped, $usersCollection] = $this->mapClassroomsCollectionToPayload($classrooms);

            // Filter by requested date window
            $startC = Carbon::parse($start);
            $endC = Carbon::parse($end);

            $filtered = array_filter($mapped, function ($c) use ($startC, $endC) {
                if (empty($c['start']))
                    return false;

                try {
                    $s = Carbon::parse($c['start']);
                } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                    return false;
                }

                return $s->between($startC, $endC);
            });

            return [array_values($filtered), $usersCollection];

        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            Log::error('getClassrooms error: ' . $e->getMessage(), [
                'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString()
            ]);

            return [[], collect()];
        }
    }




    public function getNormalizedClassrooms(int $teamId, string $groupId): array
    {
        $team = Team::find($teamId);
        if (!$team)
            return [];

        $classrooms = Classroom::where('team_id', $teamId)
            ->where('group_id', $groupId)
            ->with([
                'courseData.owner',
                'links',
                'files',
                'meetingLink',
                'materialLinks',
                'attendances.user',
                'attendances.school',
                'rescheduledFrom',
                'rescheduledFrom.attendances.user',
                'rescheduledTo',
                'rescheduledTo.attendances.user',
            ])
            ->get();

        [$mapped, $usersCollection] = $this->mapClassroomsCollectionToPayload($classrooms);

        return $mapped;
    }

    public function deleteClassrooms(string $groupId)
    {
        
        try {
            $events = Classroom::where('group_id', $groupId)->get();
            if ($events->isEmpty()) {
                return response()->json(['message' => 'No events found'], 204);
            }

            $deleted = Classroom::where('group_id', $groupId)->delete();

            if ($deleted) {
                Classroom::where('group_id', $groupId)->update(['rescheduled_from_id' => null]);
                event(new \App\Events\ClassroomsDeleted($events));

                return response()->json(['message' => 'Classrooms deleted successfully']);
            }

            throw new \Exception('Failed to delete events');
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('Error deleting classrooms: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'Failed to delete classrooms: ' . $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    protected function mapClassroomsCollectionToPayload($classroomsCollection)
    {
        try {
            $classrooms = $classroomsCollection->values();

            $userIds = $classrooms->flatMap(function ($classroom) {
                $ids = [];

                if (!empty($classroom->attendances)) {
                    $ids = array_merge($ids, $classroom->attendances->pluck('user_id')->toArray());
                }

                if (!empty($classroom->rescheduledFrom?->attendances)) {
                    $ids = array_merge($ids, $classroom->rescheduledFrom->attendances->pluck('user_id')->toArray());
                }

                if (!empty($classroom->rescheduledTo)) {
                    foreach ($classroom->rescheduledTo as $r) {
                        if (!empty($r->attendances)) {
                            $ids = array_merge($ids, $r->attendances->pluck('user_id')->toArray());
                        }
                    }
                }

                return $ids;
            })->unique()->values()->all();

            $users = $userIds ? User::whereIn('id', $userIds)
                ->with([
                    'schoolRoles',
                    'activeSchoolRoles',
                    'systemRoles',
                    'activeSystemRole',
                    'members.systemRoles',
                    'members.activeSystemRole',
                    'members.schoolRoles',
                    'members.activeSchoolRoles'
                ])
                ->get()
                ->keyBy('id') : collect();

            $mapAttendanceWithActiveRole = function ($attendances) use ($users) {
                return $attendances->map(function ($attendance) use ($users) {
                    $user = $attendance->user_id ? $users->get($attendance->user_id) : null;
                    $activeRole = null;
                    if ($user && $user->schoolRoles) {
                        $activeRole = $user->schoolRoles
                            ->first(fn($role) => $role->pivot->school_id == $attendance->school_id && $role->pivot->is_active);
                    }

                    return [
                        'id' => $attendance->id,
                        'classroom_id' => $attendance->classroom_id,
                        'team_id' => $attendance->team_id,
                        'user_id' => $attendance->user_id,
                        'status' => $attendance->status,
                        'arrival_time' => $attendance->arrival_time,
                        'created_at' => $attendance->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                        'updated_at' => $attendance->updated_at?->toIso8601String(),
                        'school_id' => $attendance->school_id,
                        'user' => $user?->toArray(),
                        'school' => $attendance->school?->toArray(),
                        'school_active_role' => $activeRole?->toArray(),
                    ];
                });
            };

            $mapped = $classrooms->map(function ($classroom) use ($mapAttendanceWithActiveRole) {
                $courseData = $classroom->courseData;

                $rescheduledFrom = $classroom->rescheduledFrom ? [
                    'id' => $classroom->rescheduledFrom->id,
                    'start' => $classroom->rescheduledFrom->start?->toIso8601String() ?? null,
                    'end' => $classroom->rescheduledFrom->end?->toIso8601String() ?? null,
                    'team_id' => $classroom->rescheduledFrom->team_id ?? null,
                    'group_id' => $classroom->rescheduledFrom->group_id ?? null,
                    'rescheduled_from_id' => $classroom->rescheduledFrom->rescheduled_from_id ?? null,
                ] : null;

                $rescheduledTo = $classroom->rescheduledTo->map(function ($r) {
                    return [
                        'id' => $r->id,
                        'start' => $r->start?->toIso8601String() ?? null,
                        'end' => $r->end?->toIso8601String() ?? null,
                        'team_id' => $r->team_id,
                        'group_id' => $r->group_id,
                        'rescheduled_from_id' => $r->rescheduled_from_id,
                    ];
                })->toArray();

                return [
                    'id' => $classroom->id,
                    'group_id' => $classroom->group_id,
                    'start' => $classroom->start?->toIso8601String(),
                    'end' => $classroom->end?->toIso8601String(),
                    'team_id' => $courseData?->id ?? $classroom->team_id,
                    'background_color' => $classroom->background_color,
                    'text_color' => $classroom->text_color,
                    'is_recurring' => $classroom->is_recurring,
                    'repeat_every' => $classroom->repeat_every,
                    'exact_days' => $classroom->exact_days,
                    'num_of_days' => $classroom->num_of_days,
                    'recurring_end_date' => $classroom->recurring_end_date?->toIso8601String(),
                    'recurring_days' => $classroom->recurring_days,
                    'created_at' => $classroom->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                    'updated_at' => $classroom->updated_at?->toIso8601String(),
                    'deleted_at' => $classroom->deleted_at,
                    'rescheduled_from_id' => $classroom->rescheduled_from_id,
                    'meeting_link_id' => $classroom->meeting_link_id,
                    'course_data' => $courseData ? [
                        'id' => $courseData->id,
                        'user_id' => $courseData->user_id,
                        'name' => $courseData->name,
                        'personal_team' => $courseData->personal_team,
                        'created_at' => $courseData->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                        'updated_at' => $courseData->updated_at?->toIso8601String(),
                        'owner' => $courseData->owner?->toArray(),
                    ] : null,
                    'attendances' => $mapAttendanceWithActiveRole($classroom->attendances),

     */
    public function getClassrooms(User $user, string $start, string $end)
    {
        try {
            // Determine which teams user can access
            $teams = $user->isAdmin() ? Team::all() : $user->teams;

            if ($teams->isEmpty()) {
                return [[], collect()];
            }

            $teamIds = $teams->pluck('id')->toArray();

                ->with([

            // Filter by requested date window

                try {
                    $s = Carbon::parse($c['start']);

                    return false;
                }

                return $s->between($startC, $endC);
            });

            return [array_values($filtered), $usersCollection];

Claude2025-12-31 18:56 UTC

The data is being double-encoded. $request->get_body() is likely already returning a JSON string, then you're encoding it again.

Fix:

// If get_body() returns JSON string, decode it first
$body = $request->get_body();
$bodyArray = is_string($body) ? json_decode($body, true) : $body;

$postFields = json_encode(array_merge($bodyArray, ['sign' => $this->sign]));

Log::info('postFields', ['postFields' => $postFields]);

Or if you want to debug what's coming in:

$body = $request->get_body();

Log::info('body type', ['type' => gettype($body), 'body' => $body]);

// Handle both cases
if (is_string($body)) {
    $bodyArray = json_decode($body, true);
} else {
    $bodyArray = $body;
}

$postFields = json_encode(array_merge($bodyArray, ['sign' => $this->sign]));

The backslashes (\", \\/) are escape characters that appear when you JSON-encode a string that's already JSON. The API is receiving malformed data because of this double-encoding.

Millard2025-12-31 18:59 UTC
no it's not but is there a way to make the json no use those back slashes when encodin
Claude2025-12-31 18:59 UTC

Use JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES:

$postFields = json_encode(
    array_merge($request->get_body(), ['sign' => $this->sign]),
    JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES
);

This turns https:\/\/example.com into https://example.com.

Other useful flags you can combine:

$postFields = json_encode(
    array_merge($request->get_body(), ['sign' => $this->sign]),
    JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE
);
Flag Effect
JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES / stays as / instead of \/
JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE Unicode chars stay as-is instead of \uXXXX
JSON_PRETTY_PRINT Formatted output (for debugging)

                        'owner' => $courseData->owner?->toArray(),
                    ] : null,
                    'attendances' => $mapAttendanceWithActiveRole($classroom->attendances),
                    'rescheduled_from' => $rescheduledFrom,
                    'rescheduled_to' => $rescheduledTo,
                    'links' => $classroom->links->map(function ($link) {

                            'title' => $link->pivot->title,

                            'created_at' => $link->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                            'updated_at' => $link->updated_at?->toIso8601String(),
                        ];
                    })->toArray(),
                    'files' => $classroom->files->map(function ($file) {
                        return [
                            'id' => $file->id,

                            'title' => $file->pivot->title,
                            'original_filename' => $file->original_filename,

                            'mime_type' => $file->mime_type,
                            'extension' => $file->extension,
                            'compressed_path' => $file->compressed_path,
                            'name' => $file->name,
                            'size' => $file->size,
                            'visibility' => $file->visibility,
                            'created_at' => $file->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                            'updated_at' => $file->updated_at?->toIso8601String(),
                        ];
                    })->toArray(),
                    'meeting_link' => ($classroom->meetingLink?->toArray() ?? null),
                    'material_links' => $classroom->materialLinks->map(function ($link) {
                        return [
                            'id' => $link->id,
                            'url' => $link->url,
                            'type' => $link->type,
                            'title' => $link->pivot->title,
                            'created_at' => $link->created_at?->toIso8601String(),
                            'updated_at' => $link->updated_at?->toIso8601String(),
                        ];
                    })->toArray(),
                    'title' => $courseData?->name ?? 'Untitled Course',
                ];
            })->values()->toArray();

            return [$mapped, $users];
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            Log::error('Error in mapClassroomsCollectionToPayload: ' . $e->getMessage(), ['trace' => $e->getTraceAsString()]);
            return [[], collect()];
        }
    }
}
