<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, computed, watch } from "vue";
import { usePage, router } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { Button, ProgressSpinner, OverlayPanel, InputText } from "primevue";
import { useClassroomDetailsStore } from "@/Pinia/store";
import axios from "axios";

const auth = usePage().props.auth;
const classroomDetailsStore = useClassroomDetailsStore();
const classroomDetails = classroomDetailsStore.state;

const loading = ref(false);
const loadingPlans = ref(false);
const lessonPlan = ref(null);
const activePresentation = ref(null);
const lessonPlanOptions = ref([]);
const filterQuery = ref("");
const assigning = ref(null);
const op = ref(null);
const expandedBlocks = ref<number[]>([]);

const canEdit = computed(() =>
    ["admin", "school", "teacher"].includes(auth.user.active_system_role)
);

const filteredLessonPlans = computed(() => {
    if (!filterQuery.value) return lessonPlanOptions.value;
    
    const query = filterQuery.value.toLowerCase();
    return lessonPlanOptions.value.filter(plan =>
        plan.title.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        plan.subject?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
        plan.grade_level?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
    );
});

// Toggle block expansion
const toggleBlock = (blockId: number) => {
    const index = expandedBlocks.value.indexOf(blockId);
    if (index === -1) {
        expandedBlocks.value.push(blockId);
    } else {
        expandedBlocks.value.splice(index, 1);
    }
};

// Fetch assigned lesson plan
const fetchLessonPlan = async () => {
    if (!classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id) {
        lessonPlan.value = null;
        return;
    }

    loading.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(
            route("api.lesson-plans.show", classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id)
        );
        lessonPlan.value = response.data.lesson_plan;
        activePresentation.value = response.data.active_presentation;
        
        // Auto-expand first block
        if (lessonPlan.value?.blocks?.length && expandedBlocks.value.length === 0) {
            expandedBlocks.value = [lessonPlan.value.blocks[0].id];
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch lesson plan:", e);
        lessonPlan.value = null;
    } finally {
        loading.value = false;
    }
};

// Fetch available lesson plans for selection
const fetchLessonPlanOptions = async () => {
    loadingPlans.value = true;
    try {
        const response = await axios.get(route("lesson-plans.search"), {
            params: { q: "" },
        });
        lessonPlanOptions.value = response.data;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch lesson plans:", e);
    } finally {
        loadingPlans.value = false;
    }
};

// Toggle overlay panel
const togglePanel = (event) => {
    op.value.toggle(event);
    if (!lessonPlanOptions.value.length) {
        fetchLessonPlanOptions();
    }
};

// Assign lesson plan
const assignLessonPlan = async (plan) => {
    assigning.value = plan.id;
    try {
        await axios.post(
            route("classrooms.lesson-plan.assign", classroomDetails.id),
            { lesson_plan_id: plan.id }
        );

        classroomDetailsStore.setData({ lesson_plan_id: plan.id });
        op.value.hide();
        filterQuery.value = "";
        expandedBlocks.value = [];
        fetchLessonPlan();
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to assign:", e);
    } finally {
        assigning.value = null;
    }
};

// Remove
const removeLessonPlan = async () => {
    if (!confirm("Remove lesson plan from this classroom?")) return;

    try {
        await axios.delete(
            route("classrooms.lesson-plan.remove", classroomDetails.id)
        );

        classroomDetailsStore.setData({ lesson_plan_id: null });
        lessonPlan.value = null;
        expandedBlocks.value = [];
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to remove:", e);
    }
};

// Start presentation
const startPresentation = () => {
    router.post(route("lesson-presentation.start", classroomDetails.id), {
        lesson_plan_id: lessonPlan.value.id,
    });
};

// Continue presentation
const continuePresentation = () => {
    router.visit(
        route("lesson-presentation.teach", activePresentation.value.id)
    );
};

const getBlockIcon = (type: string) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: "🎯",
        activity: "⚡",
        assessment: "📝",
        materials: "📦",
        media: "🎬",
        discussion: "💬",
        differentiation: "🔀",
        notes: "📌",
    };
    return icons[type] || "📋";
};

// Watch for view changes
watch(
    () => classroomDetails.view,
    (view) => {
        if (view === "lesson-plan") {
            fetchLessonPlan();
        }
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

// Watch for lesson_plan_id changes
watch(
    () => classroomDetails.lesson_plan_id,
    () => {
        if (classroomDetails.view === "lesson-plan") {
            expandedBlocks.value = [];
            fetchLessonPlan();
        }
    }
);
</script>

Changes:

  1. Added expandedBlocks ref to track which blocks are expanded
  2. Added toggleBlock() function to expand/collapse blocks
  3. Blocks now show expand/collapse arrow and are clickable
  4. Expanded blocks show:
    • Block content (text, instructions, prompt)
    • Sub-blocks with title, type badge, duration, and content
  5. First block auto-expands when lesson plan loads
  6. Added scrollable container with max-h-[400px]
  7. Reset expanded blocks when changing lesson plans

<?php
// app/Models/LessonPresentation.php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;

class LessonPresentation extends Model
{
    protected $fillable = [
        'classroom_id',
        'lesson_plan_id',
        'started_by',
        'current_block_index',
        'current_sub_block_index',
        'status',
        'started_at',
        'ended_at',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'current_block_index' => 'integer',
        'current_sub_block_index' => 'integer',
        'started_at' => 'datetime',
        'ended_at' => 'datetime',
    ];

    public function classroom(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Classroom::class);
    }

    public function lessonPlan(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(LessonPlan::class);
    }

    public function teacher(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(User::class, 'started_by');
    }

    public function getCurrentBlock()
    {
        return $this->lessonPlan->blocks()
            ->orderBy('order')
            ->skip($this->current_block_index)
            ->first();
    }

    public function getState(): array
    {
        $this->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        
        $blocks = $this->lessonPlan->blocks->sortBy('order')->values();
        $currentBlock = $blocks->get($this->current_block_index);
        
        $currentSubBlock = null;
        if ($currentBlock && $this->current_sub_block_index !== null) {
            $subBlocks = $currentBlock->subBlocks->sortBy('order')->values();
            $currentSubBlock = $subBlocks->get($this->current_sub_block_index);
        }

        return [
            'presentation_id' => $this->id,
            'status' => $this->status,
            'current_block_index' => $this->current_block_index,
            'current_sub_block_index' => $this->current_sub_block_index,
            'total_blocks' => $blocks->count(),
            'current_block' => $currentBlock?->toArray(),
            'current_sub_block' => $currentSubBlock?->toArray(),
        ];
    }
}

4. LessonPresentationController:

<?php
// app/Http/Controllers/LessonPresentationController.php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Classroom;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use App\Models\LessonPresentation;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Inertia\Inertia;

class LessonPresentationController extends Controller
{
    public function start(Request $request, Classroom $classroom)
    {
        $request->validate([
            'lesson_plan_id' => 'required|exists:lesson_plans,id',
        ]);

        // End any active presentation
        $classroom->presentations()
            ->where('status', 'active')
            ->update(['status' => 'completed', 'ended_at' => now()]);

        $presentation = LessonPresentation::create([
            'classroom_id' => $classroom->id,
            'lesson_plan_id' => $request->lesson_plan_id,
            'started_by' => auth()->id(),
            'current_block_index' => 0,
            'current_sub_block_index' => null,
            'status' => 'active',
            'started_at' => now(),
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'presentation_id' => $presentation->id,
            'state' => $presentation->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    public function state(Classroom $classroom)
    {
        $presentation = $classroom->activePresentation;

        if (!$presentation) {
            return response()->json([
                'active' => false,
                'state' => null,
            ]);
        }

        return response()->json([
            'active' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    public function navigate(Request $request, LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        if ($presentation->started_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $request->validate([
            'block_index' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'sub_block_index' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
        ]);

        $presentation->update([
            'current_block_index' => $request->block_index,
            'current_sub_block_index' => $request->sub_block_index,
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    public function next(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        if ($presentation->started_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        $blocks = $presentation->lessonPlan->blocks->sortBy('order')->values();
        $currentBlock = $blocks->get($presentation->current_block_index);

        if (!$currentBlock) {
            return response()->json(['success' => false, 'message' => 'No current block']);
        }

        $subBlocks = $currentBlock->subBlocks->sortBy('order')->values();
        $currentSubIndex = $presentation->current_sub_block_index;

        if ($subBlocks->count() > 0) {
            if ($currentSubIndex === null) {
                // Start sub-blocks
                $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => 0]);
            } elseif ($currentSubIndex < $subBlocks->count() - 1) {
                // Next sub-block
                $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => $currentSubIndex + 1]);
            } else {
                // Move to next block
                $this->moveToNextBlock($presentation, $blocks);
            }
        } else {
            // No sub-blocks, move to next block
            $this->moveToNextBlock($presentation, $blocks);
        }

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->fresh()->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    public function previous(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        if ($presentation->started_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        $blocks = $presentation->lessonPlan->blocks->sortBy('order')->values();
        $currentSubIndex = $presentation->current_sub_block_index;

        if ($currentSubIndex !== null && $currentSubIndex > 0) {
            // Previous sub-block
            $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => $currentSubIndex - 1]);
        } elseif ($currentSubIndex === 0) {
            // Back to block overview
            $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => null]);
        } elseif ($presentation->current_block_index > 0) {
            // Previous block
            $prevBlockIndex = $presentation->current_block_index - 1;
            $prevBlock = $blocks->get($prevBlockIndex);
            $prevSubBlocks = $prevBlock?->subBlocks->sortBy('order')->values();
            $lastSubIndex = $prevSubBlocks && $prevSubBlocks->count() > 0
                ? $prevSubBlocks->count() - 1
                : null;

            $presentation->update([
                'current_block_index' => $prevBlockIndex,
                'current_sub_block_index' => $lastSubIndex,
            ]);
        }

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->fresh()->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    public function pause(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        if ($presentation->started_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $presentation->update(['status' => 'paused']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    public function resume(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        if ($presentation->started_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $presentation->update(['status' => 'active']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    public function end(LessonPresentation $presentation)
    {
        if ($presentation->started_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403);
        }

        $presentation->update([
            'status' => 'completed',
            'ended_at' => now(),
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
        ]);
    }

    private function moveToNextBlock(LessonPresentation $presentation, $blocks)
    {
        $nextBlockIndex = $presentation->current_block_index + 1;

        if ($nextBlockIndex < $blocks->count()) {
            $presentation->update([
                'current_block_index' => $nextBlockIndex,
                'current_sub_block_index' => null,
            ]);
        } else {
            // End of lesson
            $presentation->update([
                'status' => 'completed',
                'ended_at' => now(),
            ]);
        }
    }
}

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { Button } from "primevue";
import axios from "axios";

const props = defineProps<{
    classroomId: number;
    presentationId: number;
    lessonPlan: any;
    state: {
        status: string;
        current_block_index: number;
        current_sub_block_index: number | null;
        total_blocks: number;
        current_block: any;
        current_sub_block: any;
    };
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{
    (e: "update", state: any): void;
    (e: "ended"): void;
}>();

const isFirst = computed(() => {
    return props.state.current_block_index === 0 && props.state.current_sub_block_index === null;
});

const next = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.next", props.presentationId));
    if (response.data.success) {
        emit("update", response.data.state);
    }
};

const previous = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.previous", props.presentationId));
    if (response.data.success) {
        emit("update", response.data.state);
    }
};

const goToBlock = async (index: number) => {
    const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.navigate", props.presentationId), {
        block_index: index,
        sub_block_index: null,
    });
    if (response.data.success) {
        emit("update", response.data.state);
    }
};

const pause = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.pause", props.presentationId));
    if (response.data.success) {
        emit("update", response.data.state);
    }
};

const resume = async () => {
    const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.resume", props.presentationId));
    if (response.data.success) {
        emit("update", response.data.state);
    }
};

const endLesson = async () => {
    if (!confirm("End this lesson?")) return;
    
    await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.end", props.presentationId));
    emit("ended");
};

const getBlockIcon = (type: string) => {
    const icons: Record<string, string> = {
        objective: "🎯",
        activity: "⚡",
        assessment: "📝",
        materials: "📦",
        media: "🎬",
        discussion: "💬",
        differentiation: "🔀",
        notes: "📌",
    };
    return icons[type] || "📋";
};
</script>

8. Composable for presentation state sync:

// resources/js/composables/useLessonPresentation.ts

import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } from "vue";
import axios from "axios";

export function useLessonPresentation(classroomId: number, isTeacher: boolean = false) {
    const presentationId = ref<number | null>(null);
    const lessonPlan = ref<any>(null);
    const state = ref<any>(null);
    const loading = ref(false);
    const polling = ref<number | null>(null);

    const fetchState = async () => {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route("lesson-presentation.state", classroomId));
            
            if (response.data.active) {
                presentationId.value = response.data.state.presentation_id;
                state.value = response.data.state;
            } else {
                presentationId.value = null;
                state.value = null;
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Failed to fetch presentation state:", e);
        }
    };

    const startPresentation = async (lessonPlanId: number) => {
        loading.value = true;
        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.start", classroomId), {
                lesson_plan_id: lessonPlanId,
            });

            presentationId.value = response.data.presentation_id;
            state.value = response.data.state;
            
            return response.data;
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Failed to start presentation:", e);
            throw e;
        } finally {
            loading.value = false;
        }
    };

    const updateState = (newState: any) => {
        state.value = newState;
    };

    const endPresentation = () => {
        presentationId.value = null;
        state.value = null;
    };

    // Start polling for students
    const startPolling = (intervalMs: number = 2000) => {
        if (polling.value) return;
        
        polling.value = window.setInterval(fetchState, intervalMs);
    };

    const stopPolling = () => {
        if (polling.value) {
            clearInterval(polling.value);
            polling.value = null;
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        fetchState();
        
        // Students poll for updates
        if (!isTeacher) {
            startPolling();
        }
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        stopPolling();
    });

    return {
        presentationId,
        lessonPlan,
        state,
        loading,
        fetchState,
        startPresentation,
        updateState,
        endPresentation,
        startPolling,
        stopPolling,
    };
}

import { computed } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { Button } from "primevue";
import { useLessonPresentation } from "@/composables/useLessonPresentation";

const liveKitStore = useLiveKitClassroomStore();

const classroomId = computed(() => liveKitStore.state.room_name);
const classroomLessonPlanId = computed(() => liveKitStore.state.lesson_plan_id);
const lessonPlan = computed(() => liveKitStore.state.lesson_plan);

const isTeacher = computed(() =>
    ["admin", "school", "teacher"].includes(auth.user.active_system_role)
);

const presentation = useLessonPresentation(classroomId.value, isTeacher.value);

const startLesson = async () => {
    if (!classroomLessonPlanId.value) return;
    await presentation.startPresentation(classroomLessonPlanId.value);
};
</script>

Summary:

Role What they see
Teacher Controls panel with Next/Previous, progress dots, pause/resume/end
Student Full-screen block content, auto-synced with teacher via polling

Flow:

  1. Teacher clicks "Start Lesson" in LiveKit room
  2. Creates LessonPresentation record
  3. Teacher controls navigation with Next/Previous
  4. Students poll /classrooms/{id}/presentation/state every 2 seconds
  5. Student view updates automatically
  6. Teacher ends lesson, students see "Complete" screen

For real-time sync instead of polling, you can broadcast state changes via WebSockets/Pusher using the same LessonPresentationUpdated event from earlier.

The unique constraint won't work as intended. It prevents duplicate (classroom_id, status) pairs, meaning you can only have ONE completed presentation per classroom ever.

Fix - remove the constraint and handle in application logic:

<?php

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Classroom;
use App\Models\LessonPlan;
use App\Models\LessonPresentation;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;

class LessonPresentationController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Start a new presentation for a classroom
     */
    public function start(Request $request, Classroom $classroom): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'lesson_plan_id' => 'required|exists:lesson_plans,id',
        ]);

        // Verify user can start presentations (teacher/school/admin)
        $this->authorizeTeacher();

        // End any existing active/paused presentations for this classroom
        LessonPresentation::where('classroom_id', $classroom->id)
            ->whereIn('status', ['active', 'paused'])
            ->update([
                'status' => 'completed',
                'ended_at' => now(),
            ]);

        $presentation = LessonPresentation::create([
            'classroom_id' => $classroom->id,
            'lesson_plan_id' => $request->lesson_plan_id,
            'started_by' => auth()->id(),
            'current_block_index' => 0,
            'current_sub_block_index' => null,
            'status' => 'active',
            'started_at' => now(),
        ]);

        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'presentation_id' => $presentation->id,
            'state' => $presentation->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Get current presentation state for a classroom
     */
    public function state(Classroom $classroom): JsonResponse
    {
        $presentation = LessonPresentation::where('classroom_id', $classroom->id)
            ->whereIn('status', ['active', 'paused'])
            ->with('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks', 'teacher')
            ->first();

        if (!$presentation) {
            return response()->json([
                'active' => false,
                'state' => null,
            ]);
        }

        return response()->json([
            'active' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->getState(),
            'lesson_plan' => [
                'id' => $presentation->lessonPlan->id,
                'title' => $presentation->lessonPlan->title,
                'subject' => $presentation->lessonPlan->subject,
                'grade_level' => $presentation->lessonPlan->grade_level,
            ],
            'teacher' => [
                'id' => $presentation->teacher->id,
                'name' => $presentation->teacher->name,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Navigate to a specific block/sub-block
     */
    public function navigate(Request $request, LessonPresentation $presentation): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorizePresenter($presentation);

        $request->validate([
            'block_index' => 'required|integer|min:0',
            'sub_block_index' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
        ]);

        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        $blocks = $presentation->lessonPlan->blocks->sortBy('order')->values();

        // Validate block_index
        if ($request->block_index >= $blocks->count()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Invalid block index',
            ], 422);
        }

        // Validate sub_block_index if provided
        if ($request->sub_block_index !== null) {
            $block = $blocks->get($request->block_index);
            $subBlocks = $block->subBlocks->sortBy('order')->values();

            if ($request->sub_block_index >= $subBlocks->count()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Invalid sub-block index',
                ], 422);
            }
        }

        $presentation->update([
            'current_block_index' => $request->block_index,
            'current_sub_block_index' => $request->sub_block_index,
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->fresh()->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Move to next block/sub-block
     */
    public function next(LessonPresentation $presentation): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorizePresenter($presentation);

        if ($presentation->status !== 'active') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Presentation is not active',
            ], 422);
        }

        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        $blocks = $presentation->lessonPlan->blocks->sortBy('order')->values();
        $currentBlock = $blocks->get($presentation->current_block_index);

        if (!$currentBlock) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'No current block',
            ], 422);
        }

        $subBlocks = $currentBlock->subBlocks->sortBy('order')->values();
        $currentSubIndex = $presentation->current_sub_block_index;

        if ($subBlocks->count() > 0) {
            if ($currentSubIndex === null) {
                // Start sub-blocks (show first sub-block)
                $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => 0]);
            } elseif ($currentSubIndex < $subBlocks->count() - 1) {
                // Next sub-block
                $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => $currentSubIndex + 1]);
            } else {
                // Finished sub-blocks, move to next block
                $this->moveToNextBlock($presentation, $blocks);
            }
        } else {
            // No sub-blocks, move to next block
            $this->moveToNextBlock($presentation, $blocks);
        }

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->fresh()->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Move to previous block/sub-block
     */
    public function previous(LessonPresentation $presentation): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorizePresenter($presentation);

        if ($presentation->status !== 'active') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Presentation is not active',
            ], 422);
        }

        $presentation->load('lessonPlan.blocks.subBlocks');
        $blocks = $presentation->lessonPlan->blocks->sortBy('order')->values();
        $currentSubIndex = $presentation->current_sub_block_index;
        $currentBlockIndex = $presentation->current_block_index;

        if ($currentSubIndex !== null && $currentSubIndex > 0) {
            // Previous sub-block
            $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => $currentSubIndex - 1]);
        } elseif ($currentSubIndex === 0) {
            // Back to block overview (null sub-block index)
            $presentation->update(['current_sub_block_index' => null]);
        } elseif ($currentBlockIndex > 0) {
            // Previous block - go to last sub-block if it has any
            $prevBlockIndex = $currentBlockIndex - 1;
            $prevBlock = $blocks->get($prevBlockIndex);
            $prevSubBlocks = $prevBlock?->subBlocks->sortBy('order')->values();

            $lastSubIndex = ($prevSubBlocks && $prevSubBlocks->count() > 0)
                ? $prevSubBlocks->count() - 1
                : null;

            $presentation->update([
                'current_block_index' => $prevBlockIndex,
                'current_sub_block_index' => $lastSubIndex,
            ]);
        }
        // If at very beginning (block 0, sub null), do nothing

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->fresh()->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Pause the presentation
     */
    public function pause(LessonPresentation $presentation): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorizePresenter($presentation);

        if ($presentation->status !== 'active') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Presentation is not active',
            ], 422);
        }

        $presentation->update(['status' => 'paused']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Resume a paused presentation
     */
    public function resume(LessonPresentation $presentation): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorizePresenter($presentation);

        if ($presentation->status !== 'paused') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Presentation is not paused',
            ], 422);
        }

        $presentation->update(['status' => 'active']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'state' => $presentation->getState(),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * End the presentation
     */
    public function end(LessonPresentation $presentation): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorizePresenter($presentation);

        if ($presentation->status === 'completed') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Presentation already ended',
            ], 422);
        }

        $presentation->update([
            'status' => 'completed',
            'ended_at' => now(),
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Presentation ended',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Get presentation history for a classroom
     */
    public function history(Classroom $classroom): JsonResponse
    {
        $presentations = LessonPresentation::where('classroom_id', $classroom->id)
            ->with(['lessonPlan:id,title,subject', 'teacher:id,name'])
            ->orderBy('started_at', 'desc')
            ->limit(20)
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($p) {
                return [
                    'id' => $p->id,
                    'lesson_plan' => $p->lessonPlan?->title,
                    'teacher' => $p->teacher?->name,
                    'status' => $p->status,
                    'started_at' => $p->started_at?->toIso8601String(),
                    'ended_at' => $p->ended_at?->toIso8601String(),
                    'duration_minutes' => $p->started_at && $p->ended_at
                        ? $p->started_at->diffInMinutes($p->ended_at)
                        : null,
                ];
            });

        return response()->json([
            'presentations' => $presentations,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Move to the next block
     */
    private function moveToNextBlock(LessonPresentation $presentation, $blocks): void
    {
        $nextBlockIndex = $presentation->current_block_index + 1;

        if ($nextBlockIndex < $blocks->count()) {
            $presentation->update([
                'current_block_index' => $nextBlockIndex,
                'current_sub_block_index' => null,
            ]);
        } else {
            // End of lesson
            $presentation->update([
                'status' => 'completed',
                'ended_at' => now(),
            ]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Verify user is the presenter (started the presentation)
     */
    private function authorizePresenter(LessonPresentation $presentation): void
    {
        if ($presentation->started_by !== auth()->id()) {
            abort(403, 'Only the presenter can control this presentation');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Verify user can start presentations
     */
    private function authorizeTeacher(): void
    {
        $role = auth()->user()->active_system_role ?? '';

        if (!in_array($role, ['admin', 'school', 'teacher'])) {
            abort(403, 'Only teachers can start presentations');
        }
    }
}

// resources/js/composables/useLessonPresentation.ts

import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, computed } from "vue";
import axios from "axios";

export function useLessonPresentation(classroomId: number | string, isTeacher: boolean = false) {
    const presentationId = ref<number | null>(null);
    const state = ref<any>(null);
    const lessonPlan = ref<any>(null);
    const teacher = ref<any>(null);
    const loading = ref(false);
    const error = ref<string | null>(null);
    const polling = ref<ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null>(null);

    const isActive = computed(() => state.value?.status === 'active');
    const isPaused = computed(() => state.value?.status === 'paused');
    const isCompleted = computed(() => state.value?.status === 'completed');
    const hasPresentation = computed(() => presentationId.value !== null);

    const fetchState = async () => {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route("lesson-presentation.state", classroomId));

            if (response.data.active) {
                presentationId.value = response.data.state.presentation_id;
                state.value = response.data.state;
                lessonPlan.value = response.data.lesson_plan;
                teacher.value = response.data.teacher;
            } else {
                presentationId.value = null;
                state.value = null;
                lessonPlan.value = null;
                teacher.value = null;
            }
            error.value = null;
        } catch (e: any) {
            console.error("Failed to fetch presentation state:", e);
            error.value = e.message;
        }
    };

    const startPresentation = async (lessonPlanId: number) => {
        loading.value = true;
        error.value = null;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.start", classroomId), {
                lesson_plan_id: lessonPlanId,
            });

            presentationId.value = response.data.presentation_id;
            state.value = response.data.state;

            return response.data;
        } catch (e: any) {
            console.error("Failed to start presentation:", e);
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        } finally {
            loading.value = false;
        }
    };

    const navigate = async (blockIndex: number, subBlockIndex: number | null = null) => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.navigate", presentationId.value), {
                block_index: blockIndex,
                sub_block_index: subBlockIndex,
            });

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e: any) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const next = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.next", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e: any) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const previous = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.previous", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e: any) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const pause = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.pause", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e: any) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const resume = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.resume", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e: any) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const end = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.end", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                presentationId.value = null;
                state.value = null;
                lessonPlan.value = null;
                teacher.value = null;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e: any) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const updateState = (newState: any) => {
        state.value = newState;
    };

    const startPolling = (intervalMs: number = 2000) => {
        if (polling.value) return;
        polling.value = setInterval(fetchState, intervalMs);
    };

    const stopPolling = () => {
        if (polling.value) {
            clearInterval(polling.value);
            polling.value = null;
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        fetchState();

        // Students poll for updates, teachers control directly
        if (!isTeacher) {
            startPolling();
        }
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        stopPolling();
    });

    return {
        // State
        presentationId,
        state,
        lessonPlan,
        teacher,
        loading,
        error,

        // Computed
        isActive,
        isPaused,
        isCompleted,
        hasPresentation,

        // Actions
        fetchState,
        startPresentation,
        navigate,
        next,
        previous,
        pause,
        resume,
        end,
        updateState,
        startPolling,
        stopPolling,
    };
}

                        <span class="text-sm capitalize truncate">{{ block.type }}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div v-if="block.content?.title" class="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate">
                        {{ block.content.title }}
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Current Content -->
            <div class="flex-1 p-4">
                <!-- Current Block Header -->
                <div v-if="state?.current_block" class="mb-4">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                        <span class="text-3xl">{{ getBlockIcon(state.current_block.type) }}</span>
                        <div>
                            <h4 class="text-xl font-semibold capitalize">
                                {{ state.current_block.type }}
                            </h4>
                            <p v-if="state.current_block.content?.title" class="text-gray-400">
                                {{ state.current_block.content.title }}
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <span
                            v-if="state.current_block.duration_minutes"
                            class="ml-auto text-sm text-gray-500"
                        >
                            {{ state.current_block.duration_minutes }} min
                        </span>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Sub-block Content -->
                <div
                    v-if="state?.current_sub_block"
                    class="bg-gray-800 rounded-lg p-4 mb-4"
                >
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                        <span class="text-xs text-gray-500">
                            Step {{ state.current_sub_block_index + 1 }} of {{ state.total_sub_blocks }}
                        </span>
                        <span
                            class="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 bg-gray-700 rounded capitalize"
                        >
                            {{ state.current_sub_block.type }}
                        </span>
                    </div>
                    <h5 class="font-semibold mb-2">{{ state.current_sub_block.title }}</h5>
                    <p class="text-gray-300 whitespace-pre-wrap">
                        {{ state.current_sub_block.content }}
                    </p>
                </div>

                <!-- Block Overview (when no sub-block selected) -->
                <div
                    v-else-if="state?.current_block"
                    class="bg-gray-800 rounded-lg p-4 mb-4"
                >
                    <BlockContent :block="state.current_block" />

                    <!-- Sub-blocks preview -->
                    <div
                        v-if="state.current_block.sub_blocks?.length"
                        class="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-700"
                    >
                        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-2">
                            {{ state.current_block.sub_blocks.length }} steps in this block
                        </p>
                        <div class="flex gap-1">
                            <div
                                v-for="(_, i) in state.current_block.sub_blocks"
                                :key="i"
                                class="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-gray-600"
                            />
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Progress Bar -->
                <div class="mb-4">
                    <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1">
                        <span>Progress</span>
                        <span>{{ state?.current_block_index + 1 }} / {{ state?.total_blocks }}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="h-2 bg-gray-700 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                        <div
                            class="h-full bg-blue-500 transition-all"
                            :style="{ width: progressPercent + '%' }"
                        />
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- Controls -->
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Button
                        severity="secondary"
                        :disabled="isFirst || state?.status === 'paused'"
                        @click="$emit('previous')"
                    >
                        ← Previous
                    </Button>

                    <div class="flex gap-2">
                        <Button
                            v-if="state?.status === 'active'"
                            severity="warning"
                            @click="$emit('pause')"
                        >
                            ⏸ Pause
                        </Button>
                        <Button
                            v-else-if="state?.status === 'paused'"
                            severity="success"
                            @click="$emit('resume')"
                        >
                            ▶ Resume
                        </Button>
                        <Button severity="danger" outlined @click="confirmEnd">
                            End Lesson
                        </Button>
                    </div>

                    <Button
                        severity="primary"
                        :disabled="state?.status !== 'active'"
                        @click="$emit('next')"
                    >
                        Next →
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { Button } from "primevue";
import BlockContent from "./BlockContent.vue";

const props = defineProps<{
    lessonPlan: {
        id: number;
        title: string;
        subject: string;
        grade_level: string;
    } | null;
    state: {
        status: string;
        current_block_index: number;
        current_sub_block_index: number | null;
        total_blocks: number;
        total_sub_blocks: number;
        current_block: any;
        current_sub_block: any;
    } | null;
    blocks: any[];
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{
    (e: "next"): void;
    (e: "previous"): void;
    (e: "navigate", blockIndex: number, subBlockIndex: number | null): void;
    (e: "pause"): void;
    (e: "resume"): void;
    (e: "end"): void;
}>();

const isFirst = computed(() => {
    return (
        props.state?.current_block_index === 0 &&
        props.state?.current_sub_block_index === null
    );
});

const progressPercent = computed(() => {
    if (!props.state || props.state.total_blocks === 0) return 0;
    return ((props.state.current_block_index + 1) / props.state.total_blocks) * 100;
});

const goToBlock = (index: number) => {
    emit("navigate", index, null);
};

const confirmEnd = () => {
    if (confirm("End this lesson for all students?")) {
        emit("end");
    }
};

const getBlockIcon = (type: string) => {
    const icons: Record<string, string> = {
        objective: "🎯",
        activity: "⚡",
        assessment: "📝",
        materials: "📦",
        media: "🎬",
        discussion: "💬",
        differentiation: "🔀",
        notes: "📌",
    };
    return icons[type] || "📋";
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.bg-gray-850 {
    background-color: #1f2937;
}
</style>

    state: {
        status: string;
        current_block_index: number;
        current_sub_block_index: number | null;
        total_blocks: number;
        total_sub_blocks: number;
        current_block: any;
        current_sub_block: any;
    } | null;
}>();

const progressPercent = computed(() => {
    if (!props.state || props.state.total_blocks === 0) return 0;
    return ((props.state.current_block_index + 1) / props.state.total_blocks) * 100;
});

const blockColorClass = computed(() => {
    const colors: Record<string, string> = {
        objective: "bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-emerald-600",

        differentiation: "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-orange-500",
        notes: "bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-500 to-slate-600",
    };
    return colors[props.state?.current_block?.type] || "bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-500 to-slate-600";
});

const getBlockIcon = (type: string) => {

        notes: "📌",
    };
    return icons[type] || "📋";
};

import { computed, watch } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { Button } from "primevue";
import { useLessonPresentation } from "@/composables/useLessonPresentation";
import TeacherControls from "./TeacherControls.vue";

const props = defineProps<{
    classroomId: number | string;
    classroomLessonPlanId: number | null;
}>();

const auth = usePage().props.auth as any;

const isTeacher = computed(() =>
    ["admin", "school", "teacher"].includes(auth.user?.active_system_role)
);

const presentation = useLessonPresentation(props.classroomId, isTeacher.value);

const lessonPlanBlocks = computed(() => {
    return presentation.state.value?.current_block
        ? [presentation.state.value.current_block]
        : [];
});

// Fetch full lesson plan blocks for teacher navigation
watch(
    () => presentation.hasPresentation.value,
    async (hasPresentation) => {
        if (hasPresentation && isTeacher.value) {

                const response = await axios.get(
                    route("api.lesson-plans.show", presentation.state.value?.lesson_plan_id)
                );
                // Update blocks from full lesson plan
                lessonPlanBlocks.value = response.data.lesson_plan?.blocks || [];
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Failed to fetch lesson plan blocks:", e);
            }
        }
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

const startLesson = async () => {
    if (!props.classroomLessonPlanId) return;
    await presentation.startPresentation(props.classroomLessonPlanId);
};
</script>

// resources/js/composables/useLessonPresentation.js

import { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted, computed } from "vue";
import axios from "axios";

export function useLessonPresentation(classroomId, isTeacher = false) {
    const presentationId = ref(null);
    const state = ref(null);
    const lessonPlan = ref(null);
    const teacher = ref(null);
    const loading = ref(false);
    const error = ref(null);
    const polling = ref(null);

    const isActive = computed(() => state.value?.status === 'active');
    const isPaused = computed(() => state.value?.status === 'paused');
    const isCompleted = computed(() => state.value?.status === 'completed');
    const hasPresentation = computed(() => presentationId.value !== null);

    const fetchState = async () => {
        try {
            const response = await axios.get(route("lesson-presentation.state", classroomId));

            if (response.data.active) {
                presentationId.value = response.data.state.presentation_id;
                state.value = response.data.state;
                lessonPlan.value = response.data.lesson_plan;
                teacher.value = response.data.teacher;
            } else {
                presentationId.value = null;
                state.value = null;
                lessonPlan.value = null;
                teacher.value = null;
            }
            error.value = null;
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Failed to fetch presentation state:", e);
            error.value = e.message;
        }
    };

    const startPresentation = async (lessonPlanId) => {
        loading.value = true;
        error.value = null;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.start", classroomId), {
                lesson_plan_id: lessonPlanId,
            });

            presentationId.value = response.data.presentation_id;
            state.value = response.data.state;

            return response.data;
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Failed to start presentation:", e);
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        } finally {
            loading.value = false;
        }
    };

    const navigate = async (blockIndex, subBlockIndex = null) => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.navigate", presentationId.value), {
                block_index: blockIndex,
                sub_block_index: subBlockIndex,
            });

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const next = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.next", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const previous = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.previous", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const pause = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.pause", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const resume = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.resume", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                state.value = response.data.state;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const end = async () => {
        if (!presentationId.value) return;

        try {
            const response = await axios.post(route("lesson-presentation.end", presentationId.value));

            if (response.data.success) {
                presentationId.value = null;
                state.value = null;
                lessonPlan.value = null;
                teacher.value = null;
            }
            return response.data;
        } catch (e) {
            error.value = e.response?.data?.message || e.message;
            throw e;
        }
    };

    const updateState = (newState) => {
        state.value = newState;
    };

    const startPolling = (intervalMs = 2000) => {
        if (polling.value) return;
        polling.value = setInterval(fetchState, intervalMs);
    };

    const stopPolling = () => {
        if (polling.value) {
            clearInterval(polling.value);
            polling.value = null;
        }
    };

    onMounted(() => {
        fetchState();

        if (!isTeacher) {
            startPolling();
        }
    });

    onUnmounted(() => {
        stopPolling();
    });

    return {
        presentationId,
        state,
        lessonPlan,
        teacher,
        loading,
        error,
        isActive,
        isPaused,
        isCompleted,
        hasPresentation,
        fetchState,
        startPresentation,
        navigate,
        next,
        previous,
        pause,
        resume,
        end,
        updateState,
        startPolling,
        stopPolling,
    };
}

<script setup>
import { computed } from "vue";
import { Button } from "primevue";
import BlockContent from "./BlockContent.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    lessonPlan: {
        type: Object,
        default: null,
    },
    state: {
        type: Object,
        default: null,
    },
    blocks: {
        type: Array,
        default: () => [],
    },
});

const emit = defineEmits(["next", "previous", "navigate", "pause", "resume", "end"]);

const isFirst = computed(() => {
    return (
        props.state?.current_block_index === 0 &&
        props.state?.current_sub_block_index === null
    );
});

const progressPercent = computed(() => {
    if (!props.state || props.state.total_blocks === 0) return 0;
    return ((props.state.current_block_index + 1) / props.state.total_blocks) * 100;
});

const goToBlock = (index) => {
    emit("navigate", index, null);
};

const confirmEnd = () => {
    if (confirm("End this lesson for all students?")) {
        emit("end");
    }
};

const getBlockIcon = (type) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: "🎯",
        activity: "⚡",
        assessment: "📝",
        materials: "📦",
        media: "🎬",
        discussion: "💬",
        differentiation: "🔀",
        notes: "📌",
    };
    return icons[type] || "📋";
};
</script>

                                <div class="text-white">
                                    <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold capitalize">
                                        {{ state.current_block.type }}
                                    </h2>
                                    <p v-if="state.current_block.content?.title" class="text-white/80">
                                        {{ state.current_block.content.title }}
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                                <span
                                    v-if="state.current_block.duration_minutes"
                                    class="ml-auto bg-white/20 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-white text-sm"
                                >
                                    {{ state.current_block.duration_minutes }} min
                                </span>
                            </div>
                        </div>

                        <!-- Content Body -->
                        <div class="p-6">
                            <!-- Showing sub-block -->
                            <div v-if="state.current_sub_block" class="space-y-4">
                                <!-- Sub-block progress -->
                                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                                    <div
                                        v-for="(_, i) in state.current_block.sub_blocks"
                                        :key="i"
                                        :class="[
                                            'h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full transition-colors',
                                            i <= state.current_sub_block_index
                                                ? 'bg-blue-500'
                                                : 'bg-gray-200',
                                        ]"
                                    />
                                </div>

                                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                                    <span class="text-sm text-gray-500">
                                        Step {{ state.current_sub_block_index + 1 }} of
                                        {{ state.current_block.sub_blocks?.length }}
                                    </span>
                                    <span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 bg-gray-100 rounded capitalize">
                                        {{ state.current_sub_block.type }}
                                    </span>
                                </div>

                                <h3 class="text-2xl font-semibold text-gray-800">
                                    {{ state.current_sub_block.title }}
                                </h3>

                                <p class="text-lg text-gray-700 whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed">
                                    {{ state.current_sub_block.content }}
                                </p>
                            </div>

                            <!-- Showing block overview -->
                            <div v-else class="student-block-content">
                                <StudentBlockContent :block="state.current_block" />

                                <!-- Upcoming steps hint -->
                                <div
                                    v-if="state.current_block.sub_blocks?.length"
                                    class="mt-6 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100"
                                >
                                    <p class="text-gray-500 flex items-center gap-2">
                                        <span>📋</span>
                                        {{ state.current_block.sub_blocks.length }} steps coming up...
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </template>
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed } from "vue";
import StudentBlockContent from "./StudentBlockContent.vue";

const props = defineProps({
    state: {
        type: Object,
        default: null,
    },
});

const progressPercent = computed(() => {
    if (!props.state || props.state.total_blocks === 0) return 0;
    return ((props.state.current_block_index + 1) / props.state.total_blocks) * 100;
});

const blockColorClass = computed(() => {
    const colors = {
        objective: "bg-gradient-to-r from-green-500 to-emerald-600",
        activity: "bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600",
        assessment: "bg-gradient-to-r from-purple-500 to-violet-600",
        materials: "bg-gradient-to-r from-orange-500 to-amber-600",
        media: "bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-rose-600",
        discussion: "bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-teal-600",
        differentiation: "bg-gradient-to-r from-yellow-500 to-orange-500",
        notes: "bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-500 to-slate-600",
    };
    return colors[props.state?.current_block?.type] || "bg-gradient-to-r from-gray-500 to-slate-600";
});

const getBlockIcon = (type) => {
    const icons = {
        objective: "🎯",
        activity: "⚡",
        assessment: "📝",
        materials: "📦",
        media: "🎬",
        discussion: "💬",
        differentiation: "🔀",
        notes: "📌",
    };
    return icons[type] || "📋";
};
</script>

<!-- resources/js/Components/LessonPresentation/LessonPresentationPanel.vue -->
<template>
    <div class="h-full flex flex-col">
        <!-- Teacher View -->
        <template v-if="isTeacher">
            <!-- No lesson plan assigned -->
            <div v-if="!classroomLessonPlanId" class="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-6">
                <div class="text-center">
                    <div class="text-4xl mb-3">📚</div>
                    <p class="text-gray-500">No lesson plan assigned to this classroom</p>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Start button when no active presentation -->
            <div
                v-else-if="!presentation.hasPresentation.value"
                class="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-6"
            >
                <div class="text-center">
                    <div class="text-4xl mb-3">🎓</div>
                    <h3 class="font-semibold mb-2">Ready to teach?</h3>
                    <p class="text-gray-500 mb-4">Start the lesson to present to your students</p>
                    <Button
                        @click="startLesson"
                        :loading="presentation.loading.value"
                        severity="success"
                        size="large"
                    >
                        ▶ Start Lesson
                    </Button>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- Teacher controls when presentation is active -->
            <TeacherControls
                v-else
                :lesson-plan="presentation.lessonPlan.value"
                :state="presentation.state.value"
                :blocks="lessonPlanBlocks"
                @next="presentation.next()"
                @previous="presentation.previous()"
                @navigate="handleNavigate"
                @pause="presentation.pause()"
                @resume="presentation.resume()"
                @end="presentation.end()"
            />
        </template>

        <!-- Student View -->
        <StudentView v-else :state="presentation.state.value" class="flex-1" />
    </div>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, watch, ref } from "vue";
import { usePage } from "@inertiajs/vue3";
import { Button } from "primevue";
import { useLessonPresentation } from "@/composables/useLessonPresentation";
import TeacherControls from "./TeacherControls.vue";
import StudentView from "./StudentView.vue";
import axios from "axios";

const props = defineProps({
    classroomId: {
        type: [Number, String],
        required: true,
    },
    classroomLessonPlanId: {
        type: Number,
        default: null,
    },
});

const auth = usePage().props.auth;

const isTeacher = computed(() =>
    ["admin", "school", "teacher"].includes(auth.user?.active_system_role)
);

const presentation = useLessonPresentation(props.classroomId, isTeacher.value);

const lessonPlanBlocks = ref([]);

// Fetch full lesson plan blocks for teacher navigation
watch(
    () => presentation.hasPresentation.value,
    async (hasPresentation) => {
        if (hasPresentation && isTeacher.value && presentation.state.value?.lesson_plan_id) {
            try {
                const response = await axios.get(
                    route("api.lesson-plans.show", presentation.state.value.lesson_plan_id)
                );
                lessonPlanBlocks.value = response.data.lesson_plan?.blocks || [];
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Failed to fetch lesson plan blocks:", e);
            }
        }
    },
    { immediate: true }
);

const startLesson = async () => {
    if (!props.classroomLessonPlanId) return;
    await presentation.startPresentation(props.classroomLessonPlanId);
};

const handleNavigate = (blockIndex, subBlockIndex) => {
    presentation.navigate(blockIndex, subBlockIndex);
};
</script>
